```tsx
const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const esc = (text: string): string => text.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#x27;");
const noop = () => undefined;
const caseId = (id: string) => parseCaseId(id)!;

const SEAL_FOR_GOOD =
  "A seal for good is lifted only on the authority's answer that the images are not child sexual abuse material. Say in the reason that the authority has answered, and the date of its answer. Never write its reference or anything that names a person: the reference stays in the operator's records, off the server.";

/** A final removal of the post and of one image, decided by someone else, under the first rulebook. */
const removal: CaseDecision = decision({

const appeal = (more: Partial<CaseAppeal> = {}): CaseAppeal => ({

describe("an appeal on the case page", () => {
  const page = (view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"] = MODERATOR) => {
    const draft = newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, role);
    const compose: CaseScreenViewProps["compose"] = { role, draft, now: NOW, busy: false, error: null, textErrors: {}, declining: null, onChange: noop, onTextBlur: noop, onSeal: noop, onConfirm: noop, onDeclineOpen: noop, onDeclineChange: noop, onDeclineSave: noop, onDeclineClose: noop, onCancelCorrection: noop, onCorrect: noop, onReview: noop };
    const props: CaseScreenViewProps = { caseId: caseId(view.id), view, compose, shownImage: null, busy: null, notice: null, error: null, note: "", reveal: null, onOpenCase: noop, onShowImage: noop, onShowClearly: noop, onHideImage: noop, onImageError: noop, onSnapshot: noop, onNoteChange: noop, onNoteSave: noop, onRevealOpen: noop, onRevealChange: noop, onRevealConfirm: noop, onRevealClose: noop };
    return html(<CaseScreenView {...props} />);
  };

  test("a pending appeal shows its statement as text, who may review it, and Review this appeal for the person who may", () => {
    const view = appealed({ statement: "<script>alert(1)</script>" });
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(view).success).toBe(true);
    const out = page(view);
    expect(out).toContain("&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;");
    expect(out).not.toContain("<script>");
    expect(out).toContain("not answered yet");
    expect(out).toContain(">Review this appeal</button>");
    // Someone who took part in the case reads why there is no button, in words that name nobody.
    const mine = page(appealed({ mayReview: false }));
    expect(mine).not.toContain("Review this appeal</button>");
    expect(mine).toContain(esc(APPEAL_WORDS.mayNotReview));
    // A review that is an admin's, and an appeal nobody can review now, say so.
    const needsAdmin = page(appealed({ needsAdmin: true, mayReview: false, reviewer: "none_single_staff" }));
    expect(needsAdmin).toContain(esc(APPEAL_WORDS.needsAdmin));
    expect(needsAdmin).toContain(APPEAL_WORDS.reviewer.none_single_staff);
    expect(page(appealed({ reviewer: "none_eligible", mayReview: false }))).toContain(APPEAL_WORDS.reviewer.none_eligible);
  });

  test("an answered appeal shows its result and offers no review", () => {
    const out = page(appealed({ answeredAt: "2026-10-08T10:00:00.000Z", result: "partly_reversed", answeredBy: "e2f30415-2637-4849-8ab5-d0e1f2031425", reviewer: null, mayReview: false }));
    expect(out).toContain("answered: partly reversed");
    expect(out).not.toContain("Review this appeal");
    expect(out).not.toContain(esc(APPEAL_WORDS.mayNotReview));
  });

  test("a re-examination is marked on its item, and for whoever decided the item it re-examines", () => {
    const view = postCase({ items: [item({ id: ITEM_REEXAMINATION, seq: 3, reexaminesPosition: 2, reexaminesYourDecision: true, statement: "Look at the second image." })] });
    const out = page(view);
    expect(out).toContain("Re-examination of item 2 of its notice");
    expect(out).toContain("You decided the item this re-examines. Leave it to another staff member when there is one.");
    expect(out).toContain("Look at the second image.");
    expect(page(postCase({ items: [item({ id: ITEM_REEXAMINATION, seq: 3, reexaminesPosition: 2, reexaminesYourDecision: false })] }))).not.toContain("You decided the item this re-examines");
  });
});

describe("the review composer", () => {
  const view = appealed();
  const draftOf = (shown: CaseView = view, decided: CaseDecision = removal, role: StaffMe["role"] = MODERATOR) => reviewDraft(caseId(shown.id), shown, decided, role);
  const composer = (shown: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"], draft: CaseDraft, extra: Partial<ComposerViewProps> = {}) => {
    const props: ComposerViewProps = { view: shown, role, draft, now: NOW, busy: false, error: null, textErrors: {}, declining: null, onChange: noop, onTextBlur: noop, onSeal: noop, onConfirm: noop, onDeclineOpen: noop, onDeclineChange: noop, onDeclineSave: noop, onDeclineClose: noop, onCancelCorrection: noop, ...extra };
    return html(<ComposerView {...props} />);
  };
  const reasoned = (draft: CaseDraft): CaseDraft => ({ ...draft, written: { ...draft.written, review_reason: "The rule does not cover a quotation." } });

  test("a decision's pending appeal is reviewed by the person the API marked, and by nobody else", () => {
    expect(reviewable(view, removal)).toMatchObject({ appeal: { id: APPEAL_ID }, measures: [{ kind: "remove" }, { kind: "remove_media" }] });
    expect(reviewable(appealed({ mayReview: false }), removal)).toBeNull();
    expect(reviewable(appealed({ result: "kept", answeredAt: "2026-10-08T10:00:00.000Z", reviewer: null, mayReview: false }), removal)).toBeNull();
    expect(reviewable(postCase({ decisions: [removal], appeals: [] }), removal)).toBeNull();
    expect(html(<ReviewControl view={view} decision={removal} disabled={false} onReview={noop} />)).toContain(">Review this appeal</button>");
    expect(html(<ReviewControl view={appealed({ mayReview: false })} decision={removal} disabled={false} onReview={noop} />)).toBe("");
  });

  test("Keep, Reverse in part and Reverse: the outcome follows what is lifted, and each is complete only as its name says", () => {
    const draft = draftOf();
    expect(draft).toMatchObject({ kind: "review", reviewsDecisionId: REMOVAL_ID, review: "kept", actions: [], category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD" });
    expect(textsOffered(draft)).toEqual(["review_reason"]);
    expect(reviewChoices(view, draft, MODERATOR).map((choice) => choice.reversal)).toEqual([
      { kind: "restore", mediaId: null },
      { kind: "restore_media", mediaId: IMAGE_ONE },
    ]);
    // Nothing is complete without its reason.
    expect(complete(view, draft)).toBe(false);
    expect(complete(view, reasoned(draft))).toBe(true);
    // Keep lifts nothing; Reverse lifts everything still in force; Reverse in part lifts something and leaves something.
    expect(complete(view, reasoned({ ...draft, actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] }))).toBe(false);
    const all = [{ kind: "restore" as const, mediaId: null }, { kind: "restore_media" as const, mediaId: IMAGE_ONE }];
    expect(complete(view, reasoned({ ...draft, review: "reversed", actions: all }))).toBe(true);
    expect(complete(view, reasoned({ ...draft, review: "reversed", actions: [all[0]!] }))).toBe(false);
    expect(complete(view, reasoned({ ...draft, review: "partly_reversed", actions: [all[0]!] }))).toBe(true);
    expect(complete(view, reasoned({ ...draft, review: "partly_reversed", actions: all }))).toBe(false);
    expect(complete(view, reasoned({ ...draft, review: "partly_reversed", actions: [] }))).toBe(false);
    expect(reviewOutcomeOf(view, { ...draft, review: "partly_reversed", actions: [all[0]!] })).toBe("partly_reversed");
    expect(REVIEW_OUTCOMES).toEqual({ kept: "Keep", partly_reversed: "Reverse in part", reversed: "Reverse" });
  });

  test("the composer shows the three choices, the reversals of what is still in force, the reason with the sentence on personal data, and the preview of the review's statement", () => {
    const out = composer(view, MODERATOR, reasoned({ ...draftOf(), review: "partly_reversed", actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] }));
    expect(out).toMatch(/<h3[^>]*>Review the appeal</);
    for (const label of ["Keep", "Reverse in part", "Reverse"]) expect(out).toContain(`<span>${label}</span>`);
    expect(out).toContain(MEASURES.restore.label);
    expect(out).toContain(MEASURES.restore_media.label);
    expect(out).toContain(`<code>${IMAGE_ONE}</code>`);
    expect(out).toContain("Reason of the review");
    expect(out).toContain(esc(COMPOSER.personalData));
    // The preview is the statement its author gets: the review's lead, the reviewed decision's rule in its own version, the reason.
    const preview = statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, reasoned({ ...draftOf(), review: "partly_reversed", actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] }), NOW));
    expect(preview[0]).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.reviewed("2026-10-01 09:00 UTC", "partly_reversed"));
    expect(preview).toContain(`That decision rested on korbat rule R1, "${getRule("R1", 1)!.title}": ${getRule("R1", 1)!.text}`);
    expect(preview).toContain("Why korbat changed it: The rule does not cover a quotation.");
    for (const paragraph of preview) expect(out, paragraph).toContain(esc(paragraph));
    expect(out).toContain(">Confirm with your staff key</button>");
    // A kept review tells its author so, and lists no reversal as chosen.
    const kept = statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, reasoned(draftOf()), NOW));
    expect(kept[0]).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.reviewed("2026-10-01 09:00 UTC", "kept"));
    expect(kept).toContain("Why korbat kept it: The rule does not cover a quotation.");
    // The appeal that was open when the composer opened is answered meanwhile: nothing is left to review.
    const gone = composer(appealed({ result: "kept", answeredAt: "2026-10-08T10:00:00.000Z", reviewer: null, mayReview: false }), MODERATOR, reasoned(draftOf()));
    expect(gone).toContain("This appeal is answered, or is not yours to review.");
    expect(gone).not.toContain("Confirm with your staff key");
  });

  test("Lift the seal stands in an admin's review alone, with the sentence on when a seal for good is lifted; a moderator is offered no review of such a decision", () => {
    const sealAction = frozenCase().decisions[0]!.actions[0]!;
    const sealed: CaseDecision = decision({ id: REMOVAL_ID, kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS", suspect: true, needsAdmin: true, throughSeq: 2, answersFromSeq: 1, staffHandle: "admin_ben", actions: [sealAction] });
    const forAdmin = appealed({ needsAdmin: true }, sealed);
    expect(reviewChoices(forAdmin, draftOf(forAdmin, sealed, ADMIN), ADMIN).map((choice) => choice.reversal.kind)).toEqual(["unseal_media"]);
    const out = composer(forAdmin, ADMIN, reasoned({ ...draftOf(forAdmin, sealed, ADMIN), review: "reversed", actions: [{ kind: "unseal_media", mediaId: null }] }));
    expect(out).toContain(MEASURES.unseal_media.label);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(SEAL_FOR_GOOD));
    // The API marks such an appeal as not a moderator's to review: no control, and a composer opened all the same shows nothing to confirm.
    const forModerator = appealed({ needsAdmin: true, mayReview: false }, sealed);
    expect(reviewable(forModerator, sealed)).toBeNull();
    expect(composer(forModerator, MODERATOR, reasoned(draftOf(forModerator, sealed, MODERATOR)))).not.toContain("Confirm with your staff key");
    expect(reviewChoices(forAdmin, draftOf(forAdmin, sealed, MODERATOR), MODERATOR)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("the review's params: the appeal, the reviewed decision's category and rules version, the reversals in their one order, and the outcome as chosen", () => {
    const draft = reasoned({ ...draftOf(), review: "reversed", actions: [{ kind: "restore_media", mediaId: IMAGE_ONE }, { kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] });
    const params = reviewParamsOf(view, draft, { snapshot: HEX, reason: "bb".repeat(32) });
    expect(params).toEqual({
      stateVersion: view.stateVersion,
      appealId: APPEAL_ID,
      snapshotId: view.snapshots[0]!.id,
      snapshotDigest: HEX,
      outcome: "reversed",
      rulesVersion: 1,
      redressVersion: REDRESS_VERSION,
      category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD",
      actions: [
        { kind: "restore", mediaId: null },
        { kind: "restore_media", mediaId: IMAGE_ONE },
      ],
      reasonDigest: "bb".repeat(32),
    });
    expect(AppealsReviewedParams.safeParse(params).success).toBe(true);
    expect(reviewAction(REMOVAL_ID, params)).toEqual({ action: "appeals_reviewed", target: { type: "decision", id: REMOVAL_ID }, params });
    expect(reviewParamsOf(view, reasoned(draftOf()), { snapshot: HEX, reason: "bb".repeat(32) })).toMatchObject({ outcome: "kept", actions: [] });
    // Without a pending appeal there is nothing to build.
    expect(() => reviewParamsOf(postCase({ decisions: [removal], appeals: [] }), draft, { snapshot: HEX, reason: "bb".repeat(32) })).toThrow();
  });

  describe("confirmed by the key", () => {
    const draft = reasoned({ ...draftOf(), review: "partly_reversed", actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] });
    const after = postCase({ closedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z", stateVersion: 4, decisions: [removal], appeals: [appeal({ result: "partly_reversed", answeredAt: "2026-10-09T09:30:00.000Z", answeredBy: "e2f30415-2637-4849-8ab5-d0e1f2031425", reviewer: null, mayReview: false })] });

    async function run(options: { review?: { status: number; body: unknown }; bind?: (action: ReturnType<typeof reviewAction>) => object } = {}) {
      const saves: { kind: string; text: string; salt: string; digest: string }[] = [];
      let action: ReturnType<typeof reviewAction> | null = null;
      const fake = fakeFetch({
        "GET /api/staff/me": { status: 200, body: makeMe() },
        [`POST /api/staff/decisions/${REMOVAL_ID}/review`]: options.review ?? { status: 201, body: after },
      });
      const fetch: typeof fake.fetch = async (input, init) => {
        const body = typeof init?.body === "string" ? (JSON.parse(init.body) as Record<string, unknown>) : undefined;
        if (input === `/api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}/texts` && init?.method === "POST") {
          await fake.fetch(input, init);
          saves.push(body as (typeof saves)[number]);
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ id: "bfc0d1e2-f304-4516-b782-adbecfd0e1f2", digest: body!.digest }), { status: 201, headers: { "content-type": "application/json" } });
        }
        if (input === "/api/staff/step-up/options") {
          await fake.fetch(input, init);
          action = body as ReturnType<typeof reviewAction>;
          return new Response(JSON.stringify(stepUpOptions(await stepUpChallenge(SESSION_HANDLE, (options.bind ? options.bind(action) : action) as never))), { status: 200, headers: { "content-type": "application/json" } });
        }
        return fake.fetch(input, init);
      };
      const credentials = fakeCredentials();
      const api = createStaffApi({ fetch, cookie: () => "__Host-korbat_staff_csrf=t" });
      const outcome = await confirmDecision({ api, credentials, random: (length) => new Uint8Array(length).fill(7) }, caseId(CASE_POST), view, draft);
      return { outcome, credentials, requests: fake.requests, saves, action: action as ReturnType<typeof reviewAction> | null };
    }

    test("the reason is saved as a review reason, the key confirms the review of exactly that decision, and the answer is the case as it now stands", async () => {
      const done = await run();
      expect(done.outcome).toEqual({ view: after });
      expect(done.credentials.calls).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(done.saves.map((save) => save.kind)).toEqual(["review_reason"]);
      const shown = view.snapshots[0]!;
      if (shown.withheld) throw new Error("the fixture's newest snapshot shows its content");
      const reason = await textDigest("07".repeat(32), "The rule does not cover a quotation.");
      expect(done.action).toEqual({ action: "appeals_reviewed", target: { type: "decision", id: REMOVAL_ID }, params: reviewParamsOf(view, draft, { snapshot: await shownSnapshotDigest(shown), reason }) });
      const sent = done.requests.at(-1)!;
      expect(`${sent.method} ${sent.url} ${sent.headers["x-staff-activity"]}`).toBe(`POST /api/staff/decisions/${REMOVAL_ID}/review 1`);
      expect(sent.body).toMatchObject({ ...done.action!.params, stepUp: { type: "public-key" } });
    });

    test("options that bind another decision or another outcome are refused before the key is asked, and no review is sent", async () => {
      for (const bind of [(action: ReturnType<typeof reviewAction>) => ({ ...action, target: { ...action.target, id: CASE_FROZEN } }), (action: ReturnType<typeof reviewAction>) => ({ ...action, params: { ...action.params, outcome: "kept" } })]) {
        const done = await run({ bind });
        expect(done.outcome).toMatchObject({ code: "step_up_mismatch" });
        expect(done.credentials.calls).toHaveLength(0);
        expect(done.requests.some((request) => request.url.endsWith("/review"))).toBe(false);
      }
    });

    test("an answer that carries another case is no answer, and each refusal is worded by the console, never by the server", async () => {
      expect((await run({ review: { status: 201, body: frozenCase() } })).outcome).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_answer" });
      for (const code of ["reviewer_conflict", "admin_required", "case_changed", "snapshot_erased", "staff_recused"] as const) {
        const done = await run({ review: { status: code === "case_changed" || code === "snapshot_erased" ? 409 : 403, body: envelope(code) } });
        expect(done.outcome, code).toEqual({ error: MODERATION_MESSAGES[code], code });
      }
      // The review composer words an erased snapshot as the decision composer does: the one table words both.
      expect(messageFor("snapshot_erased")).toBe(MODERATION_MESSAGES.snapshot_erased);
      expect(CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES).toContain("reviewer_conflict");
      expect(MODERATION_MESSAGES.reviewer_conflict).toBe("You cannot review this appeal: you made a decision in its case, or opened a finding in it. Another staff member must review it.");
    });
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/http-appeals.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino from "pino";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import {

  CaseView,
  DecisionView,
  ErrorEnvelope,
  FlowResponse,
  NoticeResponse,
  ReexamineResponse,
  ReportsPage,
  StaffOverview,
  StaffStepUpOptionsResponse,
  type AppealsReviewedParams,
  type AuthenticationResponseJSON,
  type CaseDecidedParams,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, profiles, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { createApp } from "../../src/app";
import { createAuth, type Auth } from "../../src/auth";
import { randomToken } from "../../src/auth/crypto";
import { MemoryKv } from "../../src/auth/kv";
import { createAuthRepo, type AuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { loadConfig, type Config } from "../../src/config";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { MemoryStore } from "../../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { createModeration } from "../../src/moderation";
import { createProfileStore } from "../../src/profiles/store";
import { socialForModeration } from "../../src/social";
import { createStaff } from "../../src/staff";
import { SoftAuthenticator } from "../auth/soft-authenticator";
import { Browser } from "./http-client";
import { act, authCaseCounts, casesMedia, decisionParams, moderationCounts, newPostRow, removeFixtures, reviewParams, uuids, type DecisionInput, type ReviewInput } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { HUMAN, notices, postTarget } from "./notices-harness";
import { enrolKey } from "./staff-enrolment";
import { DEVICE_BOUND, TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, issueEnrolment, newStaffAccount } from "./staff-fixtures";

// Each test signs accounts up and staff keys in over HTTP and confirms decisions with them: on a loaded machine that
// takes longer than the five seconds a test gets by default.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 120_000 });

const STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE = "__Host-korbat_staff_csrf";
/** The mark the console sends on a request its person's action started (3a design, section 7). */
const MARKED = { "x-staff-activity": "1" };

/**
 * The routes of appeals and re-examination through the real app (3c design, sections 7.2, 7.7 and 12), the app's site and
 * the console's in one server: the author's appeal and the two re-examination routes with their sessions and refusal
 * codes, and the console's list of appeals and its review, with the staff session and the key's confirmation of exactly
 * that review. Every raw answer is held strictly equal to its parsed form. What the flows store is tested in
 * moderation-appeals-flow.test.ts and moderation-reexamine.test.ts. Every decision and review here is confirmed by a real
 * key, so the audit rows that stay are ones audit-verify accepts; everything else is removed again, and the file's last
 * test holds it to leaving no row behind.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: appeals, reviews and re-examination over HTTP", () => {
  let config: Config;
  let authDb: Db;
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let repo: AuthRepo;
  let auth: Auth;
  let mailer: MemoryMailer;
  let app: ReturnType<typeof createApp>;
  let settle: () => Promise<void>;
  let moderator: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof staffBrowser>>;
  let second: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof staffBrowser>>;
  let admin: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof staffBrowser>>;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const staffIds: string[] = [];
  const profileIds: string[] = [];

  beforeAll(async () => {
    // The test environment with the console switched on at the staff harness's address.
    config = loadConfig({ ...process.env, CONSOLE_ORIGIN: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, CONSOLE_RP_ID: "" });
    const logger = pino({ level: "silent" });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 4 });
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 6 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
    mailer = new MemoryMailer();
    auth = createAuth({
      config,
      logger,
      authDb,
      kv: new MemoryKv(),
      mailer,
      profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb),
      turnstile: { verify: async (token) => token === HUMAN },
      breachChecker: { isBreached: async () => false },
    });
    const rateLimitStore = new MemoryStore();
    const moderation = createModeration({ apiDb, auth: auth.forModeration, social: socialForModeration(apiDb), media: casesMedia(apiDb), requireSession: auth.requireSession, rateLimitStore, config, logger });
    settle = moderation.settle;
    app = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks: {}, auth, moderation, staff: createStaff({ apiDb, auth: auth.forStaff, moderation: moderation.forStaff }) });
    before = await counts();
    moderator = await staffBrowser("moderator");
    second = await staffBrowser("moderator");
    admin = await staffBrowser("admin");
  }, 180_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await Promise.all([closeDb(authDb), closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  /** How many rows the moderation tables and the four auth tables of moderation cases hold. */
  const counts = async (): Promise<Record<string, number>> => ({ ...(await moderationCounts(apiDb)), ...(await authCaseCounts(migrateDb)) });
  const appBrowser = () => new Browser(app, config.APP_ORIGIN);
  const consoleBrowser = () => new Browser(app, TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, { base: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, csrfCookie: STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE, csrfHeader: "x-staff-csrf" });
  const error = async (res: Response) => ErrorEnvelope.parse(await res.json()).error;
  /** A refusal as its status and its code. */
  const refused = async (res: Response) => [res.status, (await error(res)).code];
  /** A 2xx answer's body, held strictly equal to its parsed form. */
  async function parsed<T>(res: Response, status: number, schema: { parse(value: unknown): T }): Promise<T> {
    expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(status);
    const raw: unknown = await res.json();
    const value = schema.parse(raw);
    expect(raw).toStrictEqual(value);
    return value;
  }

  /** A browser signed in over HTTP, with a profile. */
  async function signUp() {
    const b = appBrowser();
    const email = `appeal-${randomUUID()}@korbat.local`;
    const handle = `h${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`;
    const start = await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/start", { json: { email, turnstileToken: HUMAN, deviceId: randomToken(), platform: "web" } });
    expect(start.status, await start.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    const { flowId } = FlowResponse.parse(await start.json());
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/verify", { json: { flowId, code: mailer.lastCodeFor(email) } })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/signup/complete", { json: { flowId, dateOfBirth: "1990-05-17", termsVersion: config.TERMS_VERSION } })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/onboarding/handle", { json: { handle, displayName: `User ${handle}` } })).status).toBe(200);
    const id = (await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from profiles where handle = ${handle}`))[0]!.id;
    profileIds.push(id);
    return { b, id, handle };
  }

  /** A live staff account with a profile and one key enrolled through the flow, signed in from the console's browser. */
  async function staffBrowser(role: "moderator" | "admin") {
    const { user } = await newStaffAccount(authDb, repo, role);
    await apiDb.insert(profiles).values({ id: user.id, handle: `s_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`, displayName: "Staff" });
    staffIds.push(user.id);
    const soft = new SoftAuthenticator();
    const link = await issueEnrolment(migrateDb, user.id);
    const enrolled = await enrolKey({ deps: auth.deps, ctx: { ipHash: randomToken(), userAgent: undefined } }, soft, link.token);
    let counter = 0;
    const assert = (challenge: string) => soft.get({ credentialId: enrolled.credentialId, rpId: TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, challenge, origin: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, flags: DEVICE_BOUND, counter: ++counter });
    const b = consoleBrowser();
    const options = await b.fetch("/api/staff/signin/options", { method: "POST" });
    expect(options.status, await options.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    const { challenge } = ((await options.json()) as { options: { challenge: string } }).options;
    const signedIn = await b.fetch("/api/staff/signin/verify", { json: { response: assert(challenge) } });
    expect(signedIn.status, await signedIn.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    return { id: user.id, keyId: enrolled.key.id, role, b, assert };
  }
  type Staff = typeof moderator;

  /** The key's confirmation of exactly this action, asked for as the console asks for it. */
  async function confirmation(s: Staff, request: { action: "case_decided"; target: { type: "case"; id: string }; params: CaseDecidedParams } | { action: "appeals_reviewed"; target: { type: "decision"; id: string }; params: AppealsReviewedParams }): Promise<AuthenticationResponseJSON> {
    const res = await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/step-up/options", { json: request, headers: MARKED });
    expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    return s.assert(StaffStepUpOptionsResponse.parse(await res.json()).options.challenge);
  }
  /** A confirmed decision on the case over HTTP; answers the decision's id. */
  async function decide(s: Staff, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput): Promise<string> {
    const params = await decisionParams(apiDb, s, caseId, input);
    const res = await s.b.fetch(`/api/staff/cases/${caseId}/decisions`, { json: { ...params, stepUp: await confirmation(s, { action: "case_decided", target: { type: "case", id: caseId }, params }) }, headers: MARKED });
    const view = await parsed(res, 201, CaseView);
    await settle();
    return view.decisions.at(-1)!.id;
  }
  const postReview = (s: Staff, decisionId: string, body: unknown) => s.b.fetch(`/api/staff/decisions/${decisionId}/review`, { json: body, headers: MARKED });
  /** The whole exchange of a review: the params as the console builds them, the confirmation, and the request. */
  async function review(s: Staff, decisionId: string, input: ReviewInput = {}) {
    const params = await reviewParams(apiDb, s, decisionId, input);
    return postReview(s, decisionId, { ...params, stepUp: await confirmation(s, { action: "appeals_reviewed", target: { type: "decision", id: decisionId }, params }) });
  }

  /** A post of a signed-up author, reported under a rule by a signed-up reporter over HTTP, with its case and the report's item. */
  async function reported() {
    const [author, reporter] = [await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const postId = await newPostRow(apiDb, author.id);
    const res = await reporter.b.fetch("/api/notices", { json: { ground: "rule", ruleId: "R1", targets: [postTarget(postId)] } });
    const { ref } = await parsed(res, 201, NoticeResponse);
    await settle();
    const [item] = await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string; case_id: string }>(sql`select i.id, i.case_id from intake_items i join intakes n on n.id = i.intake_id where n.ref = ${ref}`);
    return { author, reporter, postId, ref, itemId: item!.id, caseId: item!.case_id };
  }
  /** The daily release, without the job: every answered item is released as of now. */
  async function release() {
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update decisions set decided_at = decided_at - interval '1 hour' where decided_at > now() - interval '1 hour'`);
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`select public.release_outcomes(now())`);
  }

  test("the new routes answer a POST only, and the console's list a GET only", async () => {
    const id = randomUUID();
    for (const path of [`/api/moderation/decisions/${id}/appeal`, `/api/moderation/items/${id}/reexamine`, "/api/notices/reexamine"]) {
      expect(await refused(await app.request(`http://localhost${path}`)), path).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    }
    expect(await refused(await moderator.b.fetch(`/api/staff/decisions/${id}/review`)), "review").toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    expect(await refused(await moderator.b.fetch("/api/staff/appeals", { method: "POST", headers: MARKED })), "appeals").toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
  });

  test("the author's appeal: a session with its CSRF token, a well-formed request, the author's own final restriction, and once", async () => {
    const r = await reported();
    const removal = await decide(moderator, r.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
    const path = `/api/moderation/decisions/${removal}/appeal`;

    expect(await refused(await appBrowser().fetch(path, { json: {} }))).toEqual([401, "unauthenticated"]);
    expect((await r.author.b.fetch(path, { json: {}, csrf: false })).status).toBe(403);
    expect(await refused(await r.author.b.fetch("/api/moderation/decisions/not-a-uuid/appeal", { json: {} }))).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
    // A member the request does not know, an empty statement and one past 2000 characters are refused, never changed.
    for (const body of [{ statement: "x", why: "y" }, { statement: "   " }, { statement: "x".repeat(2001) }]) expect(await refused(await r.author.b.fetch(path, { json: body })), JSON.stringify(body).slice(0, 40)).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
    // Someone else's decision and an id that names none get one answer.
    expect(await refused(await r.reporter.b.fetch(path, { json: {} }))).toEqual([422, "appeal_not_open"]);
    expect(await refused(await r.author.b.fetch(`/api/moderation/decisions/${randomUUID()}/appeal`, { json: {} }))).toEqual([422, "appeal_not_open"]);

    const res = await r.author.b.fetch(path, { json: { statement: "x".repeat(2000) } });
    expect(res.headers.get("cache-control")).toBe("no-store");
    const view = await parsed(res, 201, DecisionView);
    expect(view).toMatchObject({ id: removal, appealUntil: null, appeal: { state: "pending", needsAdmin: false } });
    // The decision's own route answers the same.
    expect(await parsed(await r.author.b.fetch(`/api/moderation/decisions/${removal}`), 200, DecisionView)).toEqual(view);
    expect(await refused(await r.author.b.fetch(path, { json: {} }))).toEqual([409, "appeal_exists"]);

    // Five appeals a day: the reporter has used one, and the sixth is told when to come back.
    for (let n = 2; n <= 5; n++) expect(await refused(await r.reporter.b.fetch(path, { json: {} })), String(n)).toEqual([422, "appeal_not_open"]);
    const sixth = await r.reporter.b.fetch(path, { json: {} });
    expect(Number(sixth.headers.get("retry-after"))).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(await refused(sixth)).toEqual([429, "rate_limited"]);
  });

  test("the console's list of appeals and the review: a staff session, the key's confirmation of exactly this review, and the database's refusals by their codes", async () => {
    const r = await reported();
    const removal = await decide(moderator, r.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
    await parsed(await r.author.b.fetch(`/api/moderation/decisions/${removal}/appeal`, { json: { statement: "Please look again." } }), 201, DecisionView);

    // The list: behind the staff gate and the staff session, and without the appellant's statement.
    expect(await refused(await consoleBrowser().fetch("/api/staff/appeals", { headers: MARKED }))).toEqual([401, "staff_session_required"]);
    expect(await refused(await second.b.fetch("/api/staff/appeals?cursor=%21", { headers: MARKED }))).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
    const listed = await second.b.fetch("/api/staff/appeals", { headers: MARKED });
    expect(listed.headers.get("cache-control")).toBe("no-store");
    const page = await parsed(listed, 200, AppealsPage);
    const row = page.appeals.find((appeal) => appeal.decisionId === removal)!;
    expect(row).toMatchObject({ caseId: r.caseId, ruleId: "R1", actions: ["remove"], reviewer: "available", needsAdmin: false, mayReview: true });
    expect(JSON.stringify(page)).not.toContain("Please look again");
    expect((await parsed(await moderator.b.fetch("/api/staff/appeals", { headers: MARKED }), 200, AppealsPage)).appeals.find((appeal) => appeal.id === row.id)!.mayReview).toBe(false);
    // The home screen counts them, with the person's own number.
    const home = await parsed(await second.b.fetch("/api/staff/overview"), 200, StaffOverview);
    expect(home.appealsWaiting).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(home.appealsYouMayReview).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    // The case answer carries the statement and the same marks.
    const view = await parsed(await second.b.fetch(`/api/staff/cases/${r.caseId}`, { headers: MARKED }), 200, CaseView);
    expect(view.appeals).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ id: row.id, statement: "Please look again.", reviewer: "available", needsAdmin: false, mayReview: true })]);

    // The review needs a staff session and the key's confirmation of exactly this review of exactly this decision.
    const params = await reviewParams(apiDb, second, removal);
    const stepUp = await confirmation(second, { action: "appeals_reviewed", target: { type: "decision", id: removal }, params });
    expect(await refused(await postReview({ ...second, b: consoleBrowser() }, removal, { ...params, stepUp }))).toEqual([401, "staff_session_required"]);
    expect(await refused(await postReview(second, removal, params))).toEqual([403, "staff_step_up_required"]);
    const others = await reviewParams(apiDb, second, removal);
    expect(await refused(await postReview(second, removal, { ...others, stepUp: await confirmation(second, { action: "appeals_reviewed", target: { type: "decision", id: removal }, params }) }))).toEqual([403, "staff_step_up_invalid"]);
    expect(await refused(await postReview(second, randomUUID(), { ...params, stepUp: await confirmation(second, { action: "appeals_reviewed", target: { type: "decision", id: removal }, params }) }))).toEqual([403, "staff_step_up_invalid"]);
    // A review that restricts is no review: the params' schema refuses it before any key is asked.
    expect((await second.b.fetch("/api/staff/step-up/options", { json: { action: "appeals_reviewed", target: { type: "decision", id: removal }, params: { ...params, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }] } }, headers: MARKED })).status).toBe(400);

    // What the database and the module refuse: the decider, a decision that does not exist, the redress texts of another version.
    expect(await refused(await review(moderator, removal))).toEqual([403, "reviewer_conflict"]);
    const missing = randomUUID();
    const forMissing = { ...params };
    expect(await refused(await postReview(second, missing, { ...forMissing, stepUp: await confirmation(second, { action: "appeals_reviewed", target: { type: "decision", id: missing }, params: forMissing }) }))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    expect(await refused(await review(second, removal, { redressVersion: 99 }))).toEqual([422, "invalid_decision"]);
    expect(await refused(await review(second, removal, { appealId: randomUUID() }))).toEqual([409, "case_changed"]);

    // A confirmed review is answered 201 with the case as it now stands.
    const res = await review(second, removal, { outcome: "reversed", actions: [act("restore")] });
    expect(res.headers.get("cache-control")).toBe("no-store");
    const after = await parsed(res, 201, CaseView);
    await settle();
    expect(after).toMatchObject({ id: r.caseId, target: { type: "post", id: r.postId, state: "visible", level: "visible" } });
    const reviewRow = after.decisions.at(-1)!;
    expect(reviewRow).toMatchObject({ kind: "review", outcome: "reversed", reviewsDecisionId: removal, needsAdmin: false, actions: [{ kind: "restore" }] });
    expect(after.appeals).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ id: row.id, result: "reversed", answeredBy: reviewRow.id, reviewer: null, mayReview: false })]);
    // The appeal is answered: another review finds none pending, and the list no longer holds it.
    expect(await refused(await review(admin, removal))).toEqual([409, "case_changed"]);
    expect((await parsed(await second.b.fetch("/api/staff/appeals", { headers: MARKED }), 200, AppealsPage)).appeals.find((appeal) => appeal.id === row.id)).toBeUndefined();
    // The author reads the answer on the decision's screen.
    expect(await parsed(await r.author.b.fetch(`/api/moderation/decisions/${removal}`), 200, DecisionView)).toMatchObject({ appeal: { state: "answered", result: "reversed", answeredBy: reviewRow.id, statement: { kind: "review", outcome: "reversed" } } });
  });

  test("a review of a decision under R5 is a moderator's, and one that only an admin may make is refused to a moderator", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const postId = await newPostRow(apiDb, author.id);
    // A notice on the path for child sexual abuse material, answered by the admin with a removal under R2.
    const notice = await parsed(await appBrowser().fetch("/api/notices", { json: notices.csam([postTarget(postId)]) }), 201, NoticeResponse);
    await settle();
    const [item] = await migrateDb.execute<{ case_id: string }>(sql`select i.case_id from intake_items i join intakes n on n.id = i.intake_id where n.ref = ${notice.ref}`);
    const removal = await decide(admin, item!.case_id, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("remove")] });
    const filed = await parsed(await author.b.fetch(`/api/moderation/decisions/${removal}/appeal`, { json: {} }), 201, DecisionView);
    expect(filed.appeal).toMatchObject({ state: "pending", needsAdmin: true });
    expect((await parsed(await second.b.fetch("/api/staff/appeals", { headers: MARKED }), 200, AppealsPage)).appeals.find((appeal) => appeal.decisionId === removal)).toMatchObject({ needsAdmin: true, mayReview: false });
    expect(await refused(await review(second, removal))).toEqual([403, "admin_required"]);
    expect(await refused(await review(admin, removal))).toEqual([403, "reviewer_conflict"]);
  });

  test("re-examination over HTTP: the signed-in reporter by the item's id from their list, and a notifier with the notice's token", async () => {
    const r = await reported();
    await decide(moderator, r.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
    const own = `/api/moderation/items/${r.itemId}/reexamine`;
    // Nothing can be asked before the outcome is released.
    expect(await refused(await r.reporter.b.fetch(own, { json: {} }))).toEqual([422, "reexamination_not_open"]);
    await release();
    // The reporter's list names the item by its id; the status page never does.
    const list = await parsed(await r.reporter.b.fetch("/api/moderation/reports"), 200, ReportsPage);
    expect(list.reports[0]!.items).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ id: r.itemId, outcome: "no_violation", reexamination: { open: true, until: expect.any(String) } })]);

    expect(await refused(await appBrowser().fetch(own, { json: {} }))).toEqual([401, "unauthenticated"]);
    expect((await r.reporter.b.fetch(own, { json: {}, csrf: false })).status).toBe(403);
    expect(await refused(await r.reporter.b.fetch("/api/moderation/items/not-a-uuid/reexamine", { json: {} }))).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
    expect(await refused(await r.reporter.b.fetch(own, { json: { statement: "x", position: 1 } }))).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
    expect(await refused(await r.author.b.fetch(own, { json: {} }))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    const res = await r.reporter.b.fetch(own, { json: { statement: "Read the second line." } });
    expect(res.headers.get("cache-control")).toBe("no-store");
    expect(await parsed(res, 201, ReexamineResponse)).toEqual({ positions: [1] });
    await settle();
    expect(await refused(await r.reporter.b.fetch(own, { json: {} }))).toEqual([409, "reexamination_exists"]);

    // A notifier without an account: the notice's reference, its token and the item's position.
    const author = await signUp();
    const postId = await newPostRow(apiDb, author.id);
    const notice = await parsed(await appBrowser().fetch("/api/notices", { json: notices.rule([postTarget(postId)]) }), 201, NoticeResponse);
    await settle();
    const [item] = await migrateDb.execute<{ case_id: string }>(sql`select i.case_id from intake_items i join intakes n on n.id = i.intake_id where n.ref = ${notice.ref}`);
    await decide(second, item!.case_id, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
    await release();
    const ask = (body: unknown, b = appBrowser()) => b.fetch("/api/notices/reexamine", { json: body });
    const request = { ref: notice.ref, token: notice.token, position: 1 };
    for (const body of [{ ...request, position: 0 }, { ...request, position: 21 }, { ...request, extra: true }, { ref: notice.ref, position: 1 }]) expect(await refused(await ask(body)), JSON.stringify(body).slice(0, 60)).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
    expect(await refused(await ask({ ...request, token: randomToken() }))).toEqual([404, "notice_not_found"]);
    expect(await refused(await ask({ ...request, ref: "N-AAAAAAAAAA" }))).toEqual([404, "notice_not_found"]);
    // Another site's page cannot ask in someone's name.
    expect((await new Browser(app, "https://evil.example").fetch("/api/notices/reexamine", { json: request })).status).toBe(403);
    expect(await parsed(await ask({ ...request, statement: "It is the image, not the text." }), 201, ReexamineResponse)).toEqual({ positions: [1] });
    await settle();
    // The newest item at that position is the request itself, which waits for its answer.
    expect(await refused(await ask(request))).toEqual([422, "reexamination_not_open"]);
    // Five a day from one network: the sixth is told when to come back.
    const one = appBrowser();
    for (let n = 1; n <= 5; n++) expect(await refused(await ask(request, one)), String(n)).toEqual([422, "reexamination_not_open"]);
    const sixth = await ask(request, one);
    expect(Number(sixth.headers.get("retry-after"))).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(await refused(sixth)).toEqual([429, "rate_limited"]);
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the moderation tables and the four auth tables of moderation cases hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await settle();
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, profileIds);
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from profiles where id = any(${uuids(staffIds)})`);
    expect(await counts()).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

import { MemoryJobLock, type JobLock } from "../../src/lib/jobs";
import { renderMail } from "../../src/mail/templates";
import { appealsList, fileAppeal } from "../../src/moderation/appeals";
import { authorCases, authorDecisionView } from "../../src/moderation/author";
import { overview, readCase } from "../../src/moderation/cases";
import { ModerationError } from "../../src/moderation/context";
import { dispatchRound } from "../../src/moderation/dispatch";
import { noticeStatus, recordIntake, submitNotice } from "../../src/moderation/intake";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import {
  aPost,
  act,
  appealOf,
  authCaseCounts,
  decisionParams,
  gate,
  ground,
  imageStates,
  inForce,
  moderationCounts,
  newImageRow,
  newPostRow,
  postRow,
  refusal,
  untilBlocked,
  type DecisionInput,
  type ReviewInput,
} from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { noticesWorld, notices, postTarget, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";
import { withLockTimeout } from "./staff-fixtures";

// Every test signs several decisions with real staff keys, and some run a dispatch round: more than a test gets by default.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 180_000 });

const MIN = 60_000;
const HOUR = 60 * MIN;

/**
 * Appeals and reviews as flows (3c design, sections 7.7 and 12), against the real database, the real auth module and a
 * scripted mailer: the author appeals, a different person reviews with a real staff key, and at each step what the
 * author reads and is mailed, what the console lists, what every staff account is mailed, and what whoever reported
 * reads after the daily release. Then the races the database settles: an appeal against a correction that reverses
 * everything, two appeals at once, and a report into an open case while an appeal is being filed. The file's last test
 * holds it to leaving no row behind.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: appeals and reviews, from the author's appeal to the review's answer", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let d: DeciderWorld;
  /** Two moderators and two admins: whoever decides, someone else of the needed role is left to review. */
  let mod: RealStaff;
  let mod2: RealStaff;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let admin2: RealStaff;
  let lock: JobLock;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  /** How far the dispatch job's clock stands ahead of the real one. */
  let aheadMs = 0;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    w.deps.now = () => new Date(Date.now() + aheadMs);
    lock = new MemoryJobLock(() => Date.now() + aheadMs);
    d = deciderWorld(w.apiDb, { auth: w.authForModeration, rateLimitStore: w.deps.limits });
    before = await counts();
    mod = await d.staff("moderator");
    mod2 = await d.staff("moderator");
    admin = await d.staff("admin");
    admin2 = await d.staff("admin");
  }, 180_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await w.close();
  });

  const counts = async (): Promise<Record<string, number>> => ({ ...(await moderationCounts(w.apiDb)), ...(await authCaseCounts(w.migrateDb)) });
  /** The next daily release: the dispatch hour is moved to the next full hour at least twenty minutes on, the clock to a minute past it, and a round runs. */
  async function released() {
    const next = (Math.floor((Date.now() + aheadMs + 20 * MIN) / HOUR) + 1) * HOUR;
    w.deps.config = { ...w.deps.config, MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR: new Date(next).getUTCHours() };
    aheadMs += next + MIN - (Date.now() + aheadMs);
    w.ahead.limitsMs = aheadMs;
    expect(await dispatchRound(w.deps, lock)).toMatchObject({ marked: true, daily: true });
  }
  const decided = async (staff: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput) => {
    const outcome = await d.decideAs(staff, caseId, input);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the decision was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome.decisionId;
  };
  const reviewed = async (staff: RealStaff, decisionId: string, input: ReviewInput = {}) => {
    const outcome = await d.reviewAs(staff, decisionId, input);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the review was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome.decisionId;
  };
  const settled = <T>(promise: Promise<T>) => promise.then((value) => value as unknown, (err: unknown) => err);
  /** The statements mailed to this address, in order: each mail's subject key and its paragraphs. */
  const statements = (address: string) => w.mailer.to(address, "moderation_decision").map((mail) => ({ subject: mail.data.subject, paragraphs: mail.data.statement!.split("\n") }));
  /** The mails that told this staff account of a decision that lifted the protection of reported images. */
  const lifted = async (staff: RealStaff) => w.mailer.to((await w.repo.findUserById(staff.id))!.email, "moderation_csam_lifted").map((mail) => mail.data);
  const appealsOf = async (decisionId: string) =>
    (await w.migrateDb.execute<{ id: string; result: string | null; answered_by: string | null }>(sql`select id, result, answered_by from appeals where decision_id = ${decisionId}::uuid`)).map((row) => ({ ...row }));

  /** A post of a new account with this many images, reported under a rule by another new account, and its open case. */
  async function reportedPost(images = 0) {
    const [author, reporter] = [await w.account(), await w.account()];
    const postId = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const mediaIds: string[] = [];
    for (let position = 0; position < images; position++) mediaIds.push(await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, postId, position));
    const caseId = (await recordIntake(w.deps, { ground: ground.rule(reporter.id), live: [aPost(postId)] })).items[0]!.caseId!;
    return { author, reporter, postId, mediaIds, caseId };
  }
  /** The same, removed by the first moderator's final decision. */
  async function removedPost(images = 0) {
    const r = await reportedPost(images);
    return { ...r, decisionId: await decided(mod, r.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] }) };
  }

  test("the author appeals a removal once: it waits for a reviewer at once on their screen and in the console's list, which carries no statement; a second appeal, someone else's and the sixth of a day are refused", async () => {
    const r = await removedPost();
    const until = (await authorDecisionView(w.deps, r.author.id, r.decisionId)).appealUntil;
    expect(until).not.toBeNull();

    const view = await fileAppeal(w.deps, r.author.id, r.decisionId, { statement: "The post quotes a film. Please look again." });
    // The answer is the decision as its author now reads it: no further appeal, and this one waiting for someone who may review it.
    expect(DecisionView.parse(view)).toEqual(view);
    expect(view).toMatchObject({ id: r.decisionId, appealUntil: null, appeal: { state: "pending", reviewer: "available", needsAdmin: false } });
    expect((await authorCases(w.deps, r.author.id)).decisions).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ id: r.decisionId, appealUntil: null, appeal: "pending" })]);

    // One appeal for each decision; the reporter, a stranger and an id that names nothing get one answer.
    expect(await refusal(fileAppeal(w.deps, r.author.id, r.decisionId, {}))).toBe("appeal_exists");
    expect(await refusal(fileAppeal(w.deps, r.reporter.id, r.decisionId, {}))).toBe("appeal_not_open");
    expect(await refusal(fileAppeal(w.deps, r.reporter.id, randomUUID(), {}))).toBe("appeal_not_open");
    expect(await appealsOf(r.decisionId)).toEqual([{ id: expect.any(String), result: null, answered_by: null }]);
    // Five appeals a day for one account, whatever became of each: the reporter has used two.
    for (let n = 3; n <= DAILY_LIMITS.appeals; n++) expect(await refusal(fileAppeal(w.deps, r.reporter.id, randomUUID(), {})), String(n)).toBe("appeal_not_open");
    const sixth = await settled(fileAppeal(w.deps, r.reporter.id, randomUUID(), {}));
    expect(sixth).toBeInstanceOf(ModerationError);
    expect(sixth).toMatchObject({ code: "rate_limited", status: 429 });

    // The console: the appeal waits, the moderator who removed the post may not review it, anyone else may.
    const rowFor = async (staff: RealStaff) => (await appealsList(w.deps, staff.session)).appeals.find((row) => row.decisionId === r.decisionId);
    expect(await rowFor(mod2)).toMatchObject({ caseId: r.caseId, ruleId: "R1", legal: false, actions: ["remove"], deadline: until, reviewer: "available", needsAdmin: false, mayReview: true });
    expect((await rowFor(mod))!.mayReview).toBe(false);
    expect(JSON.stringify(await appealsList(w.deps, mod2.session))).not.toContain("film");
    expect(await overview(w.deps, mod2.session)).toMatchObject({ appealsWaiting: waiting + 1 });
    expect((await overview(w.deps, mod2.session)).appealsYouMayReview).toBe((await overview(w.deps, mod.session)).appealsYouMayReview + 1);
    // The reviewer reads the statement on the case page.

    expect((await readCase(w.deps, mod.session, r.caseId)).appeals[0]).toMatchObject({ mayReview: false });
  });

  test("a kept review by a second moderator: the first is refused, the author is mailed the review's statement and reads it on the decision's screen, and the post's chip still names the removal", async () => {
    const r = await removedPost();

    const [audit] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ action: string; target_type: string; target_id: string; actor_id: string }>(sql`select action, target_type, target_id, actor_id from audit_log where metadata ->> 'decisionId' = ${review}`);

  test("a moderator lifts early what another withheld while deciding on a report of a threat: no admin is needed, the post is shown again and its author is told at once", async () => {

    await released();

    expect(await page()).toMatchObject({ outcome: "restricted_rule", changed: false });

    expect(await inForce(w.apiDb, { caseId })).toEqual([]);

    expect(await authorDecisionView(w.deps, author.id, removal)).toMatchObject({ reversedOn: expect.any(String), appeal: { state: "answered", result: "reversed", answeredBy: review } });

    expect(renderMail(updates.at(-1)!).text).toContain("A decision changed on review or by a correction, or given on re-examination, is final within korbat.");
  });

  test("an appeal of a seal for good waits for an admin: a moderator's review that lifts it is refused, a second admin's is recorded, the images are shown again, and every staff account is mailed at once", async () => {
    const author = await w.account();
    const postId = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const mediaIds = [await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, postId, 0), await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, postId, 1)];
    const notice = w.remember(await submitNotice(w.deps, notices.csam([postTarget(postId)]), w.sender()));
    await w.moderation.settle();
    const caseId = (await w.items(notice.ref))[0]!.case_id!;
    const seal = await decided(admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
    expect(await imageStates(w.apiDb, mediaIds)).toEqual(["sealed", "sealed"]);

    // The author's screen says that the review is an admin's; the console marks it so, and offers it to the other admin alone.
    const view = await fileAppeal(w.deps, author.id, seal, {});
    expect(view.appeal).toEqual({ state: "pending", filedAt: expect.any(String), reviewer: "available", needsAdmin: true });
    expect(view.measures.map((measure) => measure.kind)).toEqual(["seal_media"]);
    const rowFor = async (staff: RealStaff) => (await appealsList(w.deps, staff.session)).appeals.find((row) => row.decisionId === seal);
    expect(await rowFor(mod2)).toMatchObject({ needsAdmin: true, mayReview: false, actions: ["seal_media"] });
    expect(await rowFor(admin)).toMatchObject({ needsAdmin: true, mayReview: false });
    expect(await rowFor(admin2)).toMatchObject({ needsAdmin: true, mayReview: true });

    const lift: ReviewInput = { outcome: "reversed", actions: [act("unseal_media")] };
    const toldBefore = (await lifted(mod)).length;
    expect(await refusal(d.reviewAs(mod2, seal, lift))).toBe("admin_required");
    expect(await imageStates(w.apiDb, mediaIds)).toEqual(["sealed", "sealed"]);
    expect(await lifted(mod)).toHaveLength(toldBefore);

    const review = await reviewed(admin2, seal, lift);
    expect(await imageStates(w.apiDb, mediaIds)).toEqual(["visible", "visible"]);
    expect(await appealsOf(seal)).toEqual([{ id: expect.any(String), result: "reversed", answered_by: review }]);
    // What follows the review's commit: its statement to the author, and the mail to every staff account, the reviewer's own included.
    expect(statements(author.email).map((mail) => mail.subject)).toEqual(["seal_final", "reversed"]);
    expect(statements(author.email)[1]!.paragraphs).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.unsealed);
    for (const staff of [mod, mod2, admin, admin2]) {
      expect((await lifted(staff)).at(-1), staff.handle).toMatchObject({ handle: admin2.handle, what: "unsealed" });
      expect(await lifted(staff), staff.handle).toHaveLength(toldBefore + 1);
    }
    expect((await overview(w.deps, mod.session)).protectionLifted.items.filter((item) => item.caseId === caseId)).toEqual([{ at: expect.any(String), handle: admin2.handle, caseId, kind: "unsealed" }]);
  });

  describe("an appeal against a correction that reverses everything, in either order", () => {
    test("the correction is being recorded when the appeal arrives: the appeal waits for it and is refused, since nothing is left to appeal", async () => {
      const r = await removedPost();
      const confirmed = await d.confirm(admin, r.caseId, await decisionParams(w.apiDb, admin, r.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: r.decisionId, actions: [act("restore")] }));
      const [held, release] = [gate(), gate()];
      // While the audit chain's head is held, the correction stops at its audit row, its last statement, holding its case.
      const holder = withLockTimeout(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from public.audit_head where id = 1 for update`);
        held.open();
        await release.opened;
      });
      await held.opened;
      let correcting: Promise<unknown>;
      let appealing: Promise<unknown>;
      try {
        correcting = settled(d.moderation.forStaff.decide(admin.session, confirmed, { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` }));
        await untilBlocked(w.apiDb, "append_confirmed_audit");
        appealing = settled(fileAppeal(w.deps, r.author.id, r.decisionId, {}));
        await untilBlocked(w.apiDb, "insert into appeals");
      } finally {
        release.open();
        await holder;
      }
      expect(await correcting).toEqual({ decisionId: expect.any(String) });
      const refused = await appealing;
      expect(refused).toBeInstanceOf(ModerationError);
      expect(refused).toMatchObject({ code: "appeal_not_open" });
      await d.moderation.settle();
      expect(await appealsOf(r.decisionId)).toEqual([]);
      expect(await postRow(w.apiDb, r.postId)).toMatchObject({ level: "visible" });
    });

    test("the appeal is being filed when the correction arrives: the correction waits for it and answers it as reversed", async () => {
      const r = await removedPost();
      const confirmed = await d.confirm(admin, r.caseId, await decisionParams(w.apiDb, admin, r.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: r.decisionId, actions: [act("restore")] }));
      const [held, release] = [gate(), gate()];
      // The appeal's row is inserted and its transaction stays open: its trigger holds the case's row.
      const appealing = withLockTimeout(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
        const id = await appealOf(tx, r.decisionId, r.author.id);
        held.open();
        await release.opened;
        return id;
      });
      await held.opened;
      let correcting: Promise<unknown>;
      try {
        correcting = settled(d.moderation.forStaff.decide(admin.session, confirmed, { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` }));
        await untilBlocked(w.apiDb, "insert into decisions");
      } finally {
        release.open();
      }
      const appeal = await appealing;
      const corrected = (await correcting) as { decisionId: string };
      expect(corrected).toEqual({ decisionId: expect.any(String) });
      await d.moderation.settle();
      expect(await appealsOf(r.decisionId)).toEqual([{ id: appeal, result: "reversed", answered_by: corrected.decisionId }]);
      // The author reads the correction as the answer to their appeal.
      expect((await authorDecisionView(w.deps, r.author.id, r.decisionId)).appeal).toMatchObject({ state: "answered", result: "reversed", answeredBy: corrected.decisionId, statement: { kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed" } });
    });
  });

  test("two appeals of one decision at the same moment: exactly one is stored, and the other is told that an appeal exists", async () => {
    const r = await removedPost();
    const both = await Promise.all([settled(fileAppeal(w.deps, r.author.id, r.decisionId, {})), settled(fileAppeal(w.deps, r.author.id, r.decisionId, {}))]);
    const refusedOnes = both.filter((answer) => answer instanceof ModerationError);
    expect(refusedOnes).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(refusedOnes[0]).toMatchObject({ code: "appeal_exists", status: 409 });
    expect(await appealsOf(r.decisionId)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("a report into a case that is still open does not wait for an appeal that is being filed", async () => {
    // Two reports, of which the final removal answers the first: the case stays open with the second.
    const r = await reportedPost();
    await recordIntake(w.deps, { ground: ground.rule((await w.account()).id), live: [aPost(r.postId)] });
    const removal = await decided(mod, r.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")], throughSeq: 1 });
    const [open] = await w.apiDb.execute<{ open: boolean }>(sql`select closed_at is null as open from cases where id = ${r.caseId}::uuid`);
    expect(open!.open).toBe(true);

    const [held, release] = [gate(), gate()];
    const appealing = withLockTimeout(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      await appealOf(tx, removal, r.author.id);
      held.open();
      await release.opened;
    });
    await held.opened;
    try {
      // The appeal's transaction is open and holds the case's row for its key only: a third report attaches at once.
      const third = await recordIntake(w.deps, { ground: ground.rule((await w.account()).id), live: [aPost(r.postId)] });
      expect(third.items[0]).toMatchObject({ caseId: r.caseId, seq: 3 });
    } finally {
      release.open();
      await appealing;
    }
    expect(await appealsOf(removal)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the moderation tables and the four auth tables of moderation cases hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await w.cleanUp();
    await d.close();
    expect(await counts()).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```
