```tsx
    expect(out).not.toContain("Cases arrive in sub-project 3c.");
    expect(out).toContain("Urgent: no open case");
    expect(out.indexOf("Urgent: no open case")).toBeLessThan(out.indexOf("Staff sign-ins in the last 7 days"));
  });

  test("Sign out that session on the other sessions, never on this one", () => {
    const out = html(<HomeView {...props} />);
    expect(out.match(/>Sign out that session</g)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(out).toContain("This session");
  });

  test("a revocation under way, its outcome, and a refusal in the console's words", () => {
    expect(html(<HomeView {...props} revoking={OTHER_SESSION} />)).toMatch(/aria-busy="true"/);
    expect(html(<HomeView {...props} notice="That session is signed out." />)).toContain("That session is signed out.");
    expect(html(<HomeView {...props} error="That confirmation was for another action." />)).toMatch(/role="alert"[^>]*>That confirmation was for another action\./);
  });

  test("no sign-ins, and lists still loading or failed", () => {
    const out = html(<HomeView {...props} signIns={{ state: "ready", value: [] }} sessions={{ state: "loading" }} keys={{ state: "failed", message: "Cannot reach the server." }} />);
    expect(out).toContain("No staff sign-ins in the last 7 days.");
    expect(out).toContain("Loading");
    expect(out).toContain("Cannot reach the server.");
  });

  test("opened 11 hours after the page read its session, it lists sign-ins back to 7 days before its own opening", async () => {
    // The page read its session at 09:00 and its person kept acting, so the idle timer never read /me again: the session
    // the page holds still says 09:00 when Home opens at 20:00.
    const pageOpened = Date.parse("2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z");
    const homeOpened = Date.parse("2026-10-01T20:00:00.000Z");
    const at = (createdAt: string, seq: number): AuditEntry => ({ ...signIn("mod_anna", seq), createdAt });
    const fake = fakeFetch({
      "GET /api/staff/me": [{ status: 200, body: makeMe({ at: pageOpened }) }, { status: 200, body: makeMe({ at: homeOpened, absolute: 3600 }) }],
      "GET /api/staff/audit?action=staff_sign_in": {
        status: 200,
        body: {
          entries: [
            at("2026-10-01T19:00:00.000Z", 40),
            at("2026-09-24T20:30:00.000Z", 39),
            // Older than 7 days at 20:00, though not at the page's stale 09:00: the list ends before it.
            at("2026-09-24T19:30:00.000Z", 38),
            at("2026-09-24T09:30:00.000Z", 37),
          ],
          nextCursor: 37,
        },
      },
      "GET /api/staff/sessions": { status: 200, body: { sessions: [] } },
      "GET /api/staff/keys": { status: 200, body: { keys: [] } },
      "GET /api/staff/overview": { status: 200, body: QUIET },
    });
    const api = createStaffApi({ fetch: fake.fetch, cookie: () => "" });
    const store = createConsoleStore({ api, clock: new FakeClock(), path: "/", history: { pushState: noop, replaceState: noop } });
    await store.start();
    const held = store.get().session;
    if (held.kind !== "signed-in") throw new Error("the page holds no session");
    expect(serverNow(held.me)).toBe(pageOpened);

    // What the screen runs when it opens, with the session the page holds as its `me`.
    let signIns: Loadable<AuditEntry[]> = { state: "loading" };
    openHome(api, { current: true }, { overview: noop, signIns: (value) => (signIns = value), sessions: noop, keys: noop });
    await settle();
    expect(signIns).toMatchObject({ state: "ready" });
    const out = html(<HomeView {...props} me={held.me} signIns={signIns} />);
    expect(out).toContain("2026-10-01 19:00");
    expect(out).toContain("2026-09-24 20:30");
    expect(out).not.toContain("2026-09-24 19:30");
    expect(out).not.toContain("2026-09-24 09:30");
    // The screen's own /me, marked as its person's opening of it, came before the first page of sign-ins.
    const asked = fake.requests.map((r) => `${r.url} ${r.headers["x-staff-activity"]}`);
    expect(asked.filter((r) => r.startsWith("/api/staff/me"))).toEqual(["/api/staff/me 1", "/api/staff/me 1"]);
    expect(asked.indexOf("/api/staff/audit?action=staff_sign_in 1")).toBeGreaterThan(asked.lastIndexOf("/api/staff/me 1"));
    store.dispose();
  });
});

});
```

### Replace `apps/admin/test/source.test.ts` (whole file)

```ts
import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { z } from "zod";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";

/**
 * What the console's source must never hold (3a design, sections 3 and 9, and console-lab.md section 8). The page runs
 * under require-trusted-types-for 'script' with trusted-types 'none', so each of these sinks would throw at run time and
 * take its screen down; this scan finds them first. Every user-written string is a text node, and no link is built from
 * data.
 */
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..");
const SRC = path.join(ROOT, "src");

/**
 * Every line of the page's source (src/, which the bundle is built from) matching `pattern`, as `file:line`. The build
 * and development scripts run in Node, never in the page, so they are not scanned: the page they write needs its one
 * script element.
 */
function findInSource(pattern: RegExp): string[] {
  const found: string[] = [];
  const files = readdirSync(SRC, { recursive: true, encoding: "utf8" }).map((file) => path.join("src", file));
  for (const file of files) {
    if (!/\.(ts|tsx|css)$/.test(file)) continue;
    const lines = readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, file), "utf8").split("\n");
    lines.forEach((line, index) => {
      if (pattern.test(line)) found.push(`${file.split(path.sep).join("/")}:${index + 1}`);
    });
  }
  return found.sort();
}

describe("no HTML or script sink in apps/admin", () => {
  const sinks: [string, RegExp][] = [
    ["dangerouslySetInnerHTML", /dangerouslySetInnerHTML/],
    ["innerHTML and outerHTML", /\b(inner|outer)HTML\b/],
    ["insertAdjacentHTML", /insertAdjacentHTML/],
    ["createContextualFragment", /createContextualFragment/],
    ["document.write", /document\.write/],
    ["srcdoc", /srcdoc/i],
    ["eval", /\beval\s*\(/],
    ["new Function", /new\s+Function\b|\bFunction\s*\(/],
    ["a string as a timer's code", /setTimeout\(\s*["'`]|setInterval\(\s*["'`]/],
    ["a rendered script or style element", /<script|<style|createElement\(\s*["'`](script|style)/i],
    ["React's preinit and preload", /\bpre(init|initModule|load|loadModule)\b/],
    ["a style attribute set as text", /setAttribute\(\s*["'`]style/],
    ["setAttribute at all: React sets every attribute", /\.setAttribute\(/],
    ["a Trusted Types policy", /trustedTypes|createPolicy/],
    ["DOMParser", /DOMParser/],
    ["window.open and navigations built in code", /window\.open|location\.(href|assign|replace)\s*[=(]/],
  ];
  for (const [name, pattern] of sinks) {
    test(name, () => {
      expect(findInSource(pattern)).toEqual([]);
    });
  }

  test("no style prop: every style is in the one CSS file", () => {
    expect(findInSource(/\bstyle=\{/)).toEqual([]);

describe("the key is asked only after the console checked what it is asked to sign", () => {
  test("a confirmation asks the key in one function, which every confirmed action goes through", () => {
    const stepUp = readFileSync(path.join(SRC, "step-up.ts"), "utf8");
    expect(stepUp.match(/credentials\.get\(/g)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(stepUp).toMatch(/export async function confirmWithKey</);
    // The revocation of a session, the reveal, the decision and the review are callers of it; none asks the key itself.
    expect(stepUp.match(/confirmWithKey\(deps, action,/g)).toHaveLength(4);
  });

  test("navigator.credentials is called only by the three ceremonies, each of which checks its challenge first", () => {
    // A fourth call site would need a check of its own (3a design, section 9): this list makes adding one a decision.
    expect(findInSource(/credentials\.(get|create)\(/).map((found) => found.split(":")[0])).toEqual(["src/enroll.ts", "src/sign-in.ts", "src/step-up.ts"]);
    const checks: [string, RegExp][] = [
      ["enroll.ts", /checkRegisterChallenge\(/],
      ["sign-in.ts", /checkSignInChallenge\(/],
      ["step-up.ts", /checkStepUpOptions\(/],
    ];
    for (const [file, check] of checks) {
      const source = readFileSync(path.join(SRC, file), "utf8");
      const call = source.search(/credentials\.(get|create)\(/);
      // The check is called in the function that makes the call, before it, as it runs before it. Only that function's
      // text up to the call is searched: a check declared in the same file (step-up.ts declares checkStepUpOptions) is
      // another top-level function, so its name there never stands in for the call.
      const declarations = [...source.matchAll(/^(export )?(async )?function \w+/gm)].map((found) => found.index ?? -1);
      const enclosing = Math.max(...declarations.filter((at) => at < call));
      expect(call, file).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
      expect(enclosing, file).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
      expect(source.slice(enclosing, call).search(check), file).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    }
  });
});
```

```ts
  itemOutcomeWords,
  mediaPath,
  type NoticeRequest,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import { getRule, statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import { createApp } from "../../src/app";
import { randomToken } from "../../src/auth/crypto";
import { createMediaRepo } from "../../src/media/repo";
import { updateLine } from "../../src/moderation/dispatch";
import { noticeStatus, submitNotice } from "../../src/moderation/intake";
import { pendingOutcomeLines, releaseOutcomes } from "../../src/moderation/repo";
import { createSocial } from "../../src/social";
import { Browser } from "./http-client";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { act, authCaseCounts, moderationCounts, newImageRow, newPostRow } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { HUMAN, accountTarget, noticesWorld, notices, postTarget, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";

// Every test signs accounts up over HTTP and signs decisions with a real staff key: more than a test gets by default.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 180_000 });

const HOUR = 60 * 60_000;
const DAY = /^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$/;

/**
 * The app's side of moderation cases through the real app (3c design, sections 7.6, 10, 11 and 12): the author's list of
 * decisions and one decision's view, the chip's facts on the author's own post, the reporter's list with its words, and
 * the stop and the resume of korbat's report mails. Every decision is confirmed with a real staff key, every report goes
 * through the intake, and outcomes are released by the database's own function, as the daily dispatch releases them.
 * Every raw answer is held strictly equal to its parsed form. Every test commits; the file's last test removes what was
 * stored and holds the tables to what they held before it.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the app's side of moderation cases", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let d: DeciderWorld;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let app: ReturnType<typeof createApp>;
  let origin: string;
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    origin = w.config.APP_ORIGIN;
    d = deciderWorld(w.apiDb, { auth: w.authForModeration, rateLimitStore: w.deps.limits });
    before = await counts();
    const logger = pino({ level: "silent" });
    const images = createMediaRepo(w.apiDb);
    // The social module as the server wires it for this task: the chip's facts come from the moderation module, and the
    // images from the media repository's one list for posts. Nothing here attaches or deletes an image.
    const social = createSocial({
      apiDb: w.apiDb,
      rateLimitStore: w.deps.limits,
      logger,
      requireSession: w.auth.requireSession,
      requireFreshAuth: w.auth.requireFreshAuth(),
      moderation: w.moderation.forSocial,
      media: { attach: async () => undefined, detachAll: async () => [], requestDeletion: async () => undefined, forPosts: (postIds) => images.forPosts(postIds) },
    });
    app = createApp({ config: w.config, logger, rateLimitStore: w.deps.limits, healthChecks: {}, auth: w.auth, social, moderation: w.moderation });
    moderator = await d.staff("moderator");
    admin = await d.staff("admin");
  }, 120_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await w.close();
  });
  beforeEach(() => {
    // Past every hourly window of the limit store and the urgent alert's throttle.
    w.ahead.limitsMs += HOUR;
  });

  const counts = async (): Promise<Record<string, number>> => ({ ...(await moderationCounts(w.apiDb)), ...(await authCaseCounts(w.migrateDb)) });
  const error = async (res: Response) => ErrorEnvelope.parse(await res.json()).error;
  const today = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  /** A browser signed in over HTTP as a new account; with `onboard` false the account has not chosen a handle yet. */
  async function signUp(onboard = true) {
    const b = new Browser(app, origin);
    const email = `author-${randomUUID()}@korbat.local`;
    const handle = `a${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`;
    const start = await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/start", { json: { email, turnstileToken: HUMAN, deviceId: randomToken(), platform: "web" } });
    expect(start.status, await start.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    const { flowId } = FlowResponse.parse(await start.json());
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/verify", { json: { flowId, code: w.mailer.lastCodeFor(email) } })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/signup/complete", { json: { flowId, dateOfBirth: "1990-05-17", termsVersion: w.config.TERMS_VERSION } })).status).toBe(200);
    let id = "";
    if (onboard) {
      expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/onboarding/handle", { json: { handle, displayName: `User ${handle}` } })).status).toBe(200);
      id = (await w.migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from profiles where handle = ${handle}`))[0]!.id;
      w.profileIds.push(id);
    }
    return { b, email, handle, id, session: { userId: id, role: "user" as const, onboarded: true } };
  }

  /** A decision that committed, by its id. */
  const decided = async (staff: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: Parameters<DeciderWorld["decideAs"]>[2]) => {
    const outcome = await d.decideAs(staff, caseId, input);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the decision was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome.decisionId;
  };
  /** A notice as its sender sent it, signed out unless a session is given, with its items and the case of its first one. */
  async function sent(request: NoticeRequest, session: Parameters<NoticesWorld["sender"]>[0] = null) {
    const answer = w.remember(await submitNotice(w.deps, request, w.sender(session)));
    await w.moderation.settle();
    const items = await w.items(answer.ref);
    return { ...answer, items, caseId: items[0]!.case_id! };
  }
  /** A report under a rule as a signed-in account sends it: no human check. */
  const report = (targets: NoticeRequest["targets"], extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => notices.rule(targets, { turnstileToken: undefined, ...extra });
  /** The daily release, by the database's one function for it: every item answered so far is shown its outcome. */
  const release = () => releaseOutcomes(w.apiDb, new Date());

  /** GET a JSON answer and hold the raw body strictly equal to its parsed form. */
  async function read<T>(b: Browser, path: string, schema: { parse(value: unknown): T }): Promise<T> {
    const res = await b.fetch(path);
    expect(res.status, `${path}: ${await res.clone().text()}`).toBe(200);
    expect(res.headers.get("cache-control"), path).toBe("no-store");
    const raw: unknown = await res.json();
    const parsed = schema.parse(raw);
    expect(raw, path).toStrictEqual(parsed);
    return parsed;
  }
  const casesOf = (b: Browser, cursor?: string) => read(b, `/api/moderation/cases${cursor ? `?cursor=${cursor}` : ""}`, AuthorCasesPage);
  const decisionOf = (b: Browser, id: string) => read(b, `/api/moderation/decisions/${id}`, DecisionView);
  const reportsOf = (b: Browser, cursor?: string) => read(b, `/api/moderation/reports${cursor ? `?cursor=${cursor}` : ""}`, ReportsPage);
  const postOf = (b: Browser, id: string) => read(b, `/api/posts/${id}`, PostView);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the routes

  test("the six signed-in routes are the module's whole surface under /api/moderation; each refuses a reader without a session and an account that has not chosen a handle", async () => {
    const routes = app.routes.filter((route) => route.path.startsWith("/api/moderation") && route.method !== "ALL").map((route) => `${route.method} ${route.path}`);
    expect([...new Set(routes)].sort()).toEqual([
      "GET /api/moderation/cases",
      "GET /api/moderation/decisions/:id",
      "GET /api/moderation/reports",
      "POST /api/moderation/decisions/:id/appeal",
      "POST /api/moderation/items/:item/reexamine",
      "POST /api/moderation/report-mail/resume",
    ]);
    // The session is asked for before anything of the request is read: the appeal and the re-examination refuse the
    // same way with no body at all.
    const paths: [string, string | undefined][] = [
      ["/api/moderation/cases", undefined],
      [`/api/moderation/decisions/${randomUUID()}`, undefined],
      ["/api/moderation/reports", undefined],
      ["/api/moderation/report-mail/resume", "POST"],
      [`/api/moderation/decisions/${randomUUID()}/appeal`, "POST"],
      [`/api/moderation/items/${randomUUID()}/reexamine`, "POST"],
    ];
    const half = await signUp(false);
    for (const [path, method] of paths) {
      const signedOut = await new Browser(app, origin).fetch(path, { method });
      expect(signedOut.status, path).toBe(401);
      expect((await error(signedOut)).code, path).toBe("unauthenticated");
      const notOnboarded = await half.b.fetch(path, { method });
      expect(notOnboarded.status, path).toBe(403);
      expect((await error(notOnboarded)).code, path).toBe("onboarding_required");
    }
  });

  test("a decision's address must be an id, a cursor must be one the API wrote, and the resume is a POST with the session's CSRF token", async () => {
    const reader = await signUp();
    const notAnId = await reader.b.fetch("/api/moderation/decisions/not-an-id");
    expect(notAnId.status).toBe(400);
    expect((await error(notAnId)).code).toBe("invalid_request");
    for (const path of ["/api/moderation/cases?cursor=nonsense", "/api/moderation/reports?cursor=nonsense"]) {
      const res = await reader.b.fetch(path);
      expect(res.status, path).toBe(400);
      expect((await error(res)).code, path).toBe("invalid_request");
    }
    expect((await reader.b.fetch("/api/moderation/report-mail/resume")).status).toBe(404);
    const withoutCsrf = await reader.b.fetch("/api/moderation/report-mail/resume", { method: "POST", csrf: false });
    expect(withoutCsrf.status).toBe(403);
    expect((await error(withoutCsrf)).code).toBe("csrf_failed");
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the author's list and one decision

  test("the author's list holds the decisions they were told of, newest first, and a decision opens only for its subject; none tells of who reported, what they wrote or how many", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const stranger = await signUp();
    const reporter = await signUp();
    const postId = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { body: "the reported words" });
    const explanation = `explained-${randomBytes(6).toString("hex")}`;
    const first = await sent(report([postTarget(postId)], { ruleId: "R3", explanation }), reporter.session);
    await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(postId)]));
    const interim = await decided(moderator, first.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R3", actions: [act("withhold")] });
    const final = await decided(moderator, first.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R3", actions: [act("remove")] });
    // A second post of the author's, reported and found fine: its author is told nothing of that decision.
    const fine = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const other = await sent(report([postTarget(fine)]), reporter.session);
    const silent = await decided(moderator, other.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });

    const page = await casesOf(author.b);
    const created = (await w.apiDb.execute<{ at: string }>(sql`select to_char(created_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as at from posts where id = ${postId}::uuid`))[0]!.at;
    expect(page.nextCursor).toBeNull();
    expect(page.decisions).toEqual([
      { id: final, kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", decidedOn: today(), post: { id: postId, createdAt: created }, actions: ["remove"], endedInterim: true, ruleId: "R3", legal: false, appealUntil: expect.any(String), appeal: null, reversedOn: null },
      { id: interim, kind: "interim", outcome: "restricted", decidedOn: today(), post: { id: postId, createdAt: created }, actions: ["withhold"], endedInterim: false, ruleId: "R3", legal: false, appealUntil: null, appeal: null, reversedOn: null },
    ]);
    expect(page.decisions.map((row) => row.id)).not.toContain(silent);
    expect((await casesOf(stranger.b)).decisions).toEqual([]);
    expect((await casesOf(reporter.b)).decisions).toEqual([]);

    // The decision's view: the statement's data, where its appeal stands, and the content it was made on.
    const view = await decisionOf(author.b, final);
    const decidedAt = new Date(view.decidedAt);
    expect(view).toMatchObject({ id: final, kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R3", source: "report", post: { id: postId, createdAt: created }, reversedOn: null });
    expect(view.appealUntil).toBe(appealDeadline(decidedAt).toISOString());
    expect(page.decisions[0]!.appealUntil).toBe(view.appealUntil);
    expect(view.measures).toMatchObject([{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, sealed: null }]);
    expect(view.endedMeasures).toEqual([{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null }]);
    expect(view.content).toEqual({ kind: "post", body: "the reported words", deletedByAuthor: false, images: [], imageCount: 0, imagesHidden: null });
    // It renders as the mail did: the app calls the same function on the same data.
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(view);
    expect(paragraphs.join(" ")).toContain(getRule("R3")!.title);
    expect(w.mailer.to(author.email, "moderation_decision").at(-1)!.data.statement).toBe(paragraphs.join(String.fromCharCode(10)));
    const whileDeciding = await decisionOf(author.b, interim);
    expect(whileDeciding).toMatchObject({ kind: "interim", appealUntil: null, reversedOn: null, content: { kind: "post", body: "the reported words" } });

    // Nobody else opens it, the reporter included, and a decision its author was not told of opens for nobody.
    for (const [who, id] of [[stranger.b, final], [reporter.b, final], [author.b, silent], [author.b, randomUUID()]] as const) {
      const res = await who.fetch(`/api/moderation/decisions/${id}`);
      expect(res.status).toBe(404);
      expect((await error(res)).code).toBe("not_found");
    }

    // The post's chip names the removal, to its author alone.
    expect((await postOf(author.b, postId)).moderation).toEqual({ decisionId: final, ruleId: "R3", legal: false, interim: false });
    const whole = JSON.stringify([page, view, whileDeciding, await postOf(author.b, postId), w.mailer.to(author.email, "moderation_decision")]);
    for (const secret of [reporter.handle, reporter.id, explanation, first.ref]) expect(whole.includes(secret), secret).toBe(false);
    // And no member of the answers could carry a report, its sender or a count of them: the source is a category.
    const names = new Set<string>();
    const collect = (value: unknown): void => {
      if (Array.isArray(value)) value.forEach(collect);
      else if (value !== null && typeof value === "object") for (const [name, member] of Object.entries(value)) (names.add(name), collect(member));
    };
    collect([page, view, whileDeciding]);
    expect([...names].filter((name) => /report|intake|notice|notifier|sender|count$|items?$/i.test(name))).toEqual(["imageCount"]);
    expect(view.source).toBe("report");
  });

  test("a post whose images are sealed keeps its text and its place in its author's views: each image is a placeholder that tells the author alone that it is sealed, the post has no chip, and the sealing decision's view shows the text beside the sealed images", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const reader = await signUp();
    const postId = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { body: "text beside the images" });
    const images = [await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, postId, 0), await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, postId, 1)];
    const notice = await sent(notices.csam([postTarget(postId)]));
    const seal = await decided(moderator, notice.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });

    const own = await postOf(author.b, postId);
    expect(own).toMatchObject({ id: postId, body: "text beside the images", state: "visible" });
    expect(own.media).toEqual(images.map((id) => ({ id, hidden: true, sealed: true })));
    // The post itself is neither withheld nor removed: it has no chip, and the decision is under Settings, Cases.
    expect("moderation" in own).toBe(false);
    for (const other of [reader.b, new Browser(app, origin)]) expect((await postOf(other, postId)).media).toEqual(images.map((id) => ({ id, hidden: true })));

    expect((await casesOf(author.b)).decisions).toMatchObject([{ id: seal, kind: "interim", actions: ["seal_media"], ruleId: "R2", legal: false, appealUntil: null, reversedOn: null }]);
    const view = await decisionOf(author.b, seal);
    expect(view.measures).toEqual([{ kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedImages: 0 } }]);
    expect(view.content).toEqual({ kind: "post", body: "text beside the images", deletedByAuthor: false, images: [], imageCount: 2, imagesHidden: "sealed" });
    // Nothing of a sealed image is in the answer: no id, no path and no description.
    for (const part of [...images, "image 1", "image 2", "/api/media/"]) expect(JSON.stringify(view).includes(part), part).toBe(false);

    // An admin answers without a seal: the seal ends, and the decision's view lists the images for the app's own image route.
    const answer = await decided(admin, notice.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, seal)).content).toEqual({
      kind: "post",
      body: "text beside the images",
      deletedByAuthor: false,
      images: images.map((id, index) => ({ id, alt: `image ${index + 1}`, width: 1200, height: 800, small: mediaPath(id, "small"), large: mediaPath(id, "large") })),
      imageCount: 2,
      imagesHidden: null,
    });
    // The author was told that what korbat did while deciding has ended: that decision is listed, above the seal's.
    const page = await casesOf(author.b);
    expect(page.decisions).toMatchObject([{ id: answer, kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", actions: [], endedInterim: true, ruleId: null, legal: false, appealUntil: null }, { id: seal }]);
    const ended = await decisionOf(author.b, answer);
    // A decision without a measure tells its author neither its facts nor its reason: they are the case's record.
    expect(ended).toMatchObject({ facts: null, reason: null, measures: [], endedMeasures: [{ kind: "seal_media" }] });
  });

  test("a decision about a post its author deleted since shows korbat's copy of the text and none of its images; one whose copy was erased says on which day, and whether the post itself is still there", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const kept = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { body: "kept by its author" });
    const gone = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { body: "deleted by its author" });
    const goneImage = await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, gone, 0);
    const decisions: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const postId of [kept, gone]) {
      const notice = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(postId)]));
      decisions[postId] = await decided(moderator, notice.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] });
    }
    // The author deletes the second post, as the app's delete does: the row stays as a tombstone, and its image is held for the case.
    await w.apiDb.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', body = '', deleted_at = now() where id = ${gone}::uuid`);
    const deleted = await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[gone]!);
    expect(deleted.content).toEqual({ kind: "post", body: "deleted by its author", deletedByAuthor: true, images: [], imageCount: 1, imagesHidden: "deleted_by_author" });
    expect(JSON.stringify(deleted).includes(goneImage)).toBe(false);
    expect(deleted.post).toMatchObject({ id: gone });

    // The retention job's erasure, done here as the migrator does it: the content columns and the salt null, the day stamped.
    await w.migrateDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update evidence_snapshots set body = null, media = null, display_name = null, bio = null, salt = null, erased_at = now()
                            where id in (select snapshot_id from decisions where id = any(${`{${Object.values(decisions).join(",")}}`}::uuid[]))`);
    });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[kept]!)).content).toEqual({ kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: today(), postKept: true });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[gone]!)).content).toEqual({ kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: today(), postKept: false });
    // Once an R4 redaction erased the content, every decision about the post says so, whichever is viewed.
    await w.migrateDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set redacted_at = now() where id = ${decisions[kept]!}::uuid`);
    });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[kept]!)).content).toEqual({ kind: "r4_redacted" });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[gone]!)).content).toEqual({ kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: today(), postKept: false });
  });

  test("a removal reversed in full says on which day, and leaves nothing to appeal; the correction is a decision of its own in the list", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const postId = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const notice = await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(postId)], { email: w.address() }));
    const removal = await decided(moderator, notice.caseId, { kind: "final", ground: "illegal", actions: [act("remove")] });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, removal)).appealUntil).not.toBeNull();
    expect((await postOf(author.b, postId)).moderation).toEqual({ decisionId: removal, ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: false });
    const correction = await decided(moderator, notice.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: removal, actions: [act("restore")] });

    const page = await casesOf(author.b);
    expect(page.decisions).toMatchObject([
      { id: correction, kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", actions: ["restore"], ruleId: null, legal: false, appealUntil: null, reversedOn: null },
      { id: removal, kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", actions: ["remove"], ruleId: null, legal: true, appealUntil: null, reversedOn: today() },
    ]);
    expect(await decisionOf(author.b, removal)).toMatchObject({ source: "notice", ground: "illegal", appealUntil: null, reversedOn: today() });
    expect(await decisionOf(author.b, correction)).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", reviewed: { kind: "final", ground: "illegal" }, reversals: [{ kind: "restore" }], appealUntil: null, reversedOn: null });
    // The post is visible again, and carries no chip.
    const post = await postOf(author.b, postId);
    expect(post.state).toBe("visible");
    expect("moderation" in post).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a decision about the account shows the fields as korbat copied them, which for a reset is the value the reset removed; it names no post", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const bio = `my own bio ${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`;
    await w.apiDb.execute(sql`update profiles set bio = ${bio} where id = ${author.id}::uuid`);
    const notice = await sent(notices.rule([accountTarget(author.handle)], { ruleId: "R6" }));
    const reset = await decided(moderator, notice.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R6", actions: [act("reset_bio")] });
    const view = await decisionOf(author.b, reset);
    expect(view).toMatchObject({ kind: "final", post: null, ruleId: "R6", measures: [{ kind: "reset_bio", noEffect: null }] });
    expect(view.content).toEqual({ kind: "account", handle: author.handle, displayName: `User ${author.handle}`, bio });
    expect(view.appealUntil).toBe(appealDeadline(new Date(view.decidedAt)).toISOString());
    expect((await casesOf(author.b)).decisions).toMatchObject([{ id: reset, post: null, actions: ["reset_bio"], ruleId: "R6" }]);
  });

  test("the author's list is read a page at a time, newest first, each decision once", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const made: string[] = [];
    // One decision more than a page holds, each the removal of a post of its own.
    for (let n = 0; n <= 20; n++) {
      const notice = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id))]));
      made.push(await decided(admin, notice.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] }));
    }
    const first = await casesOf(author.b);
    expect(first.decisions).toHaveLength(20);
    expect(first.nextCursor).toEqual(expect.any(String));
    const second = await casesOf(author.b, first.nextCursor!);
    expect(second.nextCursor).toBeNull();
    expect([...first.decisions, ...second.decisions].map((row) => row.id)).toEqual([...made].reverse());
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the chip

  test("the chip names the decision of the strongest post measure in force: an interim decision as such, a removal before a withhold, the newest removal first; and it is the author's alone", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const reader = await signUp();
    // Withheld while korbat decides, under R4.
    const held = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const first = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(held)], { ruleId: "R4" }));
    const withhold = await decided(moderator, first.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("withhold")] });
    expect(await postOf(author.b, held)).toMatchObject({ state: "withheld", moderation: { decisionId: withhold, ruleId: "R4", legal: false, interim: true } });
    // Nobody else is shown a withheld post at all.

    expect((await postOf(author.b, twice)).moderation).toEqual({ decisionId: newer, ruleId: "R3", legal: false, interim: false });
    // A withhold while a third case is decided does not take the chip from the removal.

    await decided(moderator, three.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R6", actions: [act("withhold")] });
    expect(await postOf(author.b, twice)).toMatchObject({ state: "removed", moderation: { decisionId: newer, ruleId: "R3", interim: false } });

    const list = await read(author.b, `/api/profiles/${author.handle}/posts?limit=50`, TimelinePage);

    const second = await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(quoting)], { turnstileToken: undefined }), reporter.session);

        { ref: first.ref, receivedAt: expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]{12}Z$/), items: [{ position: 1, link: `${origin}/post/${postId}`, scope: null, ...reported }, { position: 2, link: `${origin}/u/${subject.handle}`, scope: "account", ...reported }] },

    expect(itemOutcomeWords(page.reports[1]!.items[0]!)).toBe(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
    expect(page.reports[0]!.items).toMatchObject([{ outcome: "restricted_rule", sealed: true, unseen: false, scope: "account_suspect", reexamination: null }]);
    expect(itemOutcomeWords(page.reports[0]!.items[0]!)).toBe(`${SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed} ${ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE}`);
    // The account's own case is answered, so that nothing of this test keeps a post frozen.
    await decided(admin, freeze.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });

    const reporter = await signUp();

    for (let n = 0; n <= REPORTS_PAGE_SIZE; n++) {

      if (n % 9 === 0) w.ahead.limitsMs += HOUR;
      const target = n === 0 ? accountTarget(`gone_${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`) : { kind: "link" as const, url: `${origin}/post/${randomUUID()}` };
      refs.push((await sent(report([target]), reporter.session)).ref);

    const oldest = second.reports[0]!.items[0]!;

    const author = await w.account();

    const lifted = await resume(reporter.b);
    expect([lifted.status, await lifted.text()]).toEqual([204, ""]);
    expect((await reportsOf(reporter.b)).reportMailStopped).toBe(false);
    expect(await w.authForModeration.accountReportMailStopped(reporter.id)).toBe(false);
    expect((await resume(reporter.b)).status).toBe(204);
  });

    await w.cleanUp();
```

```ts
        expect(await accessRows(tx, mod.id, "case_opened", caseId)).toBe(2);
        expect(await refusal(readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), randomUUID()))).toBe("not_found");
      });
    });

    test("each source is a summary: reporters get letters in the order of their first items in the case; a notifier is what was given, or that the contact is lost; the path for child sexual abuse material is anonymous; a finding was found by a moderator; a reporter whose link is gone is only that", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const { deps, contacts } = world(tx);
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const [first, second] = [await profile(tx), await profile(tx)];
        const [known, lost] = [randomUUID(), randomUUID()];
        contacts.set(known, { found: true, named: true, contactGiven: true, confirmed: false, suppressed: true });
        await intake(tx, ground.rule(first.id, "R1"), aPost(p.postId));
        await intake(tx, ground.illegal(second.id), aPost(p.postId));
        // The first reporter again, on the other ground: the same letter.
        await intake(tx, ground.illegal(first.id), aPost(p.postId));
        await intake(tx, { ...ground.illegal(null), contactId: known }, aPost(p.postId));
        await intake(tx, { ...ground.illegal(null), contactId: lost }, aPost(p.postId));
        await intake(tx, ground.illegal(null), aPost(p.postId));
        await intake(tx, ground.csam(), aPost(p.postId));
        const caseId = (await intake(tx, ground.finding(other.id, "R1"), aPost(p.postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        // The second reporter's link is forgotten, as after their account's deletion: only the migrator's functions do that.
        await tx.execute(sql`update intake_items set reporter_account_id = null where reporter_account_id = ${second.id}::uuid`);

        const view = await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), caseId);
        const none = { accountAge: null, itemsFiled: null, actedOn: null, answeredUnseen: null };
        const noContact = { named: null, contactGiven: null, confirmed: null, suppressed: null, contactLost: false };
        expect(view.items.map((item) => item.source)).toEqual([
          expect.objectContaining({ kind: "reporter", label: "Reporter A", itemsFiled: "2_to_9" }),
          { kind: "unlinked", label: "A signed-in reporter no longer linked", ...none, ...noContact },
          expect.objectContaining({ kind: "reporter", label: "Reporter A", itemsFiled: "2_to_9" }),
          { kind: "notifier", label: "A notifier", ...none, named: true, contactGiven: true, confirmed: false, suppressed: true, contactLost: false },
          { kind: "notifier", label: "A notifier", ...none, named: false, contactGiven: false, confirmed: false, suppressed: false, contactLost: true },
          { kind: "notifier", label: "A notifier", ...none, named: false, contactGiven: false, confirmed: false, suppressed: false, contactLost: false },
          { kind: "anonymous", label: "Anonymous", ...none, ...noContact },
          { kind: "staff", label: "Found by a moderator", ...none, ...noContact },
        ]);
        // No contact's id leaves the server: the summary is all the console gets.
        expect(JSON.stringify(view)).not.toContain(known);
        expect(JSON.stringify(view)).not.toContain(lost);

        // On another case the same person is lettered by that case's own order.
        const q = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const third = await profile(tx);
        await intake(tx, ground.rule(third.id, "R1"), aPost(q.postId));
        const again = (await intake(tx, ground.rule(first.id, "R1"), aPost(q.postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        expect((await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), again)).items.map((item) => item.source.label)).toEqual(["Reporter A", "Reporter B"]);
      }, migrateDb);
    });

    test("a reporter's bands are computed over the reporter's own released items: an item answered without action while nobody could open the images is counted apart, never as decided without action", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const { deps } = world(tx);
        const release = () => tx.execute(sql`select public.release_outcomes(now() - interval '1 hour')`);
        const decidedAgo = (decisionId: string) => tx.execute(sql`update decisions set decided_at = now() - interval '5 hours' where id = ${decisionId}::uuid`);
        // Whatever other suites left releasable goes first.
        await release();
        const reporter = await profile(tx);

        // A post frozen through its author's account's case: a moderator's no-action answer to the rule report is unseen.
        const frozen = await imagePost(tx, 1);
        const unseenCase = (await intake(tx, ground.rule(reporter.id, "R1"), aPost(frozen.postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        await report(tx, anAccount(frozen.authorId), "csam");
        await decidedAgo(await decideIn(tx, mod, unseenCase, NO_SEAL));
        await release();
        let view = await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), unseenCase);
        expect(view.decisions).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", unseen: true, suspect: false })]);
        expect(view.items[0]!.source).toMatchObject({ itemsFiled: "1", actedOn: "none_decided", answeredUnseen: "1" });

        // A second report, acted on, and a third without action with the images in sight: one of two decided items acted on.
        const removed = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const removedCase = (await intake(tx, ground.rule(reporter.id, "R1"), aPost(removed.postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        await decidedAgo(await decideIn(tx, mod, removedCase, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] }));
        const cleared = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const clearedCase = (await intake(tx, ground.rule(reporter.id, "R1"), aPost(cleared.postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        await decidedAgo(await decideIn(tx, mod, clearedCase, NO_SEAL));
        await release();
        view = await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), clearedCase);
        expect(view.items[0]!.source).toMatchObject({ kind: "reporter", label: "Reporter A", itemsFiled: "2_to_9", actedOn: "half_or_more", answeredUnseen: "1" });
        expect(view.items[0]).toMatchObject({ outcome: "no_violation", answeredBy: view.decisions[0]!.id });
        // An account made thirteen months ago is in the oldest band.
        await tx.execute(sql`update profiles set created_at = now() - interval '13 months' where id = ${reporter.id}::uuid`);
        expect((await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), clearedCase)).items[0]!.source.accountAge).toBe("over_12_months");
      }, migrateDb);
    });

    test("a report of child sexual abuse material: suspicion with what the case reaches, no image allowed, the quoted post's case linked from the quoting post's item and the added item marked; a seal lists what it covers; an answer without a seal is counted as an earlier answer", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const { deps } = world(tx);
        const quoted = await imagePost(tx, 2);
        const quoting = await imagePost(tx, 1, undefined, { quoteOfId: quoted.postId });
        const recorded = await intake(tx, ground.csam(), aPost(quoting.postId));
        const [named, added] = [recorded.items.find((item) => item.position === 1)!, recorded.items.find((item) => item.position === 11)!];

        const quotingView = await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), named.caseId!);
        expect(quotingView).toMatchObject({ lane: 0, imagesAllowed: false });
        expect(quotingView.suspicion).toEqual({
          open: true,
          reach: { posts: 1, images: 1, sealed: 0, served: 1, newestPostOn: expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$/) },
          earlier: { target: { count: 0, lastOn: null, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 0, lastOn: null } },
        });
        expect(quotingView.items[0]).toMatchObject({ suspect: true, csam: true, quotedByPosition: null, quotedCaseId: added.caseId, source: { kind: "anonymous" } });
        const quotedView = await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), added.caseId!);
        expect(quotedView.items[0]).toMatchObject({ suspect: true, position: 11, quotedByPosition: 1, quotedCaseId: null });
        expect(quotedView.suspicion?.reach).toMatchObject({ posts: 1, images: 2, sealed: 0, served: 2 });

        // Whoever is on duty seals the quoted post's images while deciding: the answer lists what the seal covers.
        const seal = await decideIn(tx, mod, added.caseId!, SEAL_WHILE_DECIDING);
        const sealedView = await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), added.caseId!);
        expect(sealedView.suspicion).toMatchObject({ open: true, reach: { posts: 1, images: 2, sealed: 2, served: 0 } });
        // Text is never sealed: the post keeps its state and level, and its snapshot is shown.
        expect(sealedView).toMatchObject({ imagesAllowed: false, target: { state: "visible", level: "visible" } });
        expect(sealedView.snapshots[0]).toMatchObject({ withheld: false, body: "a post" });
        expect(sealedView.decisions).toEqual([
          expect.objectContaining({ id: seal, kind: "interim", outcome: "restricted", ruleId: "R2", category: MINORS, suspect: true, unseen: false, needsAdmin: false, staffHandle: await handleOf(tx, mod.id) }),
        ]);
        expect(sealedView.decisions[0]!.actions).toEqual([
          { id: expect.any(String), kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, inForce: true, reversesActionId: null, liftedBy: null, sealed: { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedPosts: 0, list: [{ postId: quoted.postId, createdAt: expect.any(String), images: 2 }] } },
        ]);
        expect(sealedView.decisions[0]!.facts).toEqual(expect.stringContaining("facts"));

        // An admin answers without a seal: the seal has ended, the case is closed, and its images may be opened again.
        await decideIn(tx, admin, added.caseId!, NO_SEAL);
        const answered = await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), added.caseId!);
        expect(answered).toMatchObject({ imagesAllowed: true, suspicion: { open: false, reach: { sealed: 0, served: 2 } } });
        expect(answered.closedAt).not.toBeNull();
        // The seal taken while deciding ended by itself with that answer: no reversal lifted it. (Both decisions carry the
        // one time of this test's transaction, so the seal's is found by its id.)
        expect(answered.decisions.find((decision) => decision.id === seal)!.actions[0]).toMatchObject({ kind: "seal_media", inForce: false, liftedBy: null });
        // The answer counts as an earlier one, about the target and about its author, on the case itself and on the next
        // report of this kind; an answer with a seal about another post of the author does not.
        const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        expect(answered.suspicion?.earlier).toEqual({ target: { count: 1, lastOn: today, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 1, lastOn: today } });
        const sealedForGood = await imagePost(tx, 1, quoted.authorId);
        const goodCase = (await report(tx, aPost(sealedForGood.postId), "csam")).caseId;
        await decideIn(tx, admin, goodCase, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
        const next = (await report(tx, aPost(quoted.postId), "csam")).caseId;
        const nextView = await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), next);
        expect(nextView.suspicion).toMatchObject({ open: true, earlier: { target: { count: 1, lastOn: today }, author: { count: 1, lastOn: today } } });
        // The sealed post's own closed case: the seal for good stands, so its images stay out of staff's sight.
        expect(await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), goodCase)).toMatchObject({ imagesAllowed: false, suspicion: { open: false, earlier: { target: { count: 0 }, author: { count: 1 } } } });
      });
    });

    test("an earlier answer without a seal is counted for twelve months and no longer: one decided eleven months ago is, one moved past twelve is not, about the target and about its author alike", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const { deps } = world(tx);
        expect(SUSPECT_EARLIER_MONTHS).toBe(12);
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
        const answer = await decideIn(tx, admin, (await report(tx, aPost(p.postId), "csam")).caseId, NO_SEAL);
        // Another post of the same author, answered the same way: it counts for the author, never for this target.
        const sibling = await imagePost(tx, 1, p.authorId);
        const siblingAnswer = await decideIn(tx, admin, (await report(tx, aPost(sibling.postId), "csam")).caseId, NO_SEAL);
        const next = (await report(tx, aPost(p.postId), "csam")).caseId;
        const earlier = async () => (await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), next)).suspicion!.earlier;
        // Only the migrator moves a decision's time.
        const decidedAgo = (id: string, ago: string) => tx.execute(sql`update decisions set decided_at = now() - ${ago}::interval where id = ${id}::uuid`);
        const dayOf = async (id: string) => (await tx.execute<{ day: string }>(sql`select to_char(decided_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as day from decisions where id = ${id}::uuid`))[0]!.day;

        await decidedAgo(answer, "11 months");
        expect(await earlier()).toEqual({ target: { count: 1, lastOn: await dayOf(answer), imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 2, lastOn: await dayOf(siblingAnswer) } });
        await decidedAgo(answer, "12 months 1 day");
        expect(await earlier()).toEqual({ target: { count: 0, lastOn: null, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 1, lastOn: await dayOf(siblingAnswer) } });
        await decidedAgo(siblingAnswer, "13 months");
        expect(await earlier()).toEqual({ target: { count: 0, lastOn: null, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 0, lastOn: null } });
      }, migrateDb);
    });

    test("an account's case reaches every image on the account's posts, as it stands at each read, and never shows an image; a seal's list in the answer stops at SEAL_LIST_MAX posts", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {

        let view = await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), caseId);
        expect(view).toMatchObject({ imagesAllowed: false, target: { type: "account", id: author.id, handle: author.handle, deleted: false } });
        expect(view.suspicion).toMatchObject({ open: true, reach: { posts: 1, images: 2, sealed: 0, served: 2 }, earlier: { target: { count: 0, imagesOpenedOn: null } } });
        // The account posts again: the case reaches the new image too.
        await imagePost(tx, 1, author.id);
        expect((await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), caseId)).suspicion?.reach).toMatchObject({ posts: 2, images: 3, served: 3 });

        // SEAL_LIST_MAX and one more posts with an image each, written in three statements.
        const more = SEAL_LIST_MAX - 1;
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into posts (author_id, body, created_at) select ${author.id}::uuid, 'post ' || n, now() - interval '20 days' - n * interval '1 minute' from generate_series(1, ${more}::int) n`);
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into post_media (owner_id, status, width, height, blurhash) select ${author.id}::uuid, 'ready', 1200, 800, 'L2Eo_P_3jb_3~qoL' from generate_series(1, ${more}::int)`);
        await tx.execute(sql`
          update post_media m set post_id = pairs.post_id, position = 0, alt_text = 'one of many'
            from (select i.id as media_id, p.id as post_id
                    from (select id, row_number() over (order by id) as n from post_media where owner_id = ${author.id}::uuid and post_id is null) i
                    join (select id, row_number() over (order by id) as n from posts where author_id = ${author.id}::uuid and body like 'post %') p on p.n = i.n) pairs
           where m.id = pairs.media_id`);
        await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, SEAL_WHILE_DECIDING);
        view = await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), caseId);
        const sealed = view.decisions[0]!.actions[0]!.sealed!;
        expect(sealed).toMatchObject({ posts: SEAL_LIST_MAX + 1, images: SEAL_LIST_MAX + 2, deletedPosts: 0 });
        expect(sealed.list).toHaveLength(SEAL_LIST_MAX);
        // Oldest post first.
        expect(sealed.list.map((row) => row.createdAt)).toEqual([...sealed.list.map((row) => row.createdAt)].sort());
        expect(CaseView.safeParse(view).success).toBe(true);
      });
    });

    test("content that was erased since is withheld by the database's one predicate: the snapshot carries its id, time and digest and nothing else", async () => {
```
