describe("a decision's screen", () => {
  const statement = {
    kind: "final" as const,
    outcome: "restricted" as const,
    ground: "incompatible" as const,
    ruleId: "R3" as const,
    rulesVersion: 2,
    redressVersion: 1,
    legalReference: null,
    facts: "The post attacks a group for its religion.",
    reason: "That is an attack on people, not on an idea.",
    source: "report" as const,
    decidedAt: TIME,
    post: { id: id(1), createdAt: "2026-09-01T08:30:00.000Z" },
    measures: [{ kind: "remove" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null }],
    reversals: [],
    endedMeasures: [],
    reviewed: null,
  };
  const image = (n: number) => ({ id: id(n), alt: `picture ${n}`, width: 800, height: 600, small: `/api/media/${id(n)}/small.webp`, large: `/api/media/${id(n)}/large.webp` });
  const view = (extra: Partial<DecisionView> = {}): DecisionView => ({
    id: id(3),
    ...statement,
    appealUntil: "2027-04-04T10:00:00.000Z",
    reversedOn: null,
    content: { kind: "post", body: "the words that were judged", deletedByAuthor: false, images: [image(7)], imageCount: 1, imagesHidden: null },
    appeal: null,
    ...extra,
  });
  const screen = (extra: Partial<DecisionView> = {}) => html(<DecisionDetail view={view(extra)} />);

  test("a final restriction: the statement as the mail rendered it, the post's time, the content it was made on, and Appeal with its deadline", () => {
    const out = screen();
    const text = textOf(out);
    for (const paragraph of statementParagraphs(view())) expect(text).toContain(paragraph);
    expect(text).toContain(`"${getRule("R3", 2)!.title}"`);
    expect(text).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automation);
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.post("2026-09-01 08:30 UTC"));
    expect(text).toContain("the words that were judged");
    // The image comes from the app's own image route, with its description.
    expect(loaded(out)).toEqual([expect.stringContaining(`/api/media/${id(7)}/small.webp`)]);
    expect(out).toContain('alt="picture 7"');
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.appeal);
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.appealUntil("2027-04-04 10:00 UTC"));
    expect(text).not.toContain("Reversed in full");
  });

  test("a decision taken while korbat decides: the interim redress, and no Appeal", () => {
    const interim = { kind: "interim" as const, measures: [{ kind: "withhold" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null }], appealUntil: null };
    const text = textOf(screen(interim));
    expect(text).toContain(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].interim);
    expect(text).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.scope.interim);
    // Neither the section nor its sentence: the interim redress never says the word.
    expect(text).not.toContain("Appeal");
    expect(text).not.toContain("You can appeal this decision until");
    expect(text).not.toContain("Reversed in full");
  });

  test("a restriction reversed in full says on which day, in place of Appeal", () => {
    const text = textOf(screen({ appealUntil: null, reversedOn: "2026-10-06" }));
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.reversed("2026-10-06"));
    expect(text).not.toContain("You can appeal this decision until");
  });

  test("a post whose images are sealed keeps its text: each sealed image is drawn as its placeholder, and nothing is loaded for it", () => {
    const sealed = {
      kind: "interim" as const,
      ruleId: "R2" as const,
      measures: [{ kind: "seal_media" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedImages: 0 } }],
      appealUntil: null,
      content: { kind: "post" as const, body: "text beside the images", deletedByAuthor: false, images: [], imageCount: 2, imagesHidden: "sealed" as const },
    };
    const out = screen(sealed);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain("text beside the images");
    expect(count(text, SEALED_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(loaded(out)).toEqual([]);
    expect(text).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.sealPost("2026-09-01 08:30 UTC", 2));
  });

  test("a post its author deleted: korbat's copy of the text under its own heading, and its images kept and not shown", () => {
    const out = screen({ content: { kind: "post", body: "deleted since", deletedByAuthor: true, images: [], imageCount: 2, imagesHidden: "deleted_by_author" } });
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.deleted);
    expect(text.indexOf(DECISION_WORDS.deleted)).toBeLessThan(text.indexOf("deleted since"));
    expect(count(text, DECISION_WORDS.deletedImages)).toBe(1);
    expect(loaded(out)).toEqual([]);
    // A deleted post without images says nothing of images.
    expect(textOf(screen({ content: { kind: "post", body: "deleted since", deletedByAuthor: true, images: [], imageCount: 0, imagesHidden: "deleted_by_author" } }))).not.toContain(DECISION_WORDS.deletedImages);
  });

  test("content korbat no longer holds: erased under the retention rules on its day, with the profile sentence only for a post its author kept; or erased by the R4 decision", () => {
    const kept = textOf(screen({ content: { kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: "2027-04-06", postKept: true } }));
    expect(kept).toContain(`${DECISION_WORDS.erased("2027-04-06")} ${DECISION_WORDS.postKept}`);
    const gone = textOf(screen({ content: { kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: "2027-04-06", postKept: false } }));
    expect(gone).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.erased("2027-04-06"));
    expect(gone).not.toContain(DECISION_WORDS.postKept);
    const redacted = textOf(screen({ ruleId: "R4", content: { kind: "r4_redacted" } }));
    expect(redacted).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.r4Redacted);
    expect(redacted).not.toContain("was erased on");
    // The post's time stays on the screen whatever became of the content.
    for (const text of [kept, gone, redacted]) expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.post("2026-09-01 08:30 UTC"));
  });

  test("a decision about the account shows the fields as korbat copied them, and links the decision that reset a field while its value is still kept", () => {
    const reset = {
      post: null,
      ruleId: "R6" as const,
      measures: [{ kind: "reset_bio" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null }],
      content: { kind: "account" as const, handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", bio: "what the bio said" },
    };
    const text = textOf(screen(reset));
    expect(text).toContain(`${DECISION_WORDS.bio} what the bio said`);
    expect(text).toContain(`${DECISION_WORDS.displayName} Ada`);
    expect(text).not.toContain("Your post of");
    // A later decision that lifts the reset: its statement says where the old value can be read, and the screen links there.
    const lifted = {
      kind: "correction" as const,
      outcome: "reversed" as const,
      ground: null,
      ruleId: null,
      facts: null,
      post: null,
      measures: [],
      reversals: [{ kind: "restore_bio" as const, mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: id(3), oldValueKept: true, resetRuleId: "R6" as const }],
      reviewed: { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R6" as const, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: TIME },
      appealUntil: null,
      content: { kind: "account" as const, handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", bio: "what the bio said" },
    };
    const out = screen({ id: id(8), ...lifted });
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.oldValueKept);
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.resetDecision);
    expect(hrefs(out)).toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(3)}`);
    // Once the old value is gone, nothing links there.
    const erased = screen({ id: id(8), ...lifted, reversals: [{ ...lifted.reversals[0]!, oldValueKept: false }] });
    expect(hrefs(erased)).not.toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(3)}`);
  });

  test("the screen asks for the decision by the id in its address and says when there is none for this account", () => {
    const source = read("app", "settings", "cases", "[id].tsx");
    expect(source).toContain("moderation.decision(id)");
    expect(source).toContain("DECISION_WORDS.notFound");
    expect(read("lib", "moderation.ts")).toContain("decision: (id: string) => api(`/api/moderation/decisions/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { schema: DecisionView })");
  });
});

describe("the chips and the labels", () => {
  const post = (extra: Partial<PostView> = {}): PostView => ({
    id: id(1),
    author: { id: id(900), handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", verified: false },
    body: "my own post",
    createdAt: TIME,
    state: "removed",
    replyTo: null,
    counts: { likes: 0, reposts: 0, replies: 0, quotes: 0 },
    media: [],
    quoteOf: null,
    ...extra,
  });
  const me = (userId: string) => ({ status: "signed-in", me: { user: { id: userId, onboarded: true }, profile: { handle: "ada" } } });
  const image = (n: number, moderation?: MediaView["moderation"]): MediaView => ({ id: id(n), width: 800, height: 600, blurhash: "LEHV6nWB2yk8", alt: `picture ${n}`, small: `/api/media/${id(n)}/small.webp`, large: `/api/media/${id(n)}/large.webp`, ...(moderation ? { moderation } : {}) });

  test("the chip's four texts: under review or removed, under a rule or as illegal content", () => {
    expect(CHIP_WORDS).toEqual({ underReview: "Under review", removed: "Removed", illegal: "illegal content" });
    const decision = { decisionId: id(3), ruleId: "R4" as const, legal: false, interim: true };
    expect(chipText(decision)).toBe("Under review: R4");
    expect(chipText({ ...decision, ruleId: null, legal: true })).toBe("Under review: illegal content");
    expect(chipText({ ...decision, ruleId: "R3", interim: false })).toBe("Removed: R3");
    expect(chipText({ ...decision, ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: false })).toBe("Removed: illegal content");
  });

  test("the author's own withheld or removed post shows the chip as a link to the decision's statement, amber while korbat decides and red once removed", () => {
    session.state = me(id(900));
    const removed = html(<PostCard post={post({ moderation: { decisionId: id(3), ruleId: "R3", legal: false, interim: false } })} />);
    expect(textOf(removed)).toContain("Removed: R3");
    expect(hrefs(removed)).toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(3)}`);
    const held = html(<PostCard post={post({ state: "withheld", moderation: { decisionId: id(4), ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: true } })} />);
    expect(textOf(held)).toContain("Under review: illegal content");
    expect(hrefs(held)).toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(4)}`);
    // The colours are class names, which a render without the style compiler does not carry: they are read from the source.
    const card = read("components", "social", "PostCard.tsx");
    expect(card).toContain('const amber = decision ? decision.interim : post.state === "withheld";');
    expect(card).toContain('const surface = `self-start rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 ${amber ? "bg-amber-500/15" : "bg-red-500/15"}`;');
    // Without the decision's facts the chip still says the state, and links nowhere.
    const bare = html(<PostCard post={post()} />);
    expect(textOf(bare)).toContain("Removed");
    expect(hrefs(bare).filter((href) => href.startsWith("/settings/cases"))).toEqual([]);
    // A post whose images are sealed keeps its text and its place, without a chip: the post itself is visible.
    const sealedMedia: HiddenMedia[] = [{ id: id(21), hidden: true, sealed: true }, { id: id(22), hidden: true, sealed: true }];
    const sealed = html(<PostCard post={post({ state: "visible", media: sealedMedia })} />);
    expect(textOf(sealed)).toContain("my own post");
    expect(count(textOf(sealed), SEALED_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(hrefs(sealed).filter((href) => href.startsWith("/settings/cases"))).toEqual([]);
    session.state = { status: "signed-out" };
    // Anyone else reads the placeholder of a hidden image for each of them.
    const others = html(<PostCard post={post({ state: "visible", media: [{ id: id(21), hidden: true }, { id: id(22), hidden: true }] })} />);
    expect(count(textOf(others), HIDDEN_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(textOf(others)).not.toContain(SEALED_IMAGE);
  });

  test("the author's own withheld image says Under review on itself and a removed one Removed, in the post and in the viewer; anyone else gets one placeholder for both", () => {
    const own = html(<MediaGrid media={[image(1, "withheld"), image(2, "removed"), image(3)]} postId={id(1)} own />);
    const text = textOf(own);
    expect(count(text, "Under review")).toBe(1);
    expect(count(text, "Removed")).toBe(1);
    // The author still sees their own images.
    expect(loaded(own)).toHaveLength(3);
    const noop = () => undefined;
    expect(textOf(html(<MediaViewerContent media={[image(1, "withheld")]} index={0} onIndex={noop} onClose={noop} />))).toContain("Under review");
    expect(textOf(html(<MediaViewerContent media={[image(2, "removed")]} index={0} onIndex={noop} onClose={noop} />))).toContain("Removed");
    expect(textOf(html(<MediaViewerContent media={[image(3)]} index={0} onIndex={noop} onClose={noop} />))).not.toMatch(/Under review|Removed/);
    // For anyone else the API sends the same hidden image for a withheld and a removed one: one placeholder, which does not say which.
    const hidden: HiddenMedia = { id: id(1), hidden: true };
    const others = textOf(html(<MediaGrid media={[hidden, { ...hidden, id: id(2) }]} postId={id(1)} />));
    expect(count(others, HIDDEN_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(others).not.toMatch(/Under review|Removed/);
  });
});

/**
 * What the app reads of moderation (3c design, sections 7.6 and 10): the chip's facts on the author's own post, the
 * author's list of decisions and one decision's view, and the reporter's list. Each shape is what its route answers and
 * what the app parses, so this file pins what each may carry.
 */
const id = (n: number) => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, "0")}`;
const TIME = "2026-10-04T10:00:00.000Z";

const post = (extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({
  id: id(1),
  author: { id: id(900), handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", verified: false },
  body: "a post",
  createdAt: TIME,
  state: "removed",
  replyTo: null,
  counts: { likes: 0, reposts: 0, replies: 0, quotes: 0 },
  media: [],
  quoteOf: null,
  ...extra,
});

describe("the chip's facts on a post", () => {
  test("a post may carry the decision behind its state: its id, the rule or the law, and whether korbat is still deciding", () => {
    const chip = { decisionId: id(2), ruleId: "R3", legal: false, interim: false };
    expect(PostView.parse(post({ moderation: chip })).moderation).toEqual(chip);
    expect(PostView.parse(post({ moderation: { decisionId: id(2), ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: true } })).moderation).toEqual({ decisionId: id(2), ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: true });
    expect(PostView.parse(post()).moderation).toBeUndefined();
    for (const ruleId of ["R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R5", "R6"]) expect(PostView.safeParse(post({ moderation: { ...chip, ruleId } })).success, ruleId).toBe(true);
  });

  test("anything else in its place is refused", () => {
    const chip = { decisionId: id(2), ruleId: "R3", legal: false, interim: false };
    for (const moderation of [{ ...chip, ruleId: "R7" }, { ...chip, decisionId: "no id" }, { ...chip, legal: "yes" }, { decisionId: id(2), ruleId: "R3", legal: false }, null]) {
      expect(PostView.safeParse(post({ moderation })).success, JSON.stringify(moderation)).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  test("a quoted embed carries none: the chip belongs to the card of the post itself", () => {
    const quoted = QuotedPost.parse(post({ moderation: { decisionId: id(2), ruleId: "R3", legal: false, interim: false } }));
    expect("moderation" in quoted).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("an item's words from the status answer's item", () => {
  const waiting = { position: 1, link: "http://localhost:8081/post/" + id(1), scope: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, quotedBy: null, outcome: null, decidedOn: null, changed: false, reexamines: false, reexamination: null };

  test("a released restriction under a rule carries the rule with its title, and a restriction that changed nothing says so; neither is there before the release", () => {
    expect(NoticeItemStatus.parse(waiting)).toEqual(waiting);
    const restricted = { ...waiting, outcome: "restricted_rule", decidedOn: "2026-10-04", rule: { id: "R3", title: "No targeted hatred" }, noEffect: true };
    expect(NoticeItemStatus.parse(restricted)).toEqual(restricted);
    expect(NoticeItemStatus.safeParse({ ...restricted, rule: { id: "R9", title: "x" } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(NoticeItemStatus.safeParse({ ...restricted, rule: { id: "R3" } }).success).toBe(false);
    // The mark is there or it is not: a false one is never sent.
    expect(NoticeItemStatus.safeParse({ ...restricted, noEffect: false }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the words are the one composition the mails use, from the item's own facts, and nothing is said before the release", () => {
    expect(itemOutcomeWords(NoticeItemStatus.parse(waiting))).toBeNull();
    const rule = { id: "R3", title: "No targeted hatred" } as const;
    const restricted = NoticeItemStatus.parse({ ...waiting, outcome: "restricted_rule", decidedOn: "2026-10-04", rule, noEffect: true, scope: "quote" });
    expect(itemOutcomeWords(restricted)).toBe(outcomeWords({ outcome: "restricted_rule", rule, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: true, scope: "quote" }));
    expect(itemOutcomeWords(restricted)).toContain("it breaks korbat rule R3 (No targeted hatred).");
    expect(itemOutcomeWords(restricted)).toContain(ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN);
    const unseen = NoticeItemStatus.parse({ ...waiting, outcome: "no_violation", decidedOn: "2026-10-04", unseen: true });
    expect(itemOutcomeWords(unseen)).toBe(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
    const sealed = NoticeItemStatus.parse({ ...waiting, outcome: "restricted_rule", decidedOn: "2026-10-04", suspect: true, sealed: true, rule: { id: "R2", title: "No child sexual abuse material" } });
    expect(itemOutcomeWords(sealed)).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
    const dismissed = NoticeItemStatus.parse({ ...waiting, outcome: "not_evident", decidedOn: "2026-10-04", suspect: true });
    expect(itemOutcomeWords(dismissed)).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_action);
  });

  test("an account's item that named nothing keeps its scope in the answer and reads no scope sentence", () => {
    const nothing = NoticeItemStatus.parse({ ...waiting, link: "http://localhost:8081/u/nobody", scope: "account", outcome: "not_available", decidedOn: "2026-10-04" });
    expect(itemOutcomeWords(nothing)).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_available}.`);
    const answered = NoticeItemStatus.parse({ ...nothing, outcome: "no_violation" });
    expect(itemOutcomeWords(answered)).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_violation}. ${ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE}`);
  });
});

describe("the author's list of decisions", () => {
  const row = { id: id(3), kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", decidedOn: "2026-10-04", post: { id: id(1), createdAt: TIME }, actions: ["remove"], endedInterim: false, ruleId: "R3", legal: false, appealUntil: "2027-04-04T10:00:00.000Z", reversedOn: null, appeal: null };

  test("a page holds decisions, each with its day, what it did, the post's time for a decision about a post, the rule or the law and where its appeal stands", () => {
    const page = { decisions: [row, { ...row, id: id(4), kind: "interim", post: null, actions: ["reset_bio", "seal_media"], ruleId: null, legal: true, appealUntil: null }], nextCursor: "abc" };
    expect(AuthorCasesPage.parse(page)).toEqual(page);
    expect(AuthorCasesPage.parse({ decisions: [{ ...row, kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", actions: ["restore"], ruleId: null, appealUntil: null, reversedOn: null }], nextCursor: null }).decisions[0]!.actions).toEqual(["restore"]);
    expect(AuthorCasesPage.safeParse({ decisions: [{ ...row, decidedOn: TIME }], nextCursor: null }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(AuthorCasesPage.safeParse({ decisions: [{ ...row, actions: ["delete"] }], nextCursor: null }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a row says where the author's appeal of the decision stands: none, pending, or its answer", () => {
    for (const appeal of [null, "pending", "kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]) {
      expect(AuthorCasesPage.parse({ decisions: [{ ...row, appealUntil: null, appeal }], nextCursor: null }).decisions[0]!.appeal, String(appeal)).toBe(appeal);
    }
    expect(AuthorCasesPage.safeParse({ decisions: [{ ...row, appeal: "answered" }], nextCursor: null }).success).toBe(false);
    const { appeal: _appeal, ...without } = row;
    expect(AuthorCasesPage.safeParse({ decisions: [without], nextCursor: null }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("its query takes an optional cursor and nothing else", () => {
    expect(AuthorCasesQuery.parse({})).toEqual({});
    expect(AuthorCasesQuery.parse({ cursor: "abc_-" })).toEqual({ cursor: "abc_-" });
    expect(AuthorCasesQuery.safeParse({ cursor: "" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(AuthorCasesQuery.safeParse({ cursor: "a b" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ReportsQuery.parse({ cursor: "abc" })).toEqual({ cursor: "abc" });
    expect(ReportsQuery.safeParse({ cursor: "x".repeat(401) }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("one decision as its author reads it", () => {
  const statement = {
    kind: "final",
    outcome: "restricted",
    ground: "incompatible",
    ruleId: "R3",
    rulesVersion: 2,
    redressVersion: 1,

    reason: "It breaks the rule.",

    decidedAt: TIME,

    measures: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null }],
    reversals: [],
    endedMeasures: [],
    reviewed: null,
  };

  const view = { id: id(3), ...statement, appealUntil: "2027-04-04T10:00:00.000Z", reversedOn: null, content: { kind: "post", body: "the words", deletedByAuthor: false, images: [image], imageCount: 1, imagesHidden: null }, appeal: null };

  test("it is the statement's data with what the author's screen adds: where the appeal stands and the content actioned", () => {
    expect(DecisionView.parse(view)).toEqual(view);
    expect(DecisionView.safeParse({ ...view, content: undefined }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(DecisionView.safeParse({ ...view, id: undefined }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the content is the post's text with its images, an account's fields, or the reason it is not shown", () => {
    const contents = [
      { kind: "post", body: "", deletedByAuthor: true, images: [], imageCount: 2, imagesHidden: "deleted_by_author" },
      { kind: "post", body: "text stays", deletedByAuthor: false, images: [], imageCount: 3, imagesHidden: "sealed" },
      { kind: "account", handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", bio: "hello" },
      { kind: "r4_redacted" },

      { kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: "2026-10-05", postKept: false },
    ];
    for (const content of contents) expect(DecisionView.parse({ ...view, content }).content, content.kind).toEqual(content);
    for (const content of [{ kind: "erased" }, { kind: "post", body: "x" }, { kind: "sealed" }, { kind: "post", body: "x", deletedByAuthor: false, images: [], imageCount: 1, imagesHidden: "withheld" }]) {
      expect(DecisionView.safeParse({ ...view, content }).success, JSON.stringify(content)).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  test("the appeal is none, pending with who may review it as two answers that name nobody, or answered with the answering decision's statement", () => {
    const pending = { state: "pending", filedAt: TIME, reviewer: "none_single_staff", needsAdmin: true };
    const answered = { state: "answered", filedAt: TIME, answeredOn: "2026-10-09", result: "kept", answeredBy: id(9), statement: { ...statement, kind: "review", outcome: "kept" } };
    for (const appeal of [pending, { ...pending, reviewer: "available", needsAdmin: false }, { ...pending, reviewer: "none_eligible" }, answered, { ...answered, result: "partly_reversed" }, { ...answered, result: "reversed" }]) {
      expect(DecisionView.parse({ ...view, appealUntil: null, appeal }).appeal, JSON.stringify(appeal).slice(0, 60)).toEqual(appeal);
    }
    expect(DecisionAppeal.parse(pending)).toEqual(pending);
    expect(REVIEWER_STATES).toEqual(["available", "none_single_staff", "none_eligible"]);
    // Each state is a strict shape: nothing of who took part in the case, and no answer without its statement.
    for (const appeal of [{ ...pending, reviewer: "nobody" }, { ...pending, decidedBy: "mod_anna" }, { ...pending, mayReview: false }, { ...answered, statement: undefined }, { ...answered, result: "pending" }, { ...answered, answeredOn: TIME }, { state: "none" }]) {
      expect(DecisionView.safeParse({ ...view, appeal }).success, JSON.stringify(appeal).slice(0, 60)).toBe(false);
    }
    const { appeal: _appeal, ...without } = view;
    expect(DecisionView.safeParse(without).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("an image of the content carries what the app's own image route needs, and nothing of an image that is not shown", () => {
    expect(DecisionView.safeParse({ ...view, content: { ...view.content, images: [{ id: id(7), alt: "a picture" }] } }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("the reporter's list", () => {
  const item = { id: id(5), position: 1, link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada", scope: "account", suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, quotedBy: null, outcome: null, decidedOn: null, changed: false, reexamines: false, reexamination: null };

  test("a page holds the account's reports, each with its reference, its time and its items in the status page's shape with their ids, and says whether korbat's report mails to the account are stopped", () => {

    // An item of the list carries its id, by which its sender asks for a re-examination; the status page's item never does.

    expect(ReportsPage.safeParse({ ...page, reports: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", receivedAt: TIME, items: [asOnThePage] }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ReportItem.parse(item)).toEqual(item);
    expect(Object.keys(NoticeItemStatus.shape)).not.toContain("id");
    expect(REPORTS_PAGE_SIZE).toBe(20);
    expect(ReportsPage.safeParse({ ...page, reports: Array.from({ length: REPORTS_PAGE_SIZE + 1 }, () => page.reports[0]) }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("laneFor", () => {
  const TC: TdbCategory = "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC";

  test("a rule report takes its rule's lane: R2 and R5 are urgent, R3 and R4 next, R1 and R6 last", () => {
    const lanes = RULE_IDS.map((ruleId) => laneFor({ ruleId, allegesIllegal: false, csam: false, category: TC }));

  test("the CSAM path is lane 0 whatever else the intake says", () => {
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: true, csam: true, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS" })).toBe(0);
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: false, csam: true, category: TC })).toBe(0);
  });

  test("a notice of illegality takes its category's lane, for every category", () => {
    const urgent = ["STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE", "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY", "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM"];
    const next = [
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE",
    ];
    for (const category of TDB_CATEGORIES) {
      const expected = urgent.includes(category) ? 0 : next.includes(category) ? 1 : 2;
      expect(laneFor({ ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category }), category).toBe(expected);
    }
  });

  test("a notice of illegality that also cites a rule takes the more severe of the two lanes", () => {
    // Fraud (lane 2) under R5 (lane 0), and violence (lane 0) under R1 (lane 2): both are urgent.
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R5", allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD" })).toBe(0);
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R1", allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE" })).toBe(0);
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R3", allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD" })).toBe(1);
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R6", allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE" })).toBe(2);
  });

  test("where nothing is alleged to be illegal, the category is korbat's own classification and moves no lane", () => {
    for (const category of TDB_CATEGORIES) {
      expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R1", allegesIllegal: false, csam: false, category }), category).toBe(2);
      expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R3", allegesIllegal: false, csam: false, category }), category).toBe(1);
    }
  });
});

      restore_media: "image",
      restore_display_name: "display_name",
      restore_bio: "bio",
    });
    expect(Object.fromEntries(reversals.map((kind) => [kind, MEASURES[kind].lifts]))).toEqual({
      restore: ["withhold", "remove"],
      unseal_media: ["seal_media"],
      restore_media: ["withhold_media", "remove_media"],
      restore_display_name: ["reset_display_name"],
      restore_bio: ["reset_bio"],
    });
    // Every measure can be lifted, by exactly one kind of reversal.
    for (const measure of measures) expect(reversals.filter((kind) => (MEASURES[kind].lifts as readonly ActionKind[]).includes(measure)), measure).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("each has a label of its own: the composer's words where the composer names the measure", () => {
    // The first seven and "Lift the seal" are the words of the decision composer; the composer, the statement and the
    // terms all take them from here.
    expect(Object.fromEntries(kinds.map((kind) => [kind, MEASURES[kind].label]))).toEqual({
      withhold: "Withhold the post",
      remove: "Remove",
      seal_media: "Seal the images this case reaches",
      withhold_media: "Withhold one image",
      remove_media: "Remove one image",
      reset_display_name: "Reset display name",
      reset_bio: "Reset bio",
      restore: "Lift the restriction of the post",
      unseal_media: "Lift the seal",
      restore_media: "Lift the restriction of one image",
      restore_display_name: "Lift the reset of the display name",
      restore_bio: "Lift the reset of the bio",
    });
    const labels = kinds.map((kind) => MEASURES[kind].label);
    expect(new Set(labels).size).toBe(labels.length);
  });
});

describe("the order of a decision's actions", () => {
  const a = "1a1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";
  const b = "2a1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";

  test("by kind as a string, then by image as a string, an action without an image first", () => {
    const sorted: DecisionActionParams[] = [
      { kind: "remove", mediaId: null },
      { kind: "remove_media", mediaId: a },
      { kind: "remove_media", mediaId: b },
      { kind: "reset_bio", mediaId: null },
      { kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null },
      { kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: a },
    ];
    for (const shuffled of [[...sorted].reverse(), [sorted[3]!, sorted[0]!, sorted[5]!, sorted[2]!, sorted[1]!, sorted[4]!]]) {
      expect([...shuffled].sort(compareDecisionActions)).toEqual(sorted);
    }
    expect(compareDecisionActions(sorted[1]!, sorted[1]!)).toBe(0);
    expect(compareDecisionActions({ kind: "restore_media", mediaId: null }, { kind: "restore_media", mediaId: a })).toBeLessThan(0);
  });
});

describe("textDigest", () => {
  test("the tag names the version of the rule", () => {
    expect(TEXT_DIGEST_TAG).toBe("korbat.text.v1");
  });

  test.each(TEXT_DIGEST_VECTORS.map((vector) => [vector.name, vector] as const))("%s: the sha256 of the tag, a line feed, the salt's bytes and the text's UTF-8 bytes", async (_name, vector) => {
    expect(await textDigest(vector.salt, vector.text)).toBe(vector.digest);
  });

  test("the longest vector is 5000 UTF-16 units, and the vectors hold a line feed, a character outside ASCII and one outside the basic plane", () => {
    expect(Math.max(...TEXT_DIGEST_VECTORS.map((vector) => vector.text.length))).toBe(5000);
    const all = TEXT_DIGEST_VECTORS.map((vector) => vector.text).join("");
    expect(all).toContain(LF);
    expect(all).toContain(E_ACUTE);
    expect(all).toContain(GRINNING);
  });

  test("another salt or another text gives another digest", async () => {
    const digests = await Promise.all([textDigest("a1".repeat(32), "one"), textDigest("a2".repeat(32), "one"), textDigest("a1".repeat(32), "one "), textDigest("a1".repeat(32), "One")]);
    expect(new Set(digests).size).toBe(4);
  });

  test("a salt that is not 32 bytes of lower-case hex is refused, never padded or folded", async () => {
    for (const salt of ["", "a1".repeat(31), "a1".repeat(33), "A1".repeat(32), "g1".repeat(32), ` ${"a1".repeat(32)}`]) {
      await expect(textDigest(salt, "text"), JSON.stringify(salt)).rejects.toThrow(TypeError);
    }
  });

  test("a text with a lone surrogate, which has no UTF-8 bytes, is refused rather than hashed as something else", async () => {
    const high = String.fromCharCode(0xd83d);
    const low = String.fromCharCode(0xde00);
    for (const text of [high, low, `a${high}b`, `${low}${high}`]) await expect(textDigest("a1".repeat(32), text)).rejects.toThrow(TypeError);
    // The pair itself is a character.
    await expect(textDigest("a1".repeat(32), `${high}${low}`)).resolves.toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
  });
});

describe("snapshotText and snapshotDigest", () => {
  const post: SnapshotDigestInput = {
    salt: "ab".repeat(32),
    targetType: "post",
    targetId: "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a",
    takenAt: "2026-10-03T10:00:00.123Z",
    authorHandle: "ada",
    postState: "visible",
    postCreatedAt: "2026-10-01T08:30:00.000Z",
    replyToId: null,
    quoteOfId: "7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36",
    body: `Line one${LF}caf${E_ACUTE} ${GRINNING}`,
    media: [
      { id: "11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555", alt: "A cat", width: 1200, height: 800 },
      { id: "66666666-7777-4888-9999-aaaaaaaaaaaa", alt: null, width: 640, height: 480 },
    ],
    displayName: null,
    bio: null,
    handle: null,
  };
  const account: SnapshotDigestInput = {
    salt: "cd".repeat(32),
    targetType: "account",
    targetId: "8a3c7f0e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666",
    takenAt: "2026-10-03T10:00:00.000Z",
    authorHandle: "bob",
    postState: null,
    postCreatedAt: null,
    replyToId: null,
    quoteOfId: null,
    body: null,
    media: null,
    displayName: `Bob ${GRINNING}`,
    bio: "",
    handle: "bob",
  };
  const BS = String.fromCharCode(92);
  // The texts and the digests below were computed with Python's json and hashlib when they were written.
  const POST_TEXT =
    `{"authorHandle":"ada","bio":null,"body":"Line one${BS}ncaf${E_ACUTE} ${GRINNING}","displayName":null,"handle":null,` +
    `"media":[{"alt":"A cat","height":800,"id":"11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555","width":1200},{"alt":null,"height":480,"id":"66666666-7777-4888-9999-aaaaaaaaaaaa","width":640}],` +
    `"postCreatedAt":"2026-10-01T08:30:00.000Z","postState":"visible","quoteOfId":"7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36","replyToId":null,` +
    `"salt":"${"ab".repeat(32)}","takenAt":"2026-10-03T10:00:00.123Z","targetId":"3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a","targetType":"post","v":1}`;
  const POST_DIGEST = "cb995d11ed14e3c4e555c187d319a86506b263e98f924f59f2f7d5231a3bc6e6";
  const ACCOUNT_DIGEST = "41019b2a47d4ebad37cc8c5ad25f8d79a7232c4e3e705231f9e9ba1e02fb1f26";

  test("the tag names the version of the rule", () => {
    expect(SNAPSHOT_DIGEST_TAG).toBe("korbat.snapshot.v1");
  });

  test("the text is the sorted JSON of version 1 and the snapshot's fifteen members", () => {
    expect(snapshotText(post)).toBe(POST_TEXT);
    const parsed = JSON.parse(snapshotText(account)) as Record<string, unknown>;
    expect(Object.keys(parsed)).toEqual(["authorHandle", "bio", "body", "displayName", "handle", "media", "postCreatedAt", "postState", "quoteOfId", "replyToId", "salt", "takenAt", "targetId", "targetType", "v"]);
    expect(parsed).toEqual({ v: 1, ...account });
  });

  test("the digest is the sha256 of the tag, a line feed and that text", async () => {
    expect(await snapshotDigest(post)).toBe(POST_DIGEST);
    expect(await snapshotDigest(account)).toBe(ACCOUNT_DIGEST);
  });

  test("it round-trips the snapshot answer's JSON, whatever order and whatever else the answer carries", async () => {
    // As the console receives it: parsed from JSON, with members the digest does not cover, in another order.
    const sent = {
      id: "9d0f5e3c-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
      digest: POST_DIGEST,
      withheld: false,
      erasedAt: null,
      ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(post).reverse()),
      media: post.media!.map((image) => ({ height: image.height, width: image.width, note: "never part of a snapshot", alt: image.alt, id: image.id })),
    };
    const answer = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sent)) as SnapshotDigestInput;
    expect(snapshotText(answer)).toBe(POST_TEXT);
    expect(await snapshotDigest(answer)).toBe(POST_DIGEST);
  });

  test("any member that changes gives another digest", async () => {
    const changed: SnapshotDigestInput[] = [
      { ...post, salt: "ac".repeat(32) },
      { ...post, takenAt: "2026-10-03T10:00:00.124Z" },
      { ...post, body: `${post.body} ` },
      { ...post, postState: "withheld" },
      { ...post, quoteOfId: null },
      { ...post, media: [post.media![1]!, post.media![0]!] },
      { ...post, media: [{ ...post.media![0]!, alt: "A dog" }, post.media![1]!] },
      { ...post, authorHandle: "adb" },
    ];
    const digests = await Promise.all([post, ...changed].map(snapshotDigest));
    expect(new Set(digests).size).toBe(changed.length + 1);
  });

  test("a time that is not the UTC string toISOString writes, to the millisecond, is refused", () => {
    for (const takenAt of ["2026-10-03T10:00:00Z", "2026-10-03T10:00:00.123456Z", "2026-10-03T12:00:00.123+02:00", "2026-10-03 10:00:00.123Z", ""]) {
      expect(() => snapshotText({ ...post, takenAt }), takenAt).toThrow(TypeError);
    }
    expect(() => snapshotText({ ...post, postCreatedAt: "2026-10-01T08:30:00Z" })).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(snapshotText({ ...post, takenAt: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 9, 3, 10, 0, 0, 123)).toISOString() })).toBe(POST_TEXT);
  });
});

describe("appealDeadline", () => {
  const at = (iso: string) => new Date(iso);
  const deadline = (iso: string) => appealDeadline(at(iso)).toISOString();

  test("six calendar months later, at the same UTC time", () => {
    expect(deadline("2026-10-03T10:15:30.250Z")).toBe("2027-04-03T10:15:30.250Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-01-15T00:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2026-07-15T00:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-07-01T23:59:59.999Z")).toBe("2027-01-01T23:59:59.999Z");
  });

  test("a day the sixth month lacks becomes that month's last day", () => {
    // 31 August plus six months is the end of February: the 28th, or the 29th in a leap year.
    expect(deadline("2026-08-31T12:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2027-02-28T12:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2027-08-31T12:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2028-02-29T12:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2027-08-30T12:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2028-02-29T12:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2027-08-29T12:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2028-02-29T12:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-03-31T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2026-09-30T08:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-05-31T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2026-11-30T08:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-10-31T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2027-04-30T08:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-12-31T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2027-06-30T08:00:00.000Z");
    // A leap day itself moves to 29 August: August has the day.
    expect(deadline("2028-02-29T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2028-08-29T08:00:00.000Z");
  });

  test("it is computed in UTC: the last instants of a UTC month stay on that month's side", () => {
    expect(deadline("2026-08-31T23:59:59.999Z")).toBe("2027-02-28T23:59:59.999Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2027-03-01T00:00:00.000Z");
  });

  test("it leaves its argument as it was", () => {
    const informed = at("2026-08-31T12:00:00.000Z");
    appealDeadline(informed);
    expect(informed.toISOString()).toBe("2026-08-31T12:00:00.000Z");
  });
});

 * Each table is the one place its words are written: the mails, the status page, the app's list and the console take

 */

describe("the outcome phrases", () => {

      restricted_legal: "access restricted: korbat found it illegal",
      no_violation: "no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal",
      not_evident:
        "no action: korbat found no breach of its rules, and whether it is illegal cannot be seen without a detailed legal examination; a court or an authority can order its removal",
      not_available: "no action: the link names nothing korbat can show (checked automatically)",
      partly_reversed: "korbat reversed part of its decision to restrict it",

    });

  test("the sentences that follow an outcome, and the phrases of the path for child sexual abuse material, word for word", () => {

    );
    expect(ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE).toBe(

    expect(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION).toBe(

});

describe("outcomeWords: one item's outcome as its sender reads it", () => {

    }
    // The other three outcomes are worded as for any item.
    expect(words("not_available", { suspect: true })).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_available}.`);
    expect(words("partly_reversed", { suspect: true, sealed: true })).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.partly_reversed}.`);
    expect(words("reversed", { suspect: true, sealed: true })).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.reversed}.`);
  });

  test("the sealed phrase stands for every item a sealing decision answered, suspect or not, in place of both restricting phrases", () => {
    for (const suspect of [false, true]) {
      expect(words("restricted_rule", { sealed: true, suspect })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
      expect(words("restricted_legal", { sealed: true, suspect })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
    }
  });

  test("an item on another ground about a post, answered without action while nobody could open its images, reads UNSEEN_NO_ACTION, and no other item does", () => {
    expect(words("no_violation", { unseen: true })).toBe(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
    expect(words("not_evident", { unseen: true })).toBe(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
    // A restriction, a reversal and a link that named nothing keep their own words, and a suspect item its own phrase.
    for (const outcome of ["restricted_rule", "restricted_legal", "not_available", "partly_reversed", "reversed"] as const) expect(words(outcome, { unseen: true }), outcome).not.toContain(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
    expect(words("no_violation", { unseen: true, suspect: true })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_action);
    // An item about an account is never worded this way, whatever its decision's mark: it keeps the ordinary phrase with its scope.
    expect(words("no_violation", { unseen: true, scope: "account" })).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_violation}. ${ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE}`);
    expect(words("not_evident", { unseen: true, scope: "account_suspect" })).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_evident}. ${ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE}`);
    // On a post that quotes another the scope follows it as it follows any outcome.
    expect(words("no_violation", { unseen: true, scope: "quote" })).toBe(`${UNSEEN_NO_ACTION} ${QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE}`);
  });
});

describe("the console's fixed drafts for a seal", () => {
  test("SEAL_DRAFTS holds its eight texts, word for word", () => {
    expect(SEAL_DRAFTS).toEqual({
      facts: {
        notice_post: "korbat received a notice that reports images of this post as child sexual abuse material.",
        notice_account: "korbat received a notice that reports this account for child sexual abuse material. It does not say which images, so korbat sealed every image on the account's posts.",
        notice_added: "korbat received a notice about content on korbat that shows this post's images and reports them as child sexual abuse material.",
        finding_post: "A moderator reported images of this post as possible child sexual abuse material.",
        finding_account: "A moderator reported images on this account's posts as possible child sexual abuse material. korbat sealed every image on the account's posts.",
        finding_added: "A moderator reported content on korbat that shows this post's images as possible child sexual abuse material.",
      },
      reason: {
        deciding: "korbat's staff do not open images reported this way, so korbat has not assessed them. It hides them from everyone, you included, until an admin has answered the report.",
        final:
          "korbat's staff do not open images reported this way, so korbat has not assessed them. An admin found the report credible enough to keep the images sealed and to report them to the police, who can assess them.",
      },
    });
    expect(Object.keys(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts).length + Object.keys(SEAL_DRAFTS.reason).length).toBe(8);
  });

  test("none says that korbat found the images to be such material, and each reason says that staff do not open them", () => {
    for (const text of [...Object.values(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts), ...Object.values(SEAL_DRAFTS.reason)]) {
      expect(text).not.toMatch(/korbat found|is child sexual abuse material|are child sexual abuse material/);
    }
    for (const text of Object.values(SEAL_DRAFTS.reason)) expect(text).toContain("korbat's staff do not open images reported this way");
    // The two drafts for an added item never say that this post was reported, and name no other post.
    for (const text of [SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_added, SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.finding_added]) expect(text).not.toMatch(/of this post as|this post was|quot/);
  });

  test("the facts draft follows the suspect items the decision considers: a notice when any came from a user, the added form when every one was added by korbat, else by the case's target", () => {
    const item = (source: "user" | "finding", added = false) => ({ source, added });
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("user")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post);
    expect(sealFactsDraft("account", [item("user")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_account);
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("finding")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.finding_post);
    expect(sealFactsDraft("account", [item("finding")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.finding_account);
    // A notice among findings makes it a notice's draft.
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("finding"), item("user")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post);
    // Every item added for a quoted post (or a re-examination of one): the added form; one named item among them: the post's.
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("user", true), item("user", true)])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_added);
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("finding", true)])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.finding_added);
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("user", true), item("finding")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post);
    expect(() => sealFactsDraft("post", [])).toThrow(/suspect item/);
  });
});

 * The console's requests and answers on cases (3c design, section 10): what a moderator's own finding may say, what a
 * saved text must be, and the shapes the queue, the case and the home screen are parsed with.

describe("FindingRequest", () => {

  test("a moderator's finding cites a korbat rule, R2 among them, about a post, an account or a korbat link", () => {
    for (const ruleId of ["R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R5", "R6"]) expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId }).success, ruleId).toBe(true);
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "account", handle: "@Some_one" } }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(FindingRequest.parse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "account", handle: "@Some_one" } }).target).toEqual({ kind: "account", handle: "some_one" });
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "link", url: "https://korbat.example/post/" + POST } }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  test("it has no other ground than a rule: a finding never alleges illegality and never goes the path that records no sender", () => {
    for (const ground of ["illegal", "csam", "order", "law", ""]) expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ground }).success, ground).toBe(false);
    const { ground: _ground, ...withoutGround } = finding;
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse(withoutGround).success).toBe(false);
    // The members of the other grounds are refused, never ignored.
    for (const extra of [{ explanation: "words" }, { bonaFide: true }, { citedLaw: "a law" }, { keyword: "csam" }, { name: "A" }, { email: "a@b.example" }, { turnstileToken: "t" }]) {
      expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ...extra }).success, Object.keys(extra)[0]).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId: "R7" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId: null }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("its category is one of the Transparency Database's, but not the one that says a notifier was not sure", () => {
    for (const category of TDB_CATEGORIES) {
      expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category }).success, category).toBe(category !== "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE");
    }
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_MADE_UP" }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the categories a finding may carry are exported as a list, in the Transparency Database's order, for the console's form: exactly those the request takes", () => {
    expect(FINDING_CATEGORIES).toEqual(TDB_CATEGORIES.filter((category) => category !== "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE"));
    expect(FINDING_CATEGORIES).toHaveLength(TDB_CATEGORIES.length - 1);
    expect(TDB_CATEGORIES.filter((category) => FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category }).success)).toEqual(FINDING_CATEGORIES);
  });

  test("the answer names the case the finding opened or joined", () => {
    expect(FindingResponse.parse({ caseId: CASE })).toEqual({ caseId: CASE });
    expect(FindingResponse.safeParse({ caseId: "x" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("a saved text", () => {
  const save = { kind: "note", text: "Art. 18 check: no suspicion", salt: HEX, digest: HEX };

  test("is of one of the seven kinds, the recorded choice not to seal among them, with a 32-byte salt and a digest in lower-case hex", () => {
    expect(STAFF_TEXT_KINDS).toEqual(["facts", "reason", "legal_reference", "review_reason", "reveal_reason", "note", "seal_declined"]);
    for (const kind of STAFF_TEXT_KINDS) expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, kind }).success, kind).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, kind: "statement" }).success).toBe(false);
    for (const bad of [HEX.toUpperCase(), HEX.slice(2), `${HEX}00`, "", "g".repeat(64)]) {
      expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, salt: bad }).success, `salt ${bad}`).toBe(false);
      expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, digest: bad }).success, `digest ${bad}`).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, caseId: CASE }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the request's schema lets any text through: what a text must be is the route's to refuse, with a code of its own", () => {
    // A text that is too long or holds a control character is answered text_invalid, not invalid_request.
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: "x".repeat(STAFF_TEXT_MAX + 1) }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: `a${String.fromCharCode(7)}b` }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: 5 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("staffTextProblem: a well-formed text of at most 5000 UTF-16 units, with no control character but the line feed and no invisible direction or zero-width character", () => {
    expect(STAFF_TEXT_MAX).toBe(5000);
    const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
    expect(staffTextProblem(`two${LF}lines`)).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("")).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("x".repeat(5000))).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("x".repeat(5001))).toBe("too_long");
    // An emoji is two units: 2500 of them fit, and one more unit does not.
    const emoji = String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600);
    expect(staffTextProblem(emoji.repeat(2500))).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem(`${emoji.repeat(2500)}x`)).toBe("too_long");
    // Half of a surrogate pair has no UTF-8 bytes.
    expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(0xd83d)}b`)).toBe("malformed");
    expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(0xde00)}`)).toBe("malformed");
    // NUL and every other C0 control but the line feed.
    for (let code = 0; code < 32; code++) {
      expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBe(code === 10 ? null : "control");
    }
    // The invisible direction and spacing characters the notice texts refuse too; the joiners scripts and emoji need stay.
    for (const code of [0x202a, 0x202e, 0x2066, 0x2069, 0x200b, 0x2060, 0xfeff]) expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBe("format");
    for (const code of [0x200c, 0x200d]) expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem(`r${String.fromCharCode(0xe9)}sum${String.fromCharCode(0xe9)}`)).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the answers: the stored text's id and digest, the person's own drafts with their salts, and a snapshot's id and digest, never content", () => {
    expect(StaffTextSaved.parse({ id: CASE, digest: HEX })).toEqual({ id: CASE, digest: HEX });
    const draft = { id: CASE, kind: "facts", text: "The post names a home address.", salt: HEX, digest: HEX, createdAt: TIME };
    expect(StaffTextsResponse.parse({ texts: [draft] }).texts).toEqual([draft]);
    expect(Object.keys(StaffSnapshotTaken.parse({ id: CASE, digest: HEX, body: "content", media: [] }))).toEqual(["id", "digest"]);
  });
});

  test("parses a case with its target, suspicion, snapshots, items, decisions, appeals, texts and history", () => {

    expect(CaseView.safeParse(account).success).toBe(true);
    // A target whose row is gone is still an answer: staff see what is.
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, target: { type: "post", id: POST, link: `https://korbat.example/post/${POST}`, authorHandle: null, state: null, level: null } }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  test("a withheld snapshot carries its id, time and digest and no content, whatever the answer held", () => {

    expect(Object.keys(withheld).sort()).toEqual(["digest", "id", "takenAt", "withheld"]);
  });

  test("a snapshot that is shown carries everything its digest covers: the console recomputes the digest from the answer", async () => {
    const parsed = CaseSnapshot.parse(shown);

    const expected = await snapshotDigest({ ...shown, targetType: "post", postState: "visible" });
    expect(await snapshotDigest(parsed)).toBe(expected);
    const { salt: _salt, ...withoutSalt } = shown;
    expect(CaseSnapshot.safeParse(withoutSalt).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a seal's list holds at most the 500 rows the case answer carries", () => {

    const withList = (rows: number) => ({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...view.decisions[0]!, actions: [{ ...view.decisions[0]!.actions[0]!, sealed: { posts: rows, images: rows, deletedPosts: 0, list: Array.from({ length: rows }, () => row) } }] }] });
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(withList(500)).success).toBe(true);

  test("suspicion holds counts and days only", () => {

    expect(CaseView.safeParse(bad).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, suspicion: { ...view.suspicion, reach: { ...view.suspicion.reach, newestPostOn: TIME } } }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("the queue and the overview", () => {

    expect(QueuePage.safeParse({ cases: [{ ...row, lane: 3 }], nextCursor: null }).success).toBe(false);

  test("the queue's cursor is an opaque word: letters, digits, dashes and underscores", () => {

    expect(QueueQuery.safeParse({ cursor: "eyJhIjoxfQ_-" }).success).toBe(true);

    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, releaseOverdue: -1 }).success).toBe(false);
