### Create `apps/admin/src/screens/Appeals.tsx`

```tsx
import { MEASURES, type AppealRow } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { StaffApi } from "../api";
import { APPEAL_WORDS, describeError } from "../messages";
import { CaseLink } from "../nav";
import { parseCaseId, type CaseId } from "../router";
import { dateTime, Loaded, type Loadable } from "../ui";

/**
 * The appeals screen (3c design, sections 7.7 and 8): the appeals no review has answered yet, newest first, each with
 * its case, the decision it appeals, the end of that decision's appeal window, and whether the reading person may
 * review it. It shows no statement: what an appellant wrote is read on the case's page, whose read is logged and
 * counted. Everything a row shows is a time, a rule's id, a measure's label or one of the console's own sentences.
 */

/** What the decision of a row did, in the composer's labels for its measures. */
const actionsOf = (row: AppealRow): string => row.actions.map((kind) => MEASURES[kind].label).join(", ");

/** The marks of a row: whether this person may review it, whether its review is an admin's, and whether nobody may review it now. */
export function marksOf(row: AppealRow): string[] {
  const marks: string[] = [row.mayReview ? APPEAL_WORDS.mayReview : APPEAL_WORDS.mayNotReview];
  if (row.needsAdmin) marks.push(APPEAL_WORDS.needsAdmin);
  if (row.reviewer !== "available") marks.push(APPEAL_WORDS.reviewer[row.reviewer]);
  return marks;
}

export interface AppealsViewProps {
  rows: Loadable<AppealRow[]>;
  /** Whether the API named a further page. */
  more: boolean;
  loadingMore: boolean;
  onLoadMore(): void;
  onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void;
}

export function AppealsView({ rows, more, loadingMore, onLoadMore, onOpenCase }: AppealsViewProps) {
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="appeals-title">
      <h2 id="appeals-title">Appeals</h2>
      <p className="hint">{`${APPEAL_WORDS.reviewerRule} ${APPEAL_WORDS.statementOnCase}`}</p>
      <Loaded
        value={rows}
        render={(list) =>
          list.length === 0 ? (
            <p>No appeal waits.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="scroll">
              <table className="queue">
                <caption className="visually-hidden">Appeals that wait for a review</caption>
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th scope="col">Filed</th>
                    <th scope="col">Decision</th>
                    <th scope="col">Its appeal window ends</th>
                    <th scope="col">Review</th>
                    <th scope="col">
                      <span className="visually-hidden">Open</span>
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {list.map((row) => {
                    const id = parseCaseId(row.caseId);
                    return (
                      <tr key={row.id}>
                        <td>
                          <time dateTime={row.filedAt}>{dateTime(row.filedAt)}</time>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                          {`Decided ${dateTime(row.decidedAt)}, ${row.legal ? "on the law" : `under ${row.ruleId ?? "a rule"}`}: ${actionsOf(row)}`}
                        </td>
                        <td>
                          <time dateTime={row.deadline}>{dateTime(row.deadline)}</time>
                        </td>
                        <td>{marksOf(row).join(" ")}</td>
                        <td>
                          {id ? (
                            <CaseLink id={id} onOpen={onOpenCase}>
                              Open the case
                            </CaseLink>
                          ) : null}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )
        }
      />
      {more ? (
        <button type="button" onClick={onLoadMore} disabled={loadingMore} aria-busy={loadingMore}>
          Load more
        </button>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * Reads the list from its start through as many pages as the screen shows, one after the other. Each read is its
 * person's own: the screen is opened, or "Load more" clicked; the list never reads itself again on a timer.
 */
export async function readAppeals(api: StaffApi, pages: number): Promise<{ rows: AppealRow[]; next: string | null }> {
  const rows: AppealRow[] = [];
  let cursor: string | null = null;
  for (let page = 0; page < Math.max(1, pages); page++) {
    const answer = await api.appeals(cursor, { activity: true });
    rows.push(...answer.appeals);
    cursor = answer.nextCursor;
    if (cursor === null) break;
  }
  return { rows, next: cursor };
}

export function Appeals({ api, onOpenCase }: { api: StaffApi; onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void }) {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<Loadable<AppealRow[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [next, setNext] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loadingMore, setLoadingMore] = useState(false);
  const alive = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    readAppeals(api, 1).then(
      (answer) => {
        if (!alive.current) return;
        setRows({ state: "ready", value: answer.rows });
        setNext(answer.next);
      },
      (err: unknown) => alive.current && setRows({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) }),
    );
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
    // Read once per opening of the screen; the API client never changes while the page lives.
  }, [api]);

  const loadMore = async () => {
    if (next === null || rows.state !== "ready") return;
    setLoadingMore(true);
    try {
      const answer = await api.appeals(next, { activity: true });
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setRows({ state: "ready", value: [...rows.value, ...answer.appeals] });
      setNext(answer.nextCursor);
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setRows({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) });
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setLoadingMore(false);
    }
  };

  return <AppealsView rows={rows} more={next !== null} loadingMore={loadingMore} onLoadMore={() => void loadMore()} onOpenCase={onOpenCase} />;
}
```

### Create `apps/api/src/moderation/appeals.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { APPEALS_PAGE_SIZE, AppealsReviewedParams, DAILY_LIMITS, type AppealRequest, type AppealRow, type AppealsPage, type DecisionView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { REDRESS_VERSION } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { ActiveStaffSession, StaffStepUpConfirmed } from "../auth";
import { isDeadlock, isLockNotAvailable } from "../lib/lock-bounds";
import { authorDecisionView, decodeListCursor, encodeListCursor } from "./author";
import { reviewerOf } from "./cases";
import { ModerationError, isModerationErrorCode, type ModerationDeps } from "./context";
import { recordConfirmed, type DecideOutcome } from "./decide";
import { countOrRefuse, saltedStatement } from "./intake";
import { insertAction, insertAppeal, insertReview, pendingAppeals, raisedMessage, reviewedDecision, violatedUniqueConstraint } from "./repo";

/**
 * Appeals and their reviews (3c design, sections 6.3 and 7.7). An appeal has one shape: the author's appeal of a final
 * decision that restricts them, one for each such decision, while any of its measures is in force and within six
 * calendar months of being told. A review answers that one appeal: it keeps the decision or lifts measures of it, and
 * never restricts. The database decides whether an appeal is open and who may review it; this file inserts the rows.
 */

const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60_000;

/**
 * The longest an appeal waits for a lock. Its trigger takes the case's row for the length of its own transaction and
 * waits for whoever holds the case: a decision that is being recorded, which for a seal over thousands of images is
 * seconds, or an erasure.
 */
const APPEAL_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;

/** How often the appeal's transaction is run again after a deadlock or a lock timeout: in each nothing was written. */
const APPEAL_RETRIES = 2;

/**
 * POST /api/moderation/decisions/:id/appeal: the author's appeal of a decision about their post or their account. In
 * this order:
 *   1. the day's limit, five for an account, counted before anything is read, so that whatever the answer the request
 *      was counted;
 *   2. one transaction that inserts the appeal's row. Its trigger decides, under a lock on the decision's case, whether
 *      an appeal of this decision is open now for this account (appeal_not_open: the decision is not a final
 *      restriction, is someone else's, is past its window, or nothing of it is in force), and the unique index refuses
 *      a second appeal (appeal_exists). The statement is optional and free of form; the server makes its salt and
 *      digest. A deadlock or a lock timeout runs the transaction again, and when the last run fails the same way the
 *      answer is service_unavailable;
 *   3. the answer: the decision as its author now reads it, with the appeal waiting. A decision that is not the
 *      viewer's, or of which they were not told, never opened by its id and does not now: not_found.
 * A request that failed through no fault of its sender gives its hit on the day's limit back.
 */
export async function fileAppeal(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "limits" | "log">, viewer: string, decisionId: string, request: AppealRequest): Promise<DecisionView> {
  const key = `appeal:day:account:${viewer}`;
  await countOrRefuse(deps, key, DAY_MS, DAILY_LIMITS.appeals);
  const statement = await saltedStatement(request.statement);
  try {
    for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
      try {
        await deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
          await tx.execute(sql`select set_config('lock_timeout', ${`${APPEAL_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS}ms`}::text, true)`);
          await insertAppeal(tx, { decisionId, appellantId: viewer, statement });
        });
        break;
      } catch (err) {
        const refusal = raisedMessage(err);
        if (refusal !== null && isModerationErrorCode(refusal)) throw new ModerationError(refusal);
        if (violatedUniqueConstraint(err) === "appeals_once") throw new ModerationError("appeal_exists");
        if (!isDeadlock(err) && !isLockNotAvailable(err)) throw err;
        if (attempt >= APPEAL_RETRIES) throw new ModerationError("service_unavailable", 503, undefined, 30);
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // A refusal that is the sender's own (not open, appealed already) stays counted; anything else was not their doing.
    if (!(err instanceof ModerationError) || err.code === "service_unavailable") {
      await deps.limits.release(key).catch((failure: unknown) => deps.log.warn({ err: failure }, "appeal: a limit hit of a request that could not be saved could not be given back"));
    }
    throw err;
  }
  return authorDecisionView(deps, viewer, decisionId);
}

/**
 * GET /api/staff/appeals: the pending appeals, newest first, 50 a page, each marked whether the reading person may
 * review it (3c design, section 7.7). No row carries a statement: the reviewer reads it on the case page, whose read is
 * logged and counted.
 */
export async function appealsList(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, session: ActiveStaffSession, cursor?: string): Promise<AppealsPage> {
  const after = cursor === undefined ? null : decodeListCursor(cursor);
  const found = await pendingAppeals(deps.apiDb, reviewerOf(session), after, APPEALS_PAGE_SIZE + 1);
  const page = found.slice(0, APPEALS_PAGE_SIZE);
  const last = page.at(-1);
  return {
    appeals: page.map(
      (row): AppealRow => ({
        id: row.id,
        caseId: row.caseId,
        decisionId: row.decisionId,
        filedAt: row.filedAt,
        decidedAt: row.decidedAt,
        deadline: row.deadline,
        ruleId: row.ruleId as AppealRow["ruleId"],
        legal: row.legal,
        actions: row.actions,
        reviewer: row.reviewer,
        needsAdmin: row.needsAdmin,
        mayReview: row.mayReview,
      }),
    ),
    // One row more than the page was read: only then is there a next page.
    nextCursor: found.length > APPEALS_PAGE_SIZE && last ? encodeListCursor({ at: last.sortAt, id: last.id }) : null,
  };
}

/**
 * POST /api/staff/decisions/:decision/review, once its step-up verified (3c design, section 7.7): records the answer to
 * the author's one appeal of the decision, as a decision of kind review, in the one transaction every confirmed decision
 * runs (recordConfirmed), with its audit row as appeals_reviewed on the reviewed decision.
 *
 * Before the transaction: the redress texts are those the API serves now (the rulebook version is the reviewed
 * decision's, which the database holds the review to), and the appeal the reviewer's key confirmed is the decision's
 * pending appeal: when it is not, the appeal was answered since the console read the case, and the answer is
 * case_changed with nothing written. The database forces and compares the appeal again under the case's lock, and at
 * commit holds the audit row's params to the stored review, so a review answers exactly the appeal that was confirmed.
 * It refuses a reviewer who decided anything in the case or opened a finding in it (reviewer_conflict), a party
 * (staff_recused), and a moderator where the review needs an admin (admin_required).
 *
 * After the commit the transaction's own last step does what it does for every decision: the statement's mail, the
 * count of the person's decisions, and the mail to every staff account when the review lifted a seal.
 */
export async function review(deps: ModerationDeps, session: ActiveStaffSession, confirmed: StaffStepUpConfirmed, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<DecideOutcome> {
  // A confirmation of anything else never reviews an appeal: that would be a wiring fault, not a refusal.
  if (confirmed.action !== "appeals_reviewed" || confirmed.target.type !== "decision" || confirmed.keyId !== session.keyId) {
    throw new Error("a review needs a step-up that confirmed it");
  }
  const params = AppealsReviewedParams.parse(confirmed.params);
  if (params.redressVersion !== REDRESS_VERSION) throw new ModerationError("invalid_decision");

  const reviewsDecisionId = confirmed.target.id;
  const reviewed = await reviewedDecision(deps.apiDb, reviewsDecisionId);
  if (!reviewed) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  if (reviewed.pendingAppealId !== params.appealId) throw new ModerationError("case_changed");
  // As for a decision: a case's target and a post's author never change, so the subject is read before the transaction.
  const subject = reviewed.target.type === "account" ? reviewed.target.id : await deps.social.postAuthor(reviewed.target.id);

  return recordConfirmed(deps, session, confirmed, ctx, subject, async (tx, decisionId) => {
    await insertReview(tx, { id: decisionId, caseId: reviewed.caseId, reviewsDecisionId, decidedBy: session.userId, params });
    for (const action of params.actions) await insertAction(tx, decisionId, action);
  });
}

/** The case a reviewed decision belongs to, for the answer to a review that has just committed. */
export async function reviewedCase(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, decisionId: string): Promise<string> {
  const reviewed = await reviewedDecision(deps.apiDb, decisionId);
  if (!reviewed) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  return reviewed.caseId;
}
```

### Create `packages/db/migrations/0017_appeals.sql`

```sql
-- Appeals (3c design, section 6.3). Written by hand: this migration changes no table. It adds the trigger that decides
-- whether an appeal is open, two functions that answer who may review one, and replaces three functions of migration 0016
-- (CREATE OR REPLACE keeps each one's owner, grants and trigger): decisions_record, which now accepts a review;
-- decisions_apply, which now answers the appeal; and decision_actions_apply, which now refuses a seal taken while deciding
-- that would not be in force. As in 0016, every function is owned by the migrator, pins its search path, names every
-- object schema-qualified and has EXECUTE taken from PUBLIC; errors carry their code as the message under SQLSTATE P0001;
-- and a read that follows a lock is a statement of its own, which under READ COMMITTED sees every row committed while
-- the lock waited.
--
-- An appeal is checked and completed before it is stored. Whatever the insert supplied, the database sets when it was
-- filed and leaves it unanswered and unerased. It runs as its owner, since the API role cannot lock a case. In this order:
--   1. Before any check, the appealed decision's case, FOR KEY SHARE until the commit. That waits for whoever holds the
--      case FOR UPDATE: every decision (a correction that reverses the appealed decision among them) and the erasures of
--      a later migration. It does not wait for an intake's update of an open case, which changes no key, so a flood of
--      reports never holds an appeal back, nor an appeal a report.
--   2. The decision is final and restricts: what korbat does while it decides cannot be appealed, nor a decision that
--      restricts nothing, a review or a correction.
--   3. The appellant is the decision's subject: the author of the case's post, or the case's account.
--   4. The window: six calendar months after the author was told, compared with the clock read now, after the lock,
--      never with now(), which is the transaction's start. An appeal whose transaction began before its deadline but
--      whose lock waited for an erasure that found the decision final is refused, not left pending on erased evidence.
--   5. At least one of the decision's measures is in force: a decision that a correction reversed in full leaves its
--      author nothing to appeal, and an appeal filed while such a correction commits waits for it at step 1 and is
--      refused here.
-- Each refusal is appeal_not_open. The unique index appeals_once refuses a second appeal of one decision.
CREATE FUNCTION "public"."appeals_check"() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  d public.decisions;
  c public.cases;
  subject uuid;
BEGIN
  NEW.filed_at := now();
  NEW.answered_by := NULL;
  NEW.result := NULL;
  NEW.answered_at := NULL;
  NEW.erased_at := NULL;

  -- 1. A decision's case never changes, so the subquery's read before the lock names the right row.
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.cases k WHERE k.id = (SELECT x.case_id FROM public.decisions x WHERE x.id = NEW.decision_id) FOR KEY SHARE;

  -- 2.
  SELECT x.* INTO d FROM public.decisions x WHERE x.id = NEW.decision_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR d.kind <> 'final' OR d.outcome <> 'restricted' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'appeal_not_open';
  END IF;

  -- 3.
  SELECT k.* INTO c FROM public.cases k WHERE k.id = d.case_id;
  IF c.target_type = 'post' THEN
    SELECT p.author_id INTO subject FROM public.posts p WHERE p.id = c.target_id;
  ELSE
    subject := c.target_id;
  END IF;
  IF subject IS NULL OR NEW.appellant_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM subject THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'appeal_not_open';
  END IF;

  -- 4.
  IF NOT (clock_timestamp() < public.appeal_deadline(d.informed_at)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'appeal_not_open';
  END IF;

  -- 5.
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.decision_id = d.id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'appeal_not_open';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;--> statement-breakpoint
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "public"."appeals_check"() FROM PUBLIC;--> statement-breakpoint
CREATE TRIGGER "appeals_check" BEFORE INSERT ON "public"."appeals" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "public"."appeals_check"();--> statement-breakpoint
-- Whether the review of an appeal of this decision needs an admin. It reads two stored facts and nothing else: true when
-- the decision cites R2 or holds a seal; false otherwise, also for a decision that does not exist. It never reads the
-- freeze, so its answer does not change while an appeal waits, and it can be true only for a decision whose author was
-- told that it cites R2 or sealed their images, so the author's screen may show it as it is. A decision's own needs_admin
-- is not inherited by its review: the review of a restriction under R5 is any eligible moderator's. decisions_record
-- forces a review's needs_admin from it, and appeal_reviewer_state and the API's lists read it.
CREATE FUNCTION "public"."review_needs_admin"(decision uuid) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
  SELECT coalesce((
    SELECT d.rule_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'R2'
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions a WHERE a.decision_id = d.id AND a.kind = 'seal_media')
      FROM public.decisions d WHERE d.id = review_needs_admin.decision), false)
$$;--> statement-breakpoint
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "public"."review_needs_admin"(uuid) FROM PUBLIC;--> statement-breakpoint
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION "public"."review_needs_admin"(uuid) TO korbat_api;--> statement-breakpoint
-- Whether anyone at korbat may review a pending appeal now, as a word and never as accounts: null for an appeal that
-- does not exist or is answered; `available` when at least one live staff account decided no decision of the appeal's
-- case, opened no finding in it (the rule decisions_record refuses a review by, reviewer_conflict) and is not too close
-- to the case's subject or to anyone who reported in it; else `none_single_staff` when korbat has at most one live staff
-- account; else `none_eligible`. When the review needs an admin only admins count, in each of the three answers. It
-- runs as its owner, since the API role holds nothing in the auth schema, reads staff accounts without a lock, and only
-- reads.
CREATE FUNCTION "public"."appeal_reviewer_state"(appeal uuid) RETURNS text
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  a public.appeals;
  appealed_case uuid;
  admins_only boolean;
  live_staff integer;
BEGIN
  SELECT x.* INTO a FROM public.appeals x WHERE x.id = appeal_reviewer_state.appeal;
  IF NOT FOUND OR a.answered_by IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;
  SELECT d.case_id INTO appealed_case FROM public.decisions d WHERE d.id = a.decision_id;
  admins_only := public.review_needs_admin(a.decision_id);
  IF EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM auth.users u
        WHERE u.role <> 'user' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND (NOT admins_only OR u.role = 'admin')
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decisions x WHERE x.case_id = appealed_case AND x.decided_by = u.id)
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.intake_items i JOIN public.intakes n ON n.id = i.intake_id
                           WHERE i.case_id = appealed_case AND n.finding_by = u.id)
          AND NOT public.staff_case_conflict(u.id, appealed_case, true)) THEN
    RETURN 'available';
  END IF;
  SELECT count(*) INTO live_staff FROM auth.users u
   WHERE u.role <> 'user' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND (NOT admins_only OR u.role = 'admin');
  RETURN CASE WHEN live_staff <= 1 THEN 'none_single_staff' ELSE 'none_eligible' END;
END $$;--> statement-breakpoint
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "public"."appeal_reviewer_state"(uuid) FROM PUBLIC;--> statement-breakpoint
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION "public"."appeal_reviewer_state"(uuid) TO korbat_api;--> statement-breakpoint
-- decisions_record, replaced: a review is a decision too. Everything migration 0016 says of this function stands, and
-- is stated again here in full, since a replaced function keeps nothing of its old body. What a review adds, by step:
--   2. A review names a final decision of this case that restricts (reviews_decision_id), keeps it or reverses it in part
--      or in full, and carries that decision's category and rules version and a reason. Its appeal is forced: the one
--      pending appeal of the reviewed decision, read after step 1's lock, so that a review answers exactly that appeal
--      whatever the insert supplied; with none pending it is case_changed (the appeal was answered meanwhile, by another
--      review or by a correction that reversed everything). No other decision names an appeal.
--   4. Its reason is a saved text of the kind review_reason, as a correction's is.
--   5. Its parties are the case's subject and the signed-in reporters of the items the reviewed decision answered.
--      Then the reviewer's own conflict (reviewer_conflict): nobody reviews a case in which they decided anything, a
--      measure taken while deciding included, or opened a finding. A different person reviews, and the database holds it.
--   6. suspect is the reviewed decision's, as for a correction. needs_admin is review_needs_admin of the reviewed
--      decision: true when that decision cites R2 or sealed images, and not inherited otherwise, so a restriction under
--      R5 is reviewed by any eligible moderator.
--   9. The source is the reviewed decision's.
--  10. The author is told of every review, a kept one included: it answers their own appeal.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."decisions_record"() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  c public.cases;
  -- The decision a correction or a review is about.
  reviewed public.decisions;
  pending_appeal uuid;
  snapshot public.evidence_snapshots;
  subject uuid;
  reporters uuid[];
  considers_suspect boolean;
  considers_illegal boolean;
  considers_r5 boolean;
  from_notice boolean;
  from_user boolean;
  decider_role text;
  frozen boolean;
  per_hour integer;
  per_day integer;
  in_hour integer;
  in_day integer;
  reason_kind public.staff_text_kind;
  ends_interim boolean := false;
  target_deleted boolean;
BEGIN
  NEW.decided_at := now();
  NEW.xact := pg_current_xact_id();
  NEW.puid := replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', '');
  NEW.informed_at := NEW.decided_at;
  NEW.answers_from_seq := NULL;
  NEW.automated_detection := false;
  NEW.automated_decision := 'not_automated';
  NEW.territorial_scope := 'worldwide';
  NEW.author_mail_at := NULL;
  -- Only the erasure of a later migration marks a decision redacted.
  NEW.redacted_at := NULL;
  -- Only a review names an appeal, and step 2 forces which.
  NEW.appeal_id := NULL;

  -- 1.
  SELECT k.* INTO c FROM public.cases k WHERE k.id = NEW.case_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'a decision names a case that does not exist' USING ERRCODE = '23503';
  END IF;
  IF c.state_version IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.seen_state_version THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'case_changed';
  END IF;

  -- 2.
  IF NEW.kind = 'interim' THEN
    IF NEW.outcome <> 'restricted' OR c.closed_at IS NOT NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'An interim decision restricts, on an open case.';
    END IF;
  ELSIF NEW.kind = 'final' THEN
    IF NEW.outcome NOT IN ('restricted', 'no_violation', 'not_evident') OR c.closed_at IS NOT NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A final decision restricts or finds no breach, on an open case.';
    END IF;
    IF NOT (c.answered_seq < NEW.through_seq AND NEW.through_seq <= c.intake_seq) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'case_changed';
    END IF;
    NEW.answers_from_seq := c.answered_seq + 1;
  ELSIF NEW.kind = 'correction' THEN
    SELECT d.* INTO reviewed FROM public.decisions d
     WHERE d.id = NEW.reviews_decision_id AND d.case_id = NEW.case_id AND d.kind IN ('interim', 'final') AND d.outcome = 'restricted';
    IF NOT FOUND OR NEW.outcome NOT IN ('partly_reversed', 'reversed') OR NEW.category <> reviewed.category
       OR NEW.rules_version <> reviewed.rules_version OR NEW.reason_digest IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A correction reverses a restricting decision of its case, with that decision''s category and rules version and a reason.';
    END IF;
  ELSIF NEW.kind = 'review' THEN
    SELECT d.* INTO reviewed FROM public.decisions d
     WHERE d.id = NEW.reviews_decision_id AND d.case_id = NEW.case_id AND d.kind = 'final' AND d.outcome = 'restricted';
    IF NOT FOUND OR NEW.outcome NOT IN ('kept', 'partly_reversed', 'reversed') OR NEW.category <> reviewed.category
       OR NEW.rules_version <> reviewed.rules_version OR NEW.reason_digest IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A review keeps or reverses a final restriction of its case, with that decision''s category and rules version and a reason.';
    END IF;
    -- A statement of its own after the case's lock: it sees an appeal, and an answer to one, that committed while the lock waited.
    SELECT a.id INTO pending_appeal FROM public.appeals a WHERE a.decision_id = reviewed.id AND a.answered_by IS NULL;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'case_changed';
    END IF;
    NEW.appeal_id := pending_appeal;
  ELSE
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A decision is interim, final, a correction or a review.';
  END IF;

  -- 3.
  SELECT s.* INTO snapshot FROM public.evidence_snapshots s WHERE s.id = NEW.snapshot_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR snapshot.case_id <> NEW.case_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot_mismatch';
  END IF;
  IF snapshot.erased_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot_erased';
  END IF;
  IF snapshot.digest IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.snapshot_digest THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot_mismatch';
  END IF;

  -- 4. A read: decisions_apply confirms the texts, and refuses when one is gone by then.
  reason_kind := CASE WHEN NEW.kind IN ('review', 'correction') THEN 'review_reason' ELSE 'reason' END;
  IF (NEW.facts_digest IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_texts t WHERE t.digest = NEW.facts_digest AND t.case_id = NEW.case_id AND t.author_id = NEW.decided_by
           AND t.kind = 'facts' AND t.confirmed_at IS NULL AND t.erased_at IS NULL))
     OR (NEW.reason_digest IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_texts t WHERE t.digest = NEW.reason_digest AND t.case_id = NEW.case_id AND t.author_id = NEW.decided_by
           AND t.kind = reason_kind AND t.confirmed_at IS NULL AND t.erased_at IS NULL))
     OR (NEW.legal_reference_digest IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_texts t WHERE t.digest = NEW.legal_reference_digest AND t.case_id = NEW.case_id AND t.author_id = NEW.decided_by
           AND t.kind = 'legal_reference' AND t.confirmed_at IS NULL AND t.erased_at IS NULL)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'text_not_found';
  END IF;

  -- 5. What the decision considers: a final decision the items it answers, an interim one every unanswered item, a
  -- correction or a review the items its reviewed decision answered (for a corrected interim decision, every unanswered
  -- item). One statement after the case's lock reads every fact the steps below need of them.
  IF c.target_type = 'post' THEN
    SELECT p.author_id INTO subject FROM public.posts p WHERE p.id = c.target_id;
  ELSE
    subject := c.target_id;
  END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT i.reporter_account_id) FILTER (WHERE i.reporter_account_id IS NOT NULL), '{}'::uuid[]),
         coalesce(bool_or(i.suspect), false),
         coalesce(bool_or(i.alleges_illegal), false),
         coalesce(bool_or(n.rule_id = 'R5'), false),
         coalesce(bool_or(n.kind = 'user' AND i.alleges_illegal), false),
         coalesce(bool_or(n.kind = 'user'), false)
    INTO reporters, considers_suspect, considers_illegal, considers_r5, from_notice, from_user
    FROM public.intake_items i JOIN public.intakes n ON n.id = i.intake_id
   WHERE i.case_id = NEW.case_id
     AND CASE WHEN NEW.kind = 'final' THEN i.seq BETWEEN NEW.answers_from_seq AND NEW.through_seq
              WHEN NEW.kind IN ('correction', 'review') AND reviewed.kind = 'final' THEN i.answered_by = reviewed.id
              ELSE i.answered_by IS NULL END;
  IF public.staff_party_conflict(NEW.decided_by, array_remove(ARRAY[subject], NULL) || reporters, CASE WHEN c.target_type = 'post' THEN c.target_id END) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'staff_recused';
  END IF;
  -- The decision being inserted is not stored yet, so every decision of the case this reads is an earlier one.
  IF NEW.kind = 'review' AND (
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decisions x WHERE x.case_id = NEW.case_id AND x.decided_by = NEW.decided_by)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.intake_items i JOIN public.intakes n ON n.id = i.intake_id
                   WHERE i.case_id = NEW.case_id AND n.finding_by = NEW.decided_by)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'reviewer_conflict';
  END IF;

  -- 6.
  SELECT u.role::text INTO decider_role FROM auth.users u WHERE u.id = NEW.decided_by FOR SHARE;
  PERFORM public.account_is_staff(subject);
  NEW.suspect := CASE WHEN NEW.kind IN ('correction', 'review') THEN reviewed.suspect ELSE considers_suspect END;
  NEW.unseen := false;
  IF NEW.kind = 'final' AND c.target_type = 'post' THEN
    -- Read now, before decisions_apply answers anything: frozen through a suspect item of this case, through the author's
    -- account's case, or through a seal in force.
    SELECT public.post_frozen(c.target_id) INTO frozen;
    NEW.unseen := coalesce(frozen, false);
  END IF;
  IF NEW.kind = 'final' AND NEW.suspect AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.intake_items i WHERE i.case_id = NEW.case_id AND i.suspect AND i.answered_by IS NULL AND i.seq > NEW.through_seq) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'case_changed';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.rule_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'R2' AND NOT NEW.suspect THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A decision under R2 rests on a suspect item: a finding citing R2 is opened first.';
  END IF;
  NEW.needs_admin := CASE NEW.kind
                       WHEN 'final' THEN NEW.suspect OR considers_r5 OR coalesce(NEW.rule_id IN ('R2', 'R5'), false)
                       WHEN 'correction' THEN reviewed.needs_admin
                       WHEN 'review' THEN public.review_needs_admin(NEW.reviews_decision_id)
                       ELSE false END;
  IF NEW.needs_admin AND decider_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'admin_required';
  END IF;

  -- 7. A one-bigint key: the social module's pair locks use the two-key space, so the two never meet.
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('korbat.decision_cap:' || NEW.decided_by::text, 0));
  SELECT l.decisions_per_hour, l.decisions_per_day INTO per_hour, per_day FROM public.moderation_limits l WHERE l.id = 1;
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.decided_at > now() - interval '1 hour'), count(*) INTO in_hour, in_day
    FROM public.decisions d WHERE d.decided_by = NEW.decided_by AND d.decided_at > now() - interval '1 day';
  IF in_hour >= coalesce(per_hour, 60) OR in_day >= coalesce(per_day, 300) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'decision_cap';
  END IF;

  -- 8.
  IF (NEW.ground IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'illegal' OR NEW.outcome = 'not_evident') AND NOT considers_illegal THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'The ground of the law, and "illegality not evident", need a considered item that alleges illegality.';
  END IF;

  -- 9.
  NEW.source := CASE WHEN NEW.kind IN ('correction', 'review') THEN reviewed.source
                     WHEN from_notice THEN 'notice'::public.decision_source
                     WHEN from_user THEN 'report'::public.decision_source
                     ELSE 'own_initiative'::public.decision_source END;

  -- 10. Both reads come after the case's lock and after the subject's profile lock, which the deciding transaction takes
  -- first and the author's deletion and the purge take too, so the target cannot be deleted before the commit.
  IF NEW.kind = 'final' AND NEW.through_seq = c.intake_seq THEN
    SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m JOIN public.decisions d ON d.id = m.decision_id
                    WHERE m.case_id = NEW.case_id AND m.decision_kind = 'interim' AND m.kind <> 'seal_media' AND d.author_mail <> 'none')
      INTO ends_interim;
  END IF;
  NEW.ended_interim := ends_interim;
  IF c.target_type = 'post' THEN
    SELECT p.state = 'deleted_by_author' INTO target_deleted FROM public.posts p WHERE p.id = c.target_id;
  ELSE
    SELECT p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL INTO target_deleted FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = c.target_id;
  END IF;
  NEW.author_mail := CASE
                       WHEN NEW.ended_interim THEN 'pending'
                       WHEN NEW.kind = 'interim' AND NOT coalesce(target_deleted, false) THEN 'pending'
                       WHEN NEW.kind = 'final' AND NEW.outcome = 'restricted' THEN 'pending'
                       WHEN NEW.kind = 'correction' AND reviewed.author_mail <> 'none' THEN 'pending'
                       WHEN NEW.kind = 'review' THEN 'pending'
                       ELSE 'none' END::public.delivery_state;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;--> statement-breakpoint
-- decisions_apply, replaced: what a stored decision does to its case, before any of its measures exists, as migration
-- 0016 states it and as it stands again below, and now also what it does to an appeal:
--   - a review answers its one appeal, the one decisions_record forced: who answered, the review's outcome as the
--     result, and when. An appeal that is answered by then is case_changed; decisions_record read it pending under the
--     case's lock, so this is a guard and not a path;
--   - a correction that reverses everything answers the corrected decision's pending appeal as reversed, when there is
--     one: nothing of the decision is left to review. The deferred check refuses at commit a correction that says
--     "reversed" and leaves a measure in force, so the answer never stands on a false outcome;
--   - a correction that reverses part answers none: the appeal waits for a review, whose reversals reach only what is
--     still in force, and whose "kept" means that what remains stands.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."decisions_apply"() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  c public.cases;
  seals_before uuid[];
  ended uuid[];
  listed uuid[];
  open_items integer;
  open_lane smallint;
  oldest timestamptz;
  digests text[];
  confirmed integer;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.kind = 'final' THEN
    SELECT coalesce(array_agg(m.id), '{}'::uuid[]) INTO seals_before
      FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.case_id = NEW.case_id AND m.kind = 'seal_media' AND m.decision_kind = 'interim';
    UPDATE public.intake_items i
       SET answered_by = NEW.id,
           outcome = CASE NEW.outcome
                       WHEN 'restricted' THEN CASE WHEN NEW.ground = 'illegal' THEN 'restricted_legal' ELSE 'restricted_rule' END
                       WHEN 'not_evident' THEN CASE WHEN i.alleges_illegal THEN 'not_evident' ELSE 'no_violation' END
                       ELSE 'no_violation' END::public.item_outcome
     WHERE i.case_id = NEW.case_id AND i.seq BETWEEN NEW.answers_from_seq AND NEW.through_seq AND i.answered_by IS NULL;
    SELECT count(*), min(i.lane), min(i.created_at) INTO open_items, open_lane, oldest
      FROM public.intake_items i WHERE i.case_id = NEW.case_id AND i.answered_by IS NULL;
    UPDATE public.cases k
       SET state_version = k.state_version + 1,
           last_decided_at = now(),
           answered_seq = NEW.through_seq,
           lane = coalesce(open_lane, 2),
           oldest_open_at = oldest,
           closed_at = CASE WHEN open_items = 0 THEN now() END
     WHERE k.id = NEW.case_id
    RETURNING k.* INTO c;
    IF c.closed_at IS NOT NULL AND c.target_type = 'post' THEN
      PERFORM public.moderation_apply(ARRAY[c.target_id], true);
    END IF;
    SELECT coalesce(array_agg(s.id), '{}'::uuid[]) INTO ended
      FROM unnest(seals_before) AS s(id) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.id = s.id);
    IF cardinality(ended) > 0 THEN
      SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT s.post_id) INTO listed FROM public.seal_posts s WHERE s.action_id = ANY(ended);
      PERFORM public.moderation_apply(listed, false);
      IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions a JOIN public.decisions d ON d.id = a.decision_id WHERE a.id = ANY(ended) AND d.author_mail <> 'none') THEN
        UPDATE public.decisions d
           SET ended_interim = true, author_mail = CASE WHEN d.author_mail = 'none' THEN 'pending'::public.delivery_state ELSE d.author_mail END
         WHERE d.id = NEW.id;
      END IF;
    END IF;
  ELSE
    UPDATE public.cases k SET state_version = k.state_version + 1, last_decided_at = now() WHERE k.id = NEW.case_id;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.kind = 'review' THEN
    UPDATE public.appeals a
       SET answered_by = NEW.id, result = NEW.outcome::text::public.appeal_result, answered_at = now()
     WHERE a.id = NEW.appeal_id AND a.answered_by IS NULL;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'case_changed';
    END IF;
  ELSIF NEW.kind = 'correction' AND NEW.outcome = 'reversed' THEN
    UPDATE public.appeals a
       SET answered_by = NEW.id, result = 'reversed', answered_at = now()
     WHERE a.decision_id = NEW.reviews_decision_id AND a.answered_by IS NULL;
  END IF;

  digests := array_remove(ARRAY[NEW.facts_digest, NEW.reason_digest, NEW.legal_reference_digest], NULL);
  IF cardinality(digests) > 0 THEN
    UPDATE public.staff_texts t SET decision_id = NEW.id, confirmed_at = now()
     WHERE t.digest = ANY(digests) AND t.confirmed_at IS NULL AND t.erased_at IS NULL;
    GET DIAGNOSTICS confirmed = ROW_COUNT;
    IF confirmed <> cardinality(digests) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'text_not_found';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END $$;--> statement-breakpoint
-- decision_actions_apply, replaced: what a row of the ledger does once it is stored, as migration 0016 states it and as
-- it stands again below, with one step more for a seal taken while deciding. Such a seal stands for the suspect items
-- that had arrived by its decision's time (measures_in_force compares each item's created_at with the decision's
-- decided_at, and both are the starts of their transactions). So a seal whose only unanswered suspect item belongs to a
-- transaction that began after the decision's, and that committed before the decision locked its case, would be
-- recorded, told to its author, and not be in force: the images would stay served while the statement says that they
-- are sealed. The database now refuses it itself. Once the seal's list is written, a seal of an interim decision that
-- the view does not hold raises case_changed, with nothing stored: the console reads the case again, and the person
-- confirms again in a transaction that begins after the report. A seal that rests on an earlier unanswered suspect item
-- as well is in force and passes, whatever arrived later. A seal for good never ends with its case, and is not asked.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."decision_actions_apply"() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  d public.decisions;
  c public.cases;
  locked uuid[];
  listed uuid[];
  target_deleted boolean;
  covered boolean;
  snapshot public.evidence_snapshots;
BEGIN
  SELECT x.* INTO d FROM public.decisions x WHERE x.id = NEW.decision_id;
  SELECT k.* INTO c FROM public.cases k WHERE k.id = d.case_id;

  IF NEW.post_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    PERFORM public.moderation_apply(ARRAY[NEW.post_id], true);
  END IF;

  IF NEW.kind = 'seal_media' THEN
    IF c.target_type = 'post' THEN
      SELECT array_agg(l.post_id) INTO locked
        FROM (SELECT m.post_id FROM public.post_media m WHERE m.post_id = c.target_id ORDER BY m.id FOR NO KEY UPDATE) l;
    ELSE
      SELECT array_agg(l.post_id) INTO locked
        FROM (SELECT m.post_id FROM public.post_media m WHERE m.owner_id = c.target_id AND m.post_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.id FOR NO KEY UPDATE) l;
    END IF;
    IF locked IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'The case reaches no image: there is nothing to seal.';
    END IF;
    INSERT INTO public.seal_posts (action_id, post_id, images)
    SELECT NEW.id, l.post_id, count(*) FROM unnest(locked) AS l(post_id) GROUP BY l.post_id;
    -- The view itself is asked, never a copy of its clause: it is the one definition of which measures stand.
    IF d.kind = 'interim' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.id = NEW.id) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'case_changed';
    END IF;
    SELECT array_agg(s.post_id) INTO listed FROM public.seal_posts s WHERE s.action_id = NEW.id;
    IF c.target_type = 'post' THEN
      SELECT p.state = 'deleted_by_author' INTO target_deleted FROM public.posts p WHERE p.id = c.target_id;
    ELSE
      SELECT p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL INTO target_deleted FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = c.target_id;
    END IF;
    SELECT NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM public.seal_posts mine
              WHERE mine.action_id = NEW.id
                AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.seal_posts s JOIN public.measures_in_force f ON f.id = s.action_id
                                 WHERE s.post_id = mine.post_id AND s.action_id <> NEW.id AND (d.kind = 'interim' OR f.decision_kind <> 'interim')))
      INTO covered;
    UPDATE public.decision_actions a
       SET no_effect = CASE WHEN coalesce(target_deleted, false) THEN 'deleted' WHEN covered THEN 'already' END
     WHERE a.id = NEW.id;
    PERFORM public.moderation_apply(listed, false);
  ELSIF NEW.kind = 'unseal_media' THEN
    SELECT array_agg(s.post_id) INTO listed FROM public.seal_posts s WHERE s.action_id = NEW.reverses_action_id;
    PERFORM public.moderation_apply(listed, false);
  ELSIF NEW.kind IN ('reset_display_name', 'reset_bio') AND NEW.no_effect IS NULL THEN
    SELECT s.* INTO snapshot FROM public.evidence_snapshots s WHERE s.id = d.snapshot_id;
    IF NEW.kind = 'reset_display_name' THEN
      UPDATE public.profiles p SET display_name = p.handle WHERE p.id = NEW.subject_account_id AND p.display_name = snapshot.display_name;
    ELSE
      UPDATE public.profiles p SET bio = '' WHERE p.id = NEW.subject_account_id AND p.bio = snapshot.bio;
    END IF;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'profile_changed';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.reverses_action_id IS NOT NULL AND d.kind IN ('review', 'correction') THEN
    UPDATE public.intake_items i SET revision_pending_at = now()
     WHERE i.answered_by = d.reviews_decision_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decisions r WHERE r.id = d.reviews_decision_id AND r.kind = 'final');
  END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END $$;
```

```json
          "name": "decisions_rule_id",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6')"
        },
        "decisions_category": {
          "name": "decisions_category",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "decisions_category_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT')"
        },
        "decisions_automated_decision": {
          "name": "decisions_automated_decision",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"automated_decision\" in ('fully', 'partially', 'not_automated')"
        },
        "decisions_territorial_scope": {
          "name": "decisions_territorial_scope",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"territorial_scope\" = 'worldwide'"
        },
        "decisions_review_target": {
          "name": "decisions_review_target",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"kind\" in ('review', 'correction')) = (\"decisions\".\"reviews_decision_id\" is not null) and (\"decisions\".\"kind\" = 'review') = (\"decisions\".\"appeal_id\" is not null)"
        },
        "decisions_interim": {
          "name": "decisions_interim",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"kind\" <> 'interim' or \"decisions\".\"through_seq\" = 0"
        },
        "decisions_ground_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'incompatible' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is not null"
        },
        "decisions_ground_law": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_law",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is not null"
        },
        "decisions_restricted": {
          "name": "decisions_restricted",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"outcome\" <> 'restricted' or (\"decisions\".\"ground\" is not null and \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is not null and \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is not null)"
        },
        "decisions_digests": {
          "name": "decisions_digests",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')"
        },
        "decisions_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" is null or \"decisions\".\"ground\" is not distinct from 'illegal'"
        },
        "decisions_law_no_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_law_no_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is null"
        },

        }

      "checkConstraints": {
        "intakes_ref": {
          "name": "intakes_ref",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"ref\" ~ '^N-[A-Z2-7]{10}$'"
        },
        "intakes_rule_id": {
          "name": "intakes_rule_id",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6')"
        },
        "intakes_category": {
          "name": "intakes_category",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "intakes_category_keyword": {
          "name": "intakes_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL', 'KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL_DEEPFAKE', 'KEYWORD_GROOMING_SEXUAL_ENTICEMENT_MINORS')"
        },
        "intakes_cited_law_len": {
          "name": "intakes_cited_law_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"cited_law\") <= 300"
        },
        "intakes_explanation_len": {
          "name": "intakes_explanation_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"explanation\") <= 2000"
        },
        "intakes_has_ground": {
          "name": "intakes_has_ground",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\""
        },
        "intakes_illegal_elements": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_elements",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'user' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"bona_fide\" and (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is not null))"
        },
        "intakes_finding_legal": {
          "name": "intakes_finding_legal",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'finding' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\""
        },
        "intakes_illegal_not_tc": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_not_tc",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"category\" <> 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC'"
        },
        "intakes_csam": {
          "name": "intakes_csam",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"category\" = 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS' and \"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_contact_signed_out": {
          "name": "intakes_contact_signed_out",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out'"
        },
        "intakes_reporter_signed_in": {
          "name": "intakes_reporter_signed_in",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_in'"
        },
        "intakes_finding": {
          "name": "intakes_finding",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"finding_by\" is not null) and (\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'staff')"
        },
        "intakes_lookup": {
          "name": "intakes_lookup",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"lookup_hash\" is not null) = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out' or \"intakes\".\"csam\")"
        },
        "intakes_erased": {
          "name": "intakes_erased",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is null or (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is null and \"intakes\".\"cited_law\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_r2_finding_only": {
          "name": "intakes_r2_finding_only",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is distinct from 'R2' or \"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding'"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },
```

### Replace `apps/admin/src/App.tsx` (whole file)

```tsx
import { useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import { ApiError } from "./api";
import type { SignalApi } from "./enroll";
import { Layout, Masthead } from "./Layout";
import { describeError } from "./messages";
import { NavLink } from "./nav";
import type { ConsolePath } from "./router";
import { Appeals } from "./screens/Appeals";
import { Audit } from "./screens/Audit";
import { CaseScreen } from "./screens/Case";
import { Enroll } from "./screens/Enroll";
import { Home } from "./screens/Home";
import { Queue } from "./screens/Queue";
import { SignIn } from "./screens/SignIn";
import { Unavailable } from "./screens/Unavailable";
import type { ConsoleStore } from "./store";
import type { CredentialsLike } from "./webauthn";

/**
 * The console's page (3a design, section 9): the screen for the address and the session. An enrolment link needs no
 * session; every other page shows sign-in in place while there is none, at its own address, and its own screen after.
 */
export function App({ store, credentials, signal }: { store: ConsoleStore; credentials: CredentialsLike; signal: SignalApi | undefined }) {
  const state = useSyncExternalStore(store.subscribe, store.get, store.get);
  const [signOutError, setSignOutError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const { api } = store;
  const { session, route } = state;

  if (session.kind === "unavailable") return <Unavailable />;

  if (route.name === "enroll") {
    return (
      <>
        <Masthead />
        <main>
          <Enroll token={route.token} api={api} credentials={credentials} signal={signal} onUnavailable={store.unavailable} />
        </main>
      </>
    );
  }

  if (session.kind !== "signed-in") {
    return (
      <>
        <Masthead />
        <main>
          {session.kind === "checking" ? <p className="quiet">Loading</p> : null}
          {session.kind === "failed" ? (
            <section className="panel">
              <p role="alert" className="error">
                {session.message}
              </p>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => void store.start()}>
                Try again
              </button>
            </section>
          ) : null}
          {session.kind === "signed-out" ? <SignIn ended={session.ended} api={api} credentials={credentials} onSignedIn={store.signedIn} onUnavailable={store.unavailable} /> : null}
        </main>
      </>
    );
  }

  const signOut = async () => {
    setSignOutError(null);
    try {
      await api.signOut({ activity: true });
      store.signedOut();
    } catch (err) {
      // A session that had already ended has shown sign-in through the 401; any other failure leaves the session as it was.
      if (!(err instanceof ApiError && err.code === "staff_session_required")) setSignOutError(describeError(err));
    }
  };

  const navigate = (path: ConsolePath) => {
    setSignOutError(null);
    store.navigate(path);
  };

  return (
    <Layout me={session.me} path={state.path} warning={state.warning} onNavigate={navigate} onSignOut={() => void signOut()} onStay={() => void store.stay()}>
      {signOutError ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {signOutError}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {route.name === "home" || route.name === "signin" ? <Home me={session.me} api={api} credentials={credentials} onOpenCase={store.openCase} /> : null}
      {route.name === "audit" ? <Audit api={api} /> : null}
      {route.name === "queue" ? <Queue api={api} onOpenCase={store.openCase} /> : null}
      {/* Keyed by the case: another case's page starts with nothing of this one's. */}
      {route.name === "case" ? <CaseScreen key={route.id} id={route.id} api={api} credentials={credentials} role={session.me.role} drafts={store.drafts} onOpenCase={store.openCase} /> : null}
      {route.name === "appeals" ? <Appeals api={api} onOpenCase={store.openCase} /> : null}
      {route.name === "unknown" ? (
        <section aria-labelledby="unknown-title">
          <h2 id="unknown-title">No such page</h2>
          <p>There is no page at this address.</p>
          <p>
            <NavLink to="/" onNavigate={navigate}>
              Go to the home page
            </NavLink>
          </p>
        </section>
      ) : null}
    </Layout>
  );
}
```

```ts
import {
  AppealsPage,
  AuditPage,
  CaseView,
  ErrorEnvelope,
  FindingResponse,
  QueuePage,
  RevealResponse,
  StaffEnrollOptionsResponse,
  StaffEnrollVerifyResponse,
  StaffKeysResponse,
  StaffMe,
  StaffOverview,
  StaffSessionsResponse,
  StaffSignInOptionsResponse,
  StaffSignInVerifyResponse,
  StaffSnapshotTaken,
  StaffStepUpOptionsResponse,
  StaffTextSaved,
  StaffTextsResponse,
  type AppealReviewRequest,
  type CaseDecisionRequest,
  type FindingRequest,
  type IdentityRevealRequest,
  type StaffEnrollOptionsRequest,
  type StaffEnrollVerifyRequest,
  type StaffSessionRevokeRequest,
  type StaffSignInVerifyRequest,
  type StaffStepUpOptionsRequest,
  type StaffTextSaveRequest,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { z } from "zod";
import { messageFor } from "./messages";
import { isLowerUuid, type CaseId } from "./router";

/**
 * The console's calls to its API (3a design, sections 7 and 9). Every call goes to /api/staff/* on the console's own
 * origin, with the staff session's cookies. Each echoes the staff CSRF cookie in x-staff-csrf (the API requires it on
 * every write), sends X-Staff-Activity: 1 only when its caller says a person's action started it, and parses the answer
 * with the contracts' schema, so nothing the page shows is anything but what the contracts describe.
 */

/** The staff CSRF cookie, which the page can read and the API compares with the header; never the app's. */
export const STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE = "__Host-korbat_staff_csrf";
export const STAFF_CSRF_HEADER = "x-staff-csrf";
/** The mark of a request a person's action started: only such a request moves the session's idle end. */
export const STAFF_ACTIVITY_HEADER = "x-staff-activity";

/** A failed call: the API's code, or the console's own (network, invalid_answer), with the console's words for it. */
export class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly status: number,
    readonly code: string,
    message: string = messageFor(code),
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ApiError";
  }
}

/** What the API client runs on: the page's fetch and cookies, or a test's. */
export interface StaffApiDeps {
  fetch(input: string, init: RequestInit): Promise<Response>;
  cookie(): string;
}

/**
 * What the store listens for. Any staff_session_required answer means the API has already cleared both staff cookies,
 * so the store shows sign-in in place; a marked request that succeeded restarts the idle timer.
 */
export interface ApiHooks {
  /**
   * `carriedStaffCookie`: the refused request carried the staff CSRF cookie. Only a sign-in sets it, for the session's
   * 12 hours, and only a sign-out or a staff_session_required answer clears it, so a request that carried it was made
   * for a session that has now ended, even when no page held that session (a reload or a new tab after an idle-out).
   */
  onSessionRequired(carriedStaffCookie: boolean): void;
  onActivity(): void;
  /**
   * Every /me answer, marked or not: the session the browser's cookie names now, which the store keeps, so a page whose
   * cookie another tab replaced (a sign-out and a sign-in there) holds the new session's handle and binds step-ups to it.
   */
  onMe(me: StaffMe): void;
}

/** A call's options: `activity` is true only when a person's action (a click, a form, opening a screen) started it. */
export interface Call {
  activity?: boolean;
}

/** The audit reader's query: newest, before a cursor, or the page whose newest row is at a place; and its one filter. */
export interface AuditQuery {
  action?: "staff_sign_in";
  cursor?: number;
  at?: number;
}

/** A cookie's value by its exact name, from a document.cookie string. */
export function readCookie(cookies: string, name: string): string | undefined {
  for (const part of cookies.split(";")) {
    const trimmed = part.trim();
    const separator = trimmed.indexOf("=");
    if (separator > 0 && trimmed.slice(0, separator) === name) {
      try {
        return decodeURIComponent(trimmed.slice(separator + 1));
      } catch {
        return trimmed.slice(separator + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

/**
 * A case answered under another case's address is no answer (3c design, section 7.5: the action is built from what the
 * page shows): the page would show one case and act on another, so nothing is built from it.
 */
function sameCase(asked: string, view: CaseView): CaseView {
  if (view.id !== asked) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_answer");
  return view;
}

export type StaffApi = ReturnType<typeof createStaffApi>;

export function createStaffApi(deps: StaffApiDeps) {
  const hooks: ApiHooks = { onSessionRequired: () => undefined, onActivity: () => undefined, onMe: () => undefined };

  /**
   * One request. `schema` parses a 2xx answer; null means the route answers 204 with no body. A non-2xx answer becomes an
   * ApiError with the envelope's code (or not_found and internal when there is none), worded by the console.
   */
  async function request<T>(method: "GET" | "POST" | "DELETE", path: string, schema: z.ZodType<T> | null, call: Call, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
    const headers: Record<string, string> = { accept: "application/json" };
    const csrf = readCookie(deps.cookie(), STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE);
    if (csrf) headers[STAFF_CSRF_HEADER] = csrf;
    if (call.activity === true) headers[STAFF_ACTIVITY_HEADER] = "1";
    if (body !== undefined) headers["content-type"] = "application/json";

    let response: Response;
    try {
      // Same origin only, never cached, and never redirected: the staff API answers every request itself.
      response = await deps.fetch(path, {
        method,
        headers,
        body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
        credentials: "same-origin",
        cache: "no-store",
        redirect: "error",
      });
    } catch {
      throw new ApiError(0, "network");
    }

    if (!response.ok) {
      const envelope = ErrorEnvelope.safeParse(await response.json().catch(() => null));
      const code = envelope.success ? envelope.data.error.code : response.status === 404 ? "not_found" : "internal";
      // The API cleared both staff cookies with this answer; the store shows sign-in in place. The cookie is gone from
      // the page by now, so what the request carried, read before it was sent, is the only record that it was there.
      if (code === "staff_session_required") hooks.onSessionRequired(Boolean(csrf));
      throw new ApiError(response.status, code);
    }

    let value: T;
    if (schema === null) {
      value = undefined as T;
    } else {
      const parsed = schema.safeParse(await response.json().catch(() => undefined));
      if (!parsed.success) throw new ApiError(response.status, "invalid_answer");
      value = parsed.data;
    }
    // Only a marked success restarts the idle timer. A refused request moved nothing; one that did move the idle end but
    // failed later, or whose answer the schemas refused, only makes the timer read /me early, and it follows the answer.
    if (call.activity === true) hooks.onActivity();
    return value;
  }

  const query = (q: AuditQuery): string => {
    // Fixed order, numbers only: nothing a person typed reaches the address unchecked.
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (q.action !== undefined) params.set("action", q.action);
    if (q.cursor !== undefined) params.set("cursor", String(q.cursor));
    if (q.at !== undefined) params.set("at", String(q.at));
    const text = params.toString();
    return text === "" ? "" : `?${text}`;
  };

  return {
    hooks,
    me: async (call: Call = {}) => {
      const me = await request("GET", "/api/staff/me", StaffMe, call);
      hooks.onMe(me);
      return me;
    },
    sessions: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/sessions", StaffSessionsResponse, call),
    keys: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/keys", StaffKeysResponse, call),
    audit: (q: AuditQuery, call: Call = {}) => request("GET", `/api/staff/audit${query(q)}`, AuditPage, call),
    signOut: (call: Call = {}) => request<void>("POST", "/api/staff/signout", null, call),
    signInOptions: (call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/signin/options", StaffSignInOptionsResponse, call),
    signInVerify: (body: StaffSignInVerifyRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/signin/verify", StaffSignInVerifyResponse, call, body),
    enrollOptions: (body: StaffEnrollOptionsRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/enroll/options", StaffEnrollOptionsResponse, call, body),
    enrollVerify: (body: StaffEnrollVerifyRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/enroll/verify", StaffEnrollVerifyResponse, call, body),
    stepUpOptions: (body: StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/step-up/options", StaffStepUpOptionsResponse, call, body),
    /** The handle must already be the lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed: it is the action's target. */
    revokeSession: (handle: string, body: StaffSessionRevokeRequest, call: Call = {}) =>
      request<void>("DELETE", `/api/staff/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(handle)}`, null, call, body),

    // Moderation cases (3c design, section 7.3). A case's address is built from a checked id; every other value goes in
    // a body or, for the queue's cursor, is one the API itself handed out, encoded.
    overview: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/overview", StaffOverview, call),
    /** A page of the queue. Its refreshes carry no mark: they are the page's own, never its person's. */
    queue: (cursor: string | null, call: Call = {}) => request("GET", `/api/staff/queue${cursor === null ? "" : `?cursor=${encodeURIComponent(cursor)}`}`, QueuePage, call),
    caseView: async (id: CaseId, call: Call = {}) => sameCase(id, await request("GET", `/api/staff/cases/${id}`, CaseView, call)),
    takeSnapshot: (id: CaseId, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", `/api/staff/cases/${id}/snapshots`, StaffSnapshotTaken, call, {}),
    saveText: (id: CaseId, body: StaffTextSaveRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", `/api/staff/cases/${id}/texts`, StaffTextSaved, call, body),
    texts: (id: CaseId, call: Call = {}) => request("GET", `/api/staff/cases/${id}/texts`, StaffTextsResponse, call),
    openFinding: (body: FindingRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/findings", FindingResponse, call, body),
    /**
     * A decision on a case, with the key's confirmation: the case must already be the lower-case uuid the step-up
     * confirmed, since it is the action's target. The answer is the case as it now stands, and it is that case's.
     */
    decide: async (caseId: string, body: CaseDecisionRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(caseId)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameCase(caseId, await request("POST", `/api/staff/cases/${caseId}/decisions`, CaseView, call, body));
    },
    /** A page of the pending appeals, newest first. The cursor is one the API itself handed out, encoded. */
    appeals: (cursor: string | null, call: Call = {}) => request("GET", `/api/staff/appeals${cursor === null ? "" : `?cursor=${encodeURIComponent(cursor)}`}`, AppealsPage, call),
    /**
     * The review of the appeal of a decision, with the key's confirmation: the decision must already be the lower-case
     * uuid the step-up confirmed, since it is the action's target. The answer is the decision's case as it now stands,
     * and it must be the case of the page that asked.
     */
    review: async (caseId: string, decisionId: string, body: AppealReviewRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(caseId) || !isLowerUuid(decisionId)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameCase(caseId, await request("POST", `/api/staff/decisions/${decisionId}/review`, CaseView, call, body));
    },
    /** The item must already be the lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed: it is the action's target. */
    reveal: async (itemId: string, body: IdentityRevealRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(itemId)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return request("POST", `/api/staff/items/${itemId}/reveal`, RevealResponse, call, body);
    },
  };
}
```
