```tsx
}

function Target({ view }: { view: CaseView }) {
  const { target } = view;
  if (target.type === "post") {
    return (
      <p>
        The post now: {target.state === null ? "its row is gone" : `${target.state.split("_").join(" ")}, level ${target.level ?? "unknown"}`}
        {target.authorHandle === null ? null : (
          <>
            , by <UserText>{target.authorHandle}</UserText>
          </>
        )}
        . Its address, as text: <code>{target.link}</code>
      </p>
    );
  }
  // The fields as they read now are the same author's words as the snapshot's: on a case citing R3 or R5 they open
  // collapsed like those.
  const collapsed = collapsedLabel(view);
  return (
    <>
      <p>
        The account now: {target.handle === null ? "its row is gone" : <UserText>{target.handle}</UserText>}
        {target.deleted ? ", deleted" : ""}. The fields as they read now:
      </p>
      {target.displayName === null || target.displayName === "" ? <p className="quiet">No display name.</p> : <Frame by="Display name. Written by the author" text={target.displayName} collapsedLabel={collapsed} />}
      {target.bio === null || target.bio === "" ? <p className="quiet">No bio.</p> : <Frame by="Bio. Written by the author" text={target.bio} collapsedLabel={collapsed} />}
    </>
  );
}

function Item({ item, props }: { item: CaseItem; props: CaseScreenViewProps }) {
  const ground = item.csam ? "child sexual abuse material (notice)" : item.allegesIllegal ? "notice under Art. 16: illegal" : "breaks a rule";
  const by = writtenBy(item.source);
  const collapsed = item.ruleId !== null && Object.hasOwn(COLLAPSED_RULES, item.ruleId) ? `Show text (${item.ruleId}: ${COLLAPSED_RULES[item.ruleId]})` : undefined;
  return (
    <li className="panel item">
      <p>
        <strong>{`Item ${item.seq}`}</strong>
        {` (item ${item.position} of its notice), received ${dateTime(item.createdAt)}. `}
        {`${ground}${item.ruleId === null ? "" : `, ${item.ruleId}`}; ${categoryLabel(item.category)}.`}
      </p>
      <p>
        {"Source: "}
        <UserText>{item.source.label}</UserText>
        {sourceWords(item.source) === "" ? "" : ` (${sourceWords(item.source)})`}
      </p>
      <p>
        Names, as text: <UserText>{item.link}</UserText>
        {item.mediaId === null ? null : (
          <>
            {" and points at image "}
            <code>{item.mediaId}</code>
          </>
        )}
      </p>
      {/* The number is the re-examined item's place in its own notice: the page numbers this case's items otherwise, and the item may lie in an earlier case. */}
      {item.reexaminesPosition === null ? null : <p>{`Re-examination of item ${item.reexaminesPosition} of its notice`}</p>}
      {item.reexaminesYourDecision ? <p className="notice">You decided the item this re-examines. Leave it to another staff member when there is one.</p> : null}
      {item.erased ? <p className="quiet">Its words were erased under korbat's retention rules.</p> : null}
      {item.citedLaw === null ? null : <Frame by={`Cited law. ${by}`} text={item.citedLaw} />}
      {item.explanation === null ? null : <Frame by={`Explanation. ${by}`} text={item.explanation} collapsedLabel={collapsed} />}
      {item.statement === null ? null : <Frame by={`Statement for the re-examination. ${by}`} text={item.statement} collapsedLabel={collapsed} />}
      <p>{item.outcome === null ? "Unanswered." : `Answered: ${OUTCOME_WORDS[item.outcome]}.`}</p>
      {revealable(item.source) ? (
        <button type="button" onClick={() => props.onRevealOpen(item.id)} disabled={props.reveal !== null}>
          Reveal who sent this
        </button>
      ) : null}
      {props.reveal?.itemId === item.id ? <RevealDialog reveal={props.reveal} onChange={props.onRevealChange} onConfirm={props.onRevealConfirm} onClose={props.onRevealClose} /> : null}
    </li>
  );
}

export function RevealDialog({ reveal, onChange, onConfirm, onClose }: { reveal: RevealState; onChange: CaseScreenViewProps["onRevealChange"]; onConfirm(): void; onClose(): void }) {
  const { answer } = reveal;
  const revealed = answer === null ? null : (answer.handle ?? answer.name);
  return (
    <section className="dialog" role="dialog" aria-labelledby="reveal-title">
      <h4 id="reveal-title">Reveal who sent this</h4>
      {answer === null ? (
        <>
          <p className="hint">A reveal cannot be undone. It is recorded, mailed to every staff account and listed on every staff member's home screen for 30 days.</p>
          <label htmlFor="reveal-category">Why</label>
          {/* The list opens on a line that is no reason: the person chooses the one that goes on the record. */}
          <select
            id="reveal-category"
            value={reveal.category ?? ""}
            disabled={reveal.busy}
            onChange={(event) => onChange({ category: REVEAL_REASON_CATEGORIES.find((category) => category === event.target.value) ?? null })}
          >
            <option value="" disabled>
              Choose why
            </option>
            {REVEAL_REASON_CATEGORIES.map((category) => (
              <option key={category} value={category}>
                {REVEAL_REASONS[category]}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <label htmlFor="reveal-reason">Reason</label>
          <textarea id="reveal-reason" rows={3} value={reveal.reason} disabled={reveal.busy} onChange={(event) => onChange({ reason: event.target.value })} />
          <p className="hint">Write the reason in your own words. Never copy what a reporter or a notifier wrote.</p>
          {reveal.error ? (
            <p role="alert" className="error">
              {reveal.error}
            </p>
          ) : null}
          <div className="actions">
            <button type="button" className="primary" onClick={onConfirm} disabled={reveal.busy || !revealReady(reveal)} aria-busy={reveal.busy}>
              Confirm with your staff key
            </button>
            <button type="button" onClick={onClose} disabled={reveal.busy}>
              Cancel
            </button>
          </div>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          {revealed === null ? (
            <p>The name is no longer kept, so nothing can be shown. The reveal is recorded all the same.</p>
          ) : (
            <>
              {/* What it is, in the console's words; the name alone in the frame, where its hidden characters can be shown. */}
              <p>{answer.handle === null ? "The name the notifier gave:" : "The reporter's handle:"}</p>
              <Frame by={REVEALED_LABEL} text={revealed} />
            </>
          )}
          <div className="actions">
            <button type="button" onClick={onClose}>
              Close
            </button>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

function SealList({ sealed }: { sealed: NonNullable<CaseDecision["actions"][number]["sealed"]> }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const more = sealed.posts - sealed.list.length;
  return (
    <>
      <p>{`${sealed.images} images on ${sealed.posts} posts (${sealed.deletedPosts} of them deleted by their author)`}</p>
      <button type="button" className="quiet-button" onClick={() => setOpen((shown) => !shown)} aria-expanded={open}>
        {open ? "Hide the list of posts" : "Show the list of posts"}
      </button>
      {open ? (
        <>
          <ul className="seal-list">
            {sealed.list.map((row) => (
              <li key={row.postId}>
                {`${dateTime(row.createdAt)} `}
                <code>{row.postId}</code>
                {` ${counted(row.images, "image", "images")}`}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          {more > 0 ? <p>{`and ${more} more: use the runbook's query for a seal's posts`}</p> : null}
        </>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

function Decision({ decision, view, compose }: { decision: CaseDecision; view: CaseView; compose: CaseScreenViewProps["compose"] }) {
  const lifted = (id: string | null) => {
    const by = id === null ? undefined : view.decisions.find((other) => other.id === id);
    return by ? `lifted by the decision of ${dateTime(by.decidedAt)}` : "lifted";
  };
  return (
    <li className="panel decision">
      <p>
        <strong>{DECISION_KINDS[decision.kind]}</strong>
        {`: ${DECISION_OUTCOMES[decision.outcome]}, ${dateTime(decision.decidedAt)}, by `}
        <UserText>{decision.staffHandle}</UserText>
        {decision.ground === null ? "" : decision.ground === "illegal" ? "; on the law" : `; under ${decision.ruleId ?? "a rule"}`}
        {`; ${categoryLabel(decision.category)}.`}
      </p>
      {decision.suspect ? <p className="hint">Taken on a report or finding of child sexual abuse material.</p> : null}
      {decision.unseen ? <p className="notice">Taken while nobody could open the post's images: what it answered about an image was answered unseen.</p> : null}
      {decision.needsAdmin ? <p className="hint">An admin's decision.</p> : null}
      {decision.facts === null ? null : <Frame by="Facts. Written by staff" text={decision.facts} />}
      {decision.reason === null ? null : <Frame by="Reason. Written by staff" text={decision.reason} />}
      {decision.legalReference === null ? null : <Frame by="Legal reference. Written by staff" text={decision.legalReference} />}
      {decision.actions.length === 0 ? null : (
        <ul>
          {decision.actions.map((action) => (
            <li key={action.id}>
              {MEASURES[action.kind].label}
              {action.mediaId === null ? null : (
                <>
                  {" "}
                  <code>{action.mediaId}</code>
                </>
              )}
              {MEASURES[action.kind].lifts !== null
                ? ""
                : action.inForce
                  ? ": in force"
                  : action.liftedBy !== null
                    ? `: ${lifted(action.liftedBy)}`
                    : action.kind === "seal_media"
                      ? ": ended with the admin's answer"
                      : ": ended with the case's decision"}
              {action.noEffect === null ? "" : "; changed nothing when imposed"}
              {action.kind === "reset_display_name" || action.kind === "reset_bio" ? "; written once; the field as it reads now is shown above" : ""}
              {action.sealed === null ? null : <SealList sealed={action.sealed} />}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {compose === undefined ? null : <CorrectControl view={view} decision={decision} role={compose.role} disabled={compose.busy} onCorrect={compose.onCorrect} />}
    </li>
  );
}

/** One event of the history in the console's words. A staff member is named by their handle, as text. */
function historyWords(entry: CaseHistoryEntry): string {
  switch (entry.event) {
    case "item":
      return `Item ${entry.seq ?? ""} arrived${entry.reexamination ? " (a re-examination)" : ""}: ${entry.intakeKind === "finding" ? "a moderator's finding" : entry.csam ? "a notice of child sexual abuse material" : entry.allegesIllegal ? "a notice under Art. 16" : "a report"}${entry.ruleId === null ? "" : `, ${entry.ruleId}`}`;
    case "snapshot":
      return "A snapshot was taken";
    case "decision":
      return `${entry.decisionKind === null ? "Decision" : DECISION_KINDS[entry.decisionKind]}: ${entry.outcome === null ? "" : DECISION_OUTCOMES[entry.outcome]}`;
    case "appeal_filed":
      return "The author appealed";
    case "appeal_answered":
      return `The appeal was answered: ${entry.result === null ? "" : entry.result.split("_").join(" ")}`;
    case "note":
      return "A note was saved";
    case "seal_declined":
      return "Chose not to seal";
    case "reveal":
      return "A source was revealed";
    case "evidence_erased":
      return "A snapshot's content was erased";
    case "redaction":
      return "Content was erased when an R4 decision became final";
  }
}

export function CaseScreenView(props: CaseScreenViewProps) {
  const { view, busy, notice, error, note } = props;
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="case-title">
      <h2 id="case-title">{view.target.type === "post" ? "Case about a post" : "Case about an account"}</h2>
      <p>
        {`${LANE_NAMES[view.lane]}${view.lane === 0 ? " lane" : ""}; opened ${dateTime(view.openedAt)}; version ${view.stateVersion}`}
        {view.closedAt === null ? "" : `; closed ${dateTime(view.closedAt)}`}
      </p>
      {notice ? (
        <p role="status" className="notice">
          {notice}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {error ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {view.lane === 0 ? <p className="banner art18">{ART_18_BANNER}</p> : null}
      <SuspectBanner view={view} onOpenCase={props.onOpenCase} />

      <h3>Evidence</h3>
      <Target view={view} />
      {targetDiffers(view) ? (
        <button type="button" onClick={props.onSnapshot} disabled={busy !== null} aria-busy={busy === "snapshot"}>
          Take a fresh snapshot
        </button>
      ) : null}
      {view.snapshots.length === 0 ? <p className="quiet">The case holds no snapshot.</p> : null}
      {view.snapshots.map((snapshot, index) => (
        <Snapshot key={snapshot.id} snapshot={snapshot} newest={index === 0} props={props} />
      ))}
      {/* The images' list says so itself, above its entries; a case whose newest snapshot shows no content has no list. */}
      {view.target.type === "post" && !view.imagesAllowed && (view.snapshots[0] === undefined || view.snapshots[0].withheld) ? <p className="notice">{IMAGES_NOT_SHOWN}</p> : null}

      <h3>Items</h3>
      <ul className="plain">
        {view.items.map((item) => (
          <Item key={item.id} item={item} props={props} />
        ))}
      </ul>

      <h3>Decisions</h3>
      {view.decisions.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="quiet">No decision yet.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="plain">
          {view.decisions.map((decision) => (
            <Decision key={decision.id} decision={decision} view={view} compose={props.compose} />
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {view.appeals.map((appeal) => {
        const appealed = view.decisions.find((decision) => decision.id === appeal.decisionId);
        return (
          <div key={appeal.id} className="panel">
            <p>{`The author appealed${appealed ? ` the decision of ${dateTime(appealed.decidedAt)}` : ""} on ${dateTime(appeal.filedAt)}${appeal.result === null ? "; not answered yet" : `; answered: ${appeal.result.split("_").join(" ")}`}.`}</p>
            {appeal.statement === null ? null : <Frame by="Written by the appellant" text={appeal.statement} />}
            {/* A pending appeal says who may review it; the control stands only for the person the API marked. */}
            {appeal.result !== null ? null : (
              <>
                {appeal.needsAdmin ? <p className="hint">{APPEAL_WORDS.needsAdmin}</p> : null}
                {appeal.reviewer === null || appeal.reviewer === "available" ? null : <p className="notice">{APPEAL_WORDS.reviewer[appeal.reviewer]}</p>}
                {appeal.mayReview ? null : <p className="hint">{APPEAL_WORDS.mayNotReview}</p>}
                {props.compose === undefined || !appealed ? null : <ReviewControl view={view} decision={appealed} disabled={props.compose.busy} onReview={props.compose.onReview} />}
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}

      <h3>History</h3>
      <ol className="history">
        {view.history.map((entry, index) => (
          <li key={`${entry.at} ${entry.event} ${entry.refId ?? index}`}>
            <time dateTime={entry.at}>{dateTime(entry.at)}</time>
            {` ${historyWords(entry)}`}
            {entry.staffHandle === null ? null : (
              <>
                {", by "}
                <UserText>{entry.staffHandle}</UserText>
              </>
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>

      <h3>Notes</h3>
      <p className="hint">Notes are for staff only and go with the case's evidence.</p>
      {view.notes.length === 0 && view.sealsDeclined.length === 0 ? <p className="quiet">No note yet.</p> : null}
      {view.notes.map((text) => (
        <div key={text.id}>
          <p>
            <UserText>{text.staffHandle}</UserText>
            {`, ${dateTime(text.createdAt)}`}
          </p>
          <Frame by="Note. Written by staff" text={text.text} />
        </div>
      ))}
      {view.sealsDeclined.map((text) => (
        <div key={text.id}>
          <p>
            {"Chose not to seal: "}
            <UserText>{text.staffHandle}</UserText>
            {`, ${dateTime(text.createdAt)}`}
          </p>
          <Frame by="Reason. Written by staff" text={text.text} />
        </div>
      ))}
      <label htmlFor="case-note">Add a note</label>
      <textarea id="case-note" rows={3} value={note} disabled={busy !== null} onChange={(event) => props.onNoteChange(event.target.value)} />
      <div className="actions">
        <button type="button" onClick={props.onNoteSave} disabled={busy !== null || note.trim() === ""} aria-busy={busy === "note"}>
          Save the note
        </button>
      </div>

      {props.compose === undefined ? null : <ComposerView view={view} {...props.compose} />}
    </section>
  );
}

export function CaseScreen({ id, api, credentials, role, drafts, onOpenCase }: { id: CaseId; api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike; role: StaffRole; drafts: DraftSlots; onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void }) {
  const [view, setView] = useState<Loadable<CaseView>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [shownImage, setShownImage] = useState<ShownImage | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<"snapshot" | "note" | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const [reveal, setReveal] = useState<RevealState | null>(null);
  // The composer's draft lives in the store's slot for this case, so that it is still there after a session that ended
  // and a sign-in by the same handle; the page keeps its own copy to draw.
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<CaseDraft | null>(() => drafts.get(id));
  const draftNow = useRef<CaseDraft | null>(draft);
  /** The decision's draft that a correction or a review took the place of, to come back to when that is put away. */
  const beforeCorrection = useRef<CaseDraft | null>(null);
  const [composing, setComposing] = useState(false);
  const [composeError, setComposeError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [textErrors, setTextErrors] = useState<Partial<Record<DraftTextKind, string>>>({});
  /** The saves of texts that are on their way, by the text's kind: a confirmation waits for them, so that no text is saved twice. */
  const saving = useRef(new Map<DraftTextKind, Promise<void>>());
  const [declining, setDeclining] = useState<{ reason: string; busy: boolean; error: string | null } | null>(null);
  const alive = useRef(true);
  /** What the page shows of the case, as the last read left it: a read that fails is judged against it. */
  const page = useRef<Loadable<CaseView>>({ state: "loading" });

  /** Keeps a draft: in the store's slot, and on the page. */
  const keep = (next: CaseDraft) => {
    drafts.set(next);
    draftNow.current = next;
    setDraft(next);
  };

  /** A case with no draft yet gets a fresh one, with the texts its person saved on it before (a reload fetches them back). */
  const openDraft = async (value: CaseView) => {
    if (draftNow.current !== null) return;
    const fresh = await withSavedTexts(newDraft(id, value, role), value.drafts);
    if (!alive.current || draftNow.current !== null) return;
    // Not put into the store's slot before its person changes it: an untouched draft is made again from the case.
    draftNow.current = fresh;
    setDraft(fresh);
  };

  /**
   * Reads the case: its person opened the page or acted on it, so the read is marked. True when the page now shows what
   * was just read. A read that fails after the first keeps the page and uses its error line (afterFailedRead).
   */
  const read = (): Promise<boolean> =>
    api.caseView(id, { activity: true }).then(
      (value) => {
        if (!alive.current) return false;
        page.current = { state: "ready", value };
        setView(page.current);
        void openDraft(value);
        return true;
      },
      (err: unknown) => {
        if (!alive.current) return false;
        const failed = afterFailedRead(page.current, err);
        page.current = failed.view;
        setView(failed.view);
        if (failed.error !== null) setError(failed.error);
        return false;
      },
    );

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    void read();
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
    // Read once per opening of the page; the API client never changes while the page lives.
  }, [api, id]);

  const snapshot = async () => {
    setBusy("snapshot");
    setNotice(null);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api.takeSnapshot(id, { activity: true });
      // The snapshot's content is read with the case: that read is what the access log and the day's limit count.
      const fresh = await read();
      if (alive.current) setNotice(fresh ? "A fresh snapshot is the case's newest now." : "A fresh snapshot was taken. This page still shows the case as it was read before.");
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setError(describeError(err));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  const saveNote = async () => {
    setBusy("note");
    setNotice(null);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await saveStaffText({ api }, id, "note", note);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setNote("");
      const fresh = await read();
      if (alive.current) setNotice(fresh ? "The note is saved." : "The note is saved. This page still shows the case as it was read before.");
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setError(describeError(err, NOTE_WORDS));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  const confirmReveal = async () => {
    if (reveal === null || reveal.busy || reveal.category === null || !revealReady(reveal)) return;
    const { itemId, category, reason } = reveal;
    setReveal({ ...reveal, busy: true, error: null });
    const outcome = await revealSource({ api, credentials }, id, itemId, category, reason);
    if (!alive.current) return;
    if ("error" in outcome) {
      setReveal((current) => (current === null ? null : { ...current, busy: false, error: outcome.error }));
      return;
    }
    setReveal((current) => (current === null ? null : { ...current, busy: false, answer: outcome.answer }));
    // The history gains the reveal. Should this read fail, the page and the name it shows stay as they are.
    void read();
  };

  /** A text that is saved now: the refusal of an earlier save of it, worded under its field, no longer holds. */
  const textSaved = (kind: DraftTextKind) => setTextErrors((errors) => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(errors).filter(([refused]) => refused !== kind)));

  /**
   * A text's field lost focus: the text is saved, without the key, so that a reload before the first confirmation brings
   * it back (3c design, section 7.4). A refusal is worded under its field. What was written stays in the draft either
   * way: a text whose save failed is saved again by the confirmation.
   */
  const saveText = (kind: DraftTextKind) => {
    const written = draftNow.current;
    if (written === null || composing) return;
    const run = (async () => {
      const outcome = await saveDraftText({ api }, id, written, kind);
      if (!alive.current || outcome === null) return;
      if ("error" in outcome) {
        setTextErrors((errors) => ({ ...errors, [kind]: outcome.error }));
        return;
      }
      textSaved(kind);
      // Remembered only while the draft still holds the text that was saved: its person may have typed on meanwhile.
      const now = draftNow.current;
      if (now !== null && now.kind === written.kind && normalised(now.written[kind]) === outcome.saved.text) keep({ ...now, texts: { ...now.texts, [kind]: outcome.saved } });
    })();
    saving.current.set(kind, run);
    void run.finally(() => {
      if (saving.current.get(kind) === run) saving.current.delete(kind);
    });
  };

  /**
   * "Confirm with your staff key": the draft as the composer showed it, saved, confirmed and sent; the page then shows
   * what the answer says now stands. The busy flag is confirmWhileBusy's: down again on every way out.
   */
  const confirm = () => {
    if (composing) return Promise.resolve();
    const confirming = {
      alive: () => alive.current,
      shown: () => (page.current.state === "ready" ? page.current.value : null),
      draft: () => draftNow.current,
      saving: () => [...saving.current.values()],
      setBusy: setComposing,
    };
    return confirmWhileBusy(confirming, async (shown, held) => {
      setComposeError(null);
      setNotice(null);
      setError(null);
      const sent = offeredDraft(shown, role, held);
      const outcome = await confirmDecision({ api, credentials }, id, shown, sent, (kind, saved) => {
        // The confirmation saved a text whose save had failed when its field lost focus.
        textSaved(kind);
        if (draftNow.current !== null) keep({ ...draftNow.current, texts: { ...draftNow.current.texts, [kind]: saved } });
      });
      if (!alive.current) return;
      if ("error" in outcome) {
        // The refusal is worded in place and the draft kept. A text that is gone or was used is saved again at the next
        // try; a case or a snapshot that is no longer what the page shows is read again.
        const then = afterRefusal(outcome.code);
        if (then.saveAgain && draftNow.current !== null) keep({ ...draftNow.current, texts: {} });
        setComposeError(outcome.error);
        if (then.readAgain) void read();
        return;
      }
      const now = "view" in outcome ? outcome.view : outcome.fresh;
      page.current = { state: "ready", value: now };
      setView(page.current);
      if ("fresh" in outcome) {
        setNotice(outcome.notice);
        return;
      }
      // Decided: the draft is done with, and the composer starts anew on the case as it now stands.
      drafts.clear(id);
      beforeCorrection.current = null;
      draftNow.current = newDraft(id, now, role);
      setDraft(draftNow.current);
      setTextErrors({});
      setNotice(sent.kind === "review" ? COMPOSER.reviewed : decidedNotice(shown, now, sent.kind === "final"));
    });
  };

  /** "Do not seal now": the reason is saved as a text of its own kind, which is complete when saved, and the case is read again. */
  const declineSeal = async () => {
    if (declining === null || declining.busy) return;
    setDeclining({ ...declining, busy: true, error: null });
    try {
      await saveStaffText({ api }, id, "seal_declined", declining.reason);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setDeclining(null);
      const fresh = await read();
      if (alive.current) setNotice(fresh ? COMPOSER.declined : `${COMPOSER.declined} This page still shows the case as it was read before.`);
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setDeclining((current) => (current === null ? null : { ...current, busy: false, error: describeError(err, NOTE_WORDS) }));
    }
  };

  const composeProps = (value: CaseView): CaseScreenViewProps["compose"] =>
    draft === null
      ? undefined
      : {
          role,
          draft,
          now: new Date(),
          busy: composing,
          error: composeError,
          textErrors,
          declining,
          onChange: (change) => {
            setComposeError(null);
            // A text that is typed on again is judged anew at its next save.
            if (change.written !== undefined) setTextErrors({});
            if (draftNow.current !== null) keep({ ...draftNow.current, ...change });
          },
          onTextBlur: saveText,
          onSeal: () => {
            setComposeError(null);
            if (draftNow.current !== null) keep(withSeal(value, offeredDraft(value, role, draftNow.current)));
          },
          onConfirm: () => void confirm(),
          onDeclineOpen: () => setDeclining({ reason: "", busy: false, error: null }),
          onDeclineChange: (reason) => setDeclining((current) => (current === null ? null : { ...current, reason })),
          onDeclineSave: () => void declineSeal(),
          onDeclineClose: () => setDeclining(null),
          onCorrect: (decision) => {
            setComposeError(null);
            setTextErrors({});
            if (draftNow.current !== null && draftNow.current.kind !== "correction" && draftNow.current.kind !== "review") beforeCorrection.current = draftNow.current;
            const opened = correctionDraft(id, value, decision, role);
            keep(opened);
            // The reason its person saved for a correction on this case before comes back with it, unless they have typed since.
            void openCorrection(id, value, decision, role).then((restored) => {
              if (alive.current && draftNow.current === opened) keep(restored);
            });
          },
          onReview: (decision) => {
            setComposeError(null);
            setTextErrors({});
            if (draftNow.current !== null && draftNow.current.kind !== "correction" && draftNow.current.kind !== "review") beforeCorrection.current = draftNow.current;
            const opened = reviewDraft(id, value, decision, role);
            keep(opened);
            // As for a correction: a review reason saved on this case before comes back, unless its person has typed since.
            void openReview(id, value, decision, role).then((restored) => {
              if (alive.current && draftNow.current === opened) keep(restored);
            });
          },
          onCancelCorrection: () => {
            setComposeError(null);
            setTextErrors({});
            keep(beforeCorrection.current ?? newDraft(id, value, role));
            beforeCorrection.current = null;
          },
        };

  return (
    <Loaded
      value={view}
      render={(value) => (
        <CaseScreenView
          caseId={id}
          view={value}
          compose={composeProps(value)}
          shownImage={shownImage}
          busy={busy}
          notice={notice}
          error={error}
          note={note}
          reveal={reveal}
          onOpenCase={onOpenCase}
          // One image at a time: showing another puts the first back behind its placeholder.
          onShowImage={(image) => setShownImage({ id: image, clear: false, failed: false })}
          onShowClearly={() => setShownImage((current) => (current === null ? null : { ...current, clear: true }))}
          onHideImage={() => setShownImage(null)}
          // The image did not load: its place says so, and the case is read again, since what may be opened has
          // probably changed (a report froze the post, or its images were sealed, since the page read the case).
          onImageError={() => {
            setShownImage((current) => (current === null ? null : { ...current, failed: true }));
            void read();
          }}
          onSnapshot={() => void snapshot()}
          onNoteChange={setNote}
          onNoteSave={() => void saveNote()}
          onRevealOpen={(itemId) => setReveal({ itemId, category: null, reason: "", busy: false, error: null, answer: null })}
          onRevealChange={(change) => setReveal((current) => (current === null ? null : { ...current, ...change }))}
          onRevealConfirm={() => void confirmReveal()}
          onRevealClose={() => setReveal(null)}
        />
      )}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { FINDING_CATEGORIES, MEASURES, RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY, type AppealsReviewedParams, type CaseDecision, type CaseView, type DecisionActionParams, type MeasureKind, type RuleId, type TdbCategory } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { RULES, statementParagraphs, type StatementInput } from "@korbat/rules";
import {
  COMPOSER,
  complete,
  correctable,
  correctionChoices,
  holds,
  kindsOffered,
  lawOffered,
  leftOpen,
  liftable,
  liftedKind,
  measuresOffered,
  noEffectOf,
  offeredDraft,
  outcomesListed,
  previewOf,
  previewable,
  reviewChoices,
  reviewOutcomeOf,
  reviewable,
  sealOffered,
  snapshotImages,
  statementSent,
  suspectOpen,
  throughSeqOf,
  toggled,
  type CaseDraft,
  type DraftTextKind,
  type StaffRole,
} from "../compose";
import { APPEAL_WORDS, COMPOSER_KINDS, COMPOSER_OUTCOMES, COMPOSER_WORDS, REVIEW_OUTCOMES } from "../messages";
import { dateTime, UserText } from "../ui";
import { categoryLabel } from "../words";

/**
 * The decision composer (3c design, section 8): the outcome first, then, for a restriction, the kind, the ground and the
 * measures this target and kind allow; the category; the facts and the reason; and the preview, which is the statement
 * exactly as its author will receive it. What it offers follows the case and the person's role; the database checks
 * every rule again when the key has confirmed. A correction ("Lift what was done while deciding", "Correct this
 * decision") takes the composer's place while it is open, and so does the review of an appeal ("Review this appeal").
 */

/** "Do not seal now": the reason as typed, and what became of saving it. */
export interface DecliningState {
  reason: string;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
}

export interface ComposerViewProps {
  view: CaseView;
  role: StaffRole;
  draft: CaseDraft;
  /** The time the preview is rendered for: the decision's time, were it confirmed now. */
  now: Date;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  /** The refusal of a text's save, worded in place under its field. */
  textErrors: Partial<Record<DraftTextKind, string>>;
  declining: DecliningState | null;
  onChange(change: Partial<CaseDraft>): void;
  /** A text's field lost focus: the text is saved, without the key. */
  onTextBlur(kind: DraftTextKind): void;
  /** "Seal the images this case reaches". */
  onSeal(): void;
  onConfirm(): void;
  onDeclineOpen(): void;
  onDeclineChange(reason: string): void;
  onDeclineSave(): void;
  onDeclineClose(): void;
  onCancelCorrection(): void;
}

/**
 * The statement as its author will receive it, each paragraph as text in a frame of its own direction. In its place the
 * page says so when there is nothing to show yet (a restriction without a measure), nothing it can show (a post whose
 * snapshot cannot be shown: no creation time is made up), or nothing that is sent.
 */
function Preview({ view, draft, now }: Pick<ComposerViewProps, "view" | "draft" | "now">) {
  // A restriction without a measure has no statement yet: the page says so rather than show one that restricts nothing.
  if (draft.kind !== "correction" && draft.kind !== "review" && draft.outcome === "restricted" && !draft.actions.some((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null)) {
    return <p className="hint">{COMPOSER.previewNeedsMeasure}</p>;
  }
  if (!previewable(view)) return <p className="hint">{COMPOSER_WORDS.previewAfterSnapshot}</p>;
  let input: StatementInput;
  let paragraphs: string[];
  try {
    input = previewOf(view, draft, now);
    paragraphs = statementParagraphs(input);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  // A decision that restricts nothing and ends nothing sends its author nothing: no statement is shown as if it were sent.
  if (!statementSent(input)) return <p className="hint">{COMPOSER_WORDS.noStatement}</p>;
  return (
    <div className="frame preview">
      <h4>Preview: the statement as its author will receive it</h4>
      {paragraphs.map((paragraph, index) => (
        <p key={index} className="frame-text">
          <UserText>{paragraph}</UserText>
        </p>
      ))}
      {draft.actions.some((action) => action.kind === "seal_media") ? <p className="hint">{COMPOSER_WORDS.sealSettled}</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/** One of the draft's texts, as its person types it. It is saved when the field loses focus; a refusal of that save stands under the field. */
function TextField({ id, label, kind, rows, props, under }: { id: string; label: string; kind: DraftTextKind; rows: number; props: ComposerViewProps; under: string[] }) {
  const { draft } = props;
  const refused = props.textErrors[kind];
  return (
    <>
      <label htmlFor={id}>{label}</label>
      <textarea
        id={id}
        rows={rows}
        value={draft.written[kind]}
        disabled={props.busy}
        onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ written: { ...draft.written, [kind]: event.target.value } })}
        onBlur={() => props.onTextBlur(kind)}
      />
      {refused ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {refused}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {under.map((sentence) => (
        <p key={sentence} className="hint">
          {sentence}
        </p>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

function Confirm({ props, onCancel }: { props: ComposerViewProps; onCancel?: () => void }) {
  return (
    <>
      {props.error ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {props.error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <div className="actions">
        <button type="button" className="primary" onClick={props.onConfirm} disabled={props.busy || !complete(props.view, props.draft)} aria-busy={props.busy}>
          Confirm with your staff key
        </button>
        {onCancel ? (
          <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} disabled={props.busy}>
            Cancel
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

/** A correction of one decision: what of it to lift, the reason, and the preview. */
function CorrectionView(props: ComposerViewProps) {
  const { view, role, draft } = props;
  const decision = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === draft.reviewsDecisionId);
  const choices = correctionChoices(view, draft, role);
  if (!decision || choices.length === 0) {
    return (
      <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
        <h3 id="composer-title">{COMPOSER.correctLabel}</h3>
        <p>Nothing of that decision is in force any more.</p>
        <div className="actions">
          <button type="button" onClick={props.onCancelCorrection}>
            Cancel
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }
  const deciding = decision.kind === "interim";
  return (
    <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
      <h3 id="composer-title">{deciding ? COMPOSER.liftLabel : COMPOSER.correctLabel}</h3>
      <p>{`The decision of ${dateTime(decision.decidedAt)}. A correction only lifts: choose what of it to lift.`}</p>
      <ul className="plain">
        {choices.map(({ measure, reversal }) => (
          <li key={measure.id}>
            <label>
              <input type="checkbox" checked={holds(draft, reversal)} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ actions: toggled(draft, reversal, event.target.checked) })} />{" "}
              <span>{MEASURES[reversal.kind].label}</span>
              {measure.mediaId === null ? null : (
                <>
                  {" "}
                  <code>{measure.mediaId}</code>
                </>
              )}
            </label>
            {reversal.kind === "unseal_media" ? <p className="notice">{deciding ? COMPOSER.sealInError : COMPOSER.sealForGood}</p> : null}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <TextField id="compose-review-reason" label="Reason of the correction" kind="review_reason" rows={3} props={props} under={[COMPOSER.personalData]} />
      <Preview view={view} draft={draft} now={props.now} />
      <Confirm props={props} onCancel={props.onCancelCorrection} />
    </section>
  );
}

const REVIEW_ANSWERS: AppealsReviewedParams["outcome"][] = ["kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"];

/**
 * The review of an appeal (3c design, section 8): Keep, Reverse in part or Reverse; the reversals of the decision's
 * measures that are still in force; the reason; and the preview of the review's statement. A review only lifts. "Keep"
 * lifts nothing and "Reverse" everything still in force, so the page sets those itself; "Reverse in part" is chosen
 * measure by measure. Once the appeal is answered, or for a person the API did not mark as its reviewer, nothing is
 * offered but the way back.
 */
function ReviewView(props: ComposerViewProps) {
  const { view, role, draft } = props;
  const decision = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === draft.reviewsDecisionId);
  const offered = decision ? reviewable(view, decision) : null;
  if (!decision || offered === null) {
    return (
      <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
        <h3 id="composer-title">{COMPOSER.reviewLabel}</h3>
        <p>{APPEAL_WORDS.notYours}</p>
        <div className="actions">
          <button type="button" onClick={props.onCancelCorrection}>
            Cancel
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }
  const choices = reviewChoices(view, draft, role);
  const answer = reviewOutcomeOf(view, draft);
  // "Keep" lifts nothing and "Reverse" everything still in force; a part keeps what was chosen while it is one, and starts empty otherwise.
  const partial = draft.actions.length > 0 && draft.actions.length < choices.length;
  const choose = (next: AppealsReviewedParams["outcome"]) => props.onChange({ review: next, actions: next === "reversed" ? choices.map((choice) => choice.reversal) : next === "partly_reversed" && partial ? draft.actions : [] });
  return (
    <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
      <h3 id="composer-title">{COMPOSER.reviewLabel}</h3>
      <p>{`The decision of ${dateTime(decision.decidedAt)}. A review keeps it or lifts measures of it, and never adds one.`}</p>
      <fieldset>
        <legend>Answer</legend>
        {REVIEW_ANSWERS.map((option) => (
          <label key={option}>
            <input type="radio" name="compose-review" checked={answer === option} disabled={props.busy} onChange={() => choose(option)} /> <span>{REVIEW_OUTCOMES[option]}</span>
          </label>
        ))}
      </fieldset>
      <ul className="plain">
        {choices.map(({ measure, reversal }) => (
          <li key={measure.id}>
            <label>
              {/* What "Keep" and "Reverse" lift follows from the answer: only a part is chosen measure by measure. */}
              <input type="checkbox" checked={holds(draft, reversal)} disabled={props.busy || answer !== "partly_reversed"} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ actions: toggled(draft, reversal, event.target.checked) })} />{" "}
              <span>{MEASURES[reversal.kind].label}</span>
              {measure.mediaId === null ? null : (
                <>
                  {" "}
                  <code>{measure.mediaId}</code>
                </>
              )}
            </label>
            {reversal.kind === "unseal_media" ? <p className="notice">{COMPOSER.sealForGood}</p> : null}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <TextField id="compose-review-reason" label="Reason of the review" kind="review_reason" rows={3} props={props} under={[COMPOSER.personalData]} />
      <Preview view={view} draft={draft} now={props.now} />
      <Confirm props={props} onCancel={props.onCancelCorrection} />
    </section>
  );
}

/** One measure's checkbox, with the image it names for an image measure, and the sentence that it changes nothing now when it would not. */
function Measure({ measure, props, images }: { measure: MeasureKind; props: ComposerViewProps; images: string[] }) {
  const { view, draft } = props;
  const ofImage = MEASURES[measure].target === "image";
  const held = draft.actions.find((action) => action.kind === measure);
  const action: DecisionActionParams = { kind: measure, mediaId: ofImage ? (held?.mediaId ?? images[0] ?? null) : null };
  if (ofImage && images.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <li>
      <label>
        <input type="checkbox" checked={held !== undefined} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ actions: toggled({ ...draft, actions: draft.actions.filter((other) => other.kind !== measure) }, action, event.target.checked) })} />{" "}
        <span>{MEASURES[measure].label}</span>
      </label>
      {ofImage && held !== undefined ? (
        <>
          {" "}
          <label htmlFor={`compose-image-${measure}`} className="visually-hidden">
            Which image
          </label>
          <select
            id={`compose-image-${measure}`}
            value={action.mediaId ?? ""}
            disabled={props.busy}
            onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ actions: [...draft.actions.filter((other) => other.kind !== measure), { kind: measure, mediaId: images.find((image) => image === event.target.value) ?? null }] })}
          >
            {images.map((image, index) => (
              <option key={image} value={image}>
                {`Image ${index + 1}`}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </>
      ) : null}
      {noEffectOf(view, action) !== null ? <p className="hint">{COMPOSER.noEffect}</p> : null}
    </li>
  );
}

export function ComposerView(shown: ComposerViewProps) {
  const { view, role } = shown;
  if (shown.draft.kind === "correction") return <CorrectionView {...shown} />;
  if (shown.draft.kind === "review") return <ReviewView {...shown} />;
  // What the draft holds is shown as far as it is offered, and that is what the key confirms.
  const draft = offeredDraft(view, role, shown.draft);
  const props: ComposerViewProps = { ...shown, draft };
  const kinds = kindsOffered(view, role);
  if (kinds.length === 0) {
    return (
      <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
        <h3 id="composer-title">Decide</h3>
        <p>{COMPOSER.closed}</p>
      </section>
    );
  }
  const kind = draft.kind === "final" ? "final" : "interim";
  const listed = outcomesListed(view, role);
  const outcome = draft.outcome;
  const restricts = outcome === "restricted";
  const law = restricts && draft.ground === "illegal";
  const suspect = suspectOpen(view);
  const sealChosen = draft.actions.some((action) => action.kind === "seal_media");
  const images = snapshotImages(view);
  const left = leftOpen(view);
  const rule = RULES.find((each) => each.id === draft.ruleId) ?? RULES[0];
  const postHidden = view.target.type === "post" && view.target.state !== null && view.target.state !== "visible";
  // Beside the two outcomes of a decision without a measure, whenever they are listed: on a post whose images cannot be
  // opened, such an answer to a report about an image is given unseen.
  const unseen = view.target.type === "post" && !view.imagesAllowed && listed.some((each) => each !== "restricted");
  // Under the facts and under the reason: on a case with an unanswered suspect item, never to say what the images are;
  // then the rule on personal data, with where the text goes. The texts of a decision without a measure never reach its author.
  const underTexts = [...(suspect.length > 0 ? [COMPOSER.neverWrite] : []), restricts ? COMPOSER.personalData : `${COMPOSER_WORDS.personalDataRule} ${COMPOSER_WORDS.staysInRecord}`];

  return (
    <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
      <h3 id="composer-title">Decide</h3>

      <fieldset>
        <legend>Outcome</legend>
        {kinds.includes("final") ? null : <p className="notice">{COMPOSER.adminFinal}</p>}
        {listed.map((each) => (
          <label key={each}>
            {/* An outcome without a measure is a final decision's: choosing it makes the decision final, and puts its measures away. */}
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="compose-outcome"
              checked={outcome === each}
              disabled={props.busy}
              onChange={() => props.onChange(each === "restricted" ? { outcome: each } : { outcome: each, kind: "final", actions: draft.actions.filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts !== null) })}
            />{" "}
            <span>{COMPOSER_OUTCOMES[each]}</span>
          </label>
        ))}
        {unseen ? <p className="notice">{COMPOSER.unseen}</p> : null}
      </fieldset>

      {restricts ? (
        <fieldset>
          <legend>When</legend>
          {kinds.map((each) => (
            <label key={each}>
              {/* A measure belongs to one kind: the other kind's measures are put away with the change. */}
              <input type="radio" name="compose-kind" checked={kind === each} disabled={props.busy} onChange={() => props.onChange({ kind: each, actions: [] })} /> <span>{COMPOSER_KINDS[each]}</span>
            </label>
          ))}
        </fieldset>
      ) : null}

      {suspect.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="banner suspect">
          <p>{(view.suspicion?.reach.served ?? 0) > 0 ? COMPOSER.onlySealEnds : COMPOSER.noteEnds}</p>
          {sealOffered(view, kind, role) ? (
            <div className="actions">
              <button type="button" onClick={props.onSeal} disabled={props.busy || sealChosen}>
                {MEASURES.seal_media.label}
              </button>
              {/* The choice not to seal belongs beside the seal taken while deciding: an admin deciding the case seals for good or answers without a seal. */}
              {kind === "interim" ? (
                <button type="button" onClick={props.onDeclineOpen} disabled={props.busy || props.declining !== null}>
                  Do not seal now
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {props.declining === null || kind !== "interim" ? null : (
            <div className="dialog" role="group" aria-labelledby="decline-title">
              <h4 id="decline-title">Do not seal now</h4>
              <p>{COMPOSER.declineWords}</p>
              <label htmlFor="decline-reason">Why you do not seal now</label>
              <textarea id="decline-reason" rows={3} value={props.declining.reason} disabled={props.declining.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onDeclineChange(event.target.value)} />
              {props.declining.error ? (
                <p role="alert" className="error">
                  {props.declining.error}
                </p>
              ) : null}
              <div className="actions">
                <button type="button" onClick={props.onDeclineSave} disabled={props.declining.busy || props.declining.reason.trim() === ""} aria-busy={props.declining.busy}>
                  Record this choice
                </button>
                <button type="button" onClick={props.onDeclineClose} disabled={props.declining.busy}>
                  Cancel
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {role === "admin" && kind === "final" ? (
            <>
              <p>{COMPOSER.admin.endsFreeze}</p>
              <p>{COMPOSER.admin.unseen}</p>
              {view.target.type === "post" ? <p>{COMPOSER.admin.answersEarlier}</p> : null}
              <p>{COMPOSER.admin.afterwards}</p>
            </>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : view.lane === 0 && (postHidden || view.target.type === "account") ? (
        <p className="notice">{view.target.type === "account" ? COMPOSER.noteAdviceAccount : COMPOSER.noteAdvicePost}</p>
      ) : null}

      {restricts ? (
        <>
          <label htmlFor="compose-ground">Ground</label>
          <select
            id="compose-ground"
            value={law ? "illegal" : "incompatible"}
            disabled={props.busy}
            onChange={(event) => props.onChange(event.target.value === "illegal" ? { ground: "illegal", terrorist: false } : { ground: "incompatible", terrorist: false, category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY[draft.ruleId] })}
          >
            <option value="incompatible">A korbat rule</option>
            {lawOffered(view, kind) ? <option value="illegal">The law</option> : null}
          </select>
          {law ? (
            <>
              <TextField id="compose-legal" label="Legal reference" kind="legal_reference" rows={2} props={props} under={[]} />
              <label>
                <input type="checkbox" checked={draft.terrorist} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ terrorist: event.target.checked })} /> <span>Terrorist content (Regulation (EU) 2021/784, Article 2(7))</span>
              </label>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <label htmlFor="compose-rule">Rule</label>
              <select id="compose-rule" value={draft.ruleId} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ ruleId: event.target.value as RuleId, category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY[event.target.value as RuleId] })}>
                {/* A decision under R2 rests on a report or finding of child sexual abuse material: it is offered only where one is unanswered. */}
                {RULES.filter((each) => each.id !== "R2" || suspect.length > 0).map((each) => (
                  <option key={each.id} value={each.id}>{`${each.id}: ${each.title}`}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <p>{rule.text}</p>
              <div className="examples">
                <div>
                  <h5>Allowed</h5>
                  <ul>
                    {rule.allowed.map((example) => (
                      <li key={example}>{example}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h5>Not allowed</h5>
                  <ul>
                    {rule.notAllowed.map((example) => (
                      <li key={example}>{example}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </>
      ) : null}

      {/* Every decision carries a category, so every decision shows the one the key will confirm. */}
      <label htmlFor="compose-category">Category</label>
      <select id="compose-category" value={draft.category} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ category: event.target.value as TdbCategory })}>
        {FINDING_CATEGORIES.map((category) => (
          <option key={category} value={category}>
            {categoryLabel(category)}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>

      {restricts ? (
        <fieldset>
          <legend>Measures</legend>
          <ul className="plain">
            {sealChosen ? (
              <li>
                <label>
                  <input type="checkbox" checked disabled={props.busy} onChange={() => props.onChange({ actions: draft.actions.filter((action) => action.kind !== "seal_media") })} /> <span>{`${MEASURES.seal_media.label}: chosen`}</span>
                </label>
              </li>
            ) : null}
            {measuresOffered(view, kind).map((measure) => (
              <Measure key={measure} measure={measure} props={props} images={images} />
            ))}
          </ul>
        </fieldset>
      ) : null}

      {/* A restriction needs both texts; a decision without a measure may carry them, for the case's record. */}
      <TextField id="compose-facts" label="Facts" kind="facts" rows={4} props={props} under={underTexts} />
      <TextField id="compose-reason" label="Reason" kind="reason" rows={4} props={props} under={underTexts} />

      {kind === "final" && left.length > 0 && liftable(view).length > 0 ? (
        <fieldset>
          <legend>Measures taken while deciding</legend>
          <ul className="plain">
            {liftable(view).map((reversal) => (
              <li key={`${reversal.kind} ${reversal.mediaId ?? ""}`}>
                <label>
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={holds(draft, reversal)} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ actions: toggled(draft, reversal, event.target.checked) })} />{" "}
                  <span>{`Lift: ${MEASURES[liftedKind(reversal)].label}`}</span>
                </label>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </fieldset>
      ) : null}
      {kind === "final" && suspect.length > 0 && left.length > 0 ? <p className="notice">{COMPOSER.staysOpen(throughSeqOf(view), left.length)}</p> : null}

      <Preview view={view} draft={draft} now={props.now} />
      <Confirm props={props} />
    </section>
  );
}

/** Beside a decision with a measure in force: "Lift what was done while deciding" or "Correct this decision", for whoever may. */
export function CorrectControl({ view, decision, role, disabled, onCorrect }: { view: CaseView; decision: CaseDecision; role: StaffRole; disabled: boolean; onCorrect(decision: CaseDecision): void }) {
  const offered = correctable(view, decision, role);
  if (offered === null) return null;
  return (
    <button type="button" onClick={() => onCorrect(decision)} disabled={disabled}>
      {offered.label}
    </button>
  );
}

/** Beside a pending appeal: "Review this appeal", for the person the API marked as one who may review it. */
export function ReviewControl({ view, decision, disabled, onReview }: { view: CaseView; decision: CaseDecision; disabled: boolean; onReview(decision: CaseDecision): void }) {
  if (reviewable(view, decision) === null) return null;
  return (
    <button type="button" onClick={() => onReview(decision)} disabled={disabled}>
      {APPEAL_WORDS.reviewLabel}
    </button>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/** Runs one read and hands its outcome to `set`, unless the screen has gone meanwhile. */
function load<T>(alive: { current: boolean }, set: (value: Loadable<T>) => void, read: () => Promise<T>): void {
  read().then(
    (value) => alive.current && set({ state: "ready", value }),
    (err: unknown) => alive.current && set({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) }),
  );
}

/** The person's staff sessions, marked: the screen reads them when it opens and after a revocation the person asked for. */
function readSessions(api: StaffApi, alive: { current: boolean }, set: (value: Loadable<StaffSession[]>) => void): void {
  load(alive, set, async () => (await api.sessions({ activity: true })).sessions);
}

/** Where the screen's lists go as each read finishes. */
export interface HomeLists {
  overview(value: Loadable<StaffOverview>): void;
  signIns(value: Loadable<AuditEntry[]>): void;
  sessions(value: Loadable<StaffSession[]>): void;
  keys(value: Loadable<StaffKey[]>): void;
}

/**
 * What the screen reads when it opens, every read marked, since opening the screen is its person's action. It takes no
 * session: the sign-ins' 7 days are counted from a /me read now (readSignInsAtOpening), never from the session the page
 * holds, which can be hours old.
 */
export function openHome(api: StaffApi, alive: { current: boolean }, set: HomeLists): void {
  load(alive, set.signIns, () => readSignInsAtOpening(api));
  load(alive, set.overview, () => api.overview({ activity: true }));
  readSessions(api, alive, set.sessions);
  load(alive, set.keys, async () => (await api.keys({ activity: true })).keys);
}

export function Home({ me, api, credentials, onOpenCase }: { me: StaffMe; api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike; onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void }) {
  const [overview, setOverview] = useState<Loadable<StaffOverview>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  const [signIns, setSignIns] = useState<Loadable<AuditEntry[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<Loadable<StaffSession[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<Loadable<StaffKey[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [revoking, setRevoking] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const alive = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    openHome(api, alive, {
      overview: (value) => {
        setNow(Date.now());
        setOverview(value);
      },
      signIns: setSignIns,
      sessions: setSessions,
      keys: setKeys,
    });
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
    // Read once per opening of the screen, never again when the idle timer's reads change `me`; the API client never
    // changes while the page lives.
  }, [api]);

  const revoke = async (handle: string) => {
    setRevoking(handle);
    setNotice(null);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const outcome = await revokeSessionWithKey({ api, credentials }, handle);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setNotice(outcome === "revoked" ? "That session is signed out." : "That session had already ended.");
      readSessions(api, alive, setSessions);
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setError(describeError(err));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setRevoking(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <HomeView me={me} overview={overview} now={now} onOpenCase={onOpenCase} signIns={signIns} sessions={sessions} keys={keys} revoking={revoking} notice={notice} error={error} onRevoke={(handle) => void revoke(handle)} />
  );
}
```

### Replace `apps/admin/src/step-up.ts` (whole file)

```ts
import { STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE, StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, stepUpActionHash, stepUpBinding, type AppealsReviewedParams, type AuthenticationResponseJSON, type CaseDecidedParams, type IdentityRevealedParams } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { ApiError, type StaffApi } from "./api";
import { messageFor } from "./messages";
import { authenticationResponseToJSON, ceremonyFailure, fromBase64url, requestOptionsFromJSON, type CredentialsLike } from "./webauthn";

/**
 * The step-up as the console runs it (3a design, sections 7 and 9). Before it asks the key to confirm an action, the page
 * checks the options the API gave it: the challenge must be the 74 bytes of the contracts' step-up layout with the
 * staff_step_up purpose, bound to the sha256 of this session's handle and the hash of exactly the `{ action, target,
 * params }` the page chose, and the allow list must hold one key. Otherwise the key is never asked, so an API under an
 * attacker's control cannot have it sign an action the person did not choose. The check trusts the page, which Caddy
 * serves from its image, not the API.
 */

/** Options that bind something other than the action the person chose; the key was not asked. */
export class StepUpMismatch extends Error {
  readonly code = "step_up_mismatch";
  readonly status = 0;
  constructor() {
    super(messageFor("step_up_mismatch"));
    this.name = "StepUpMismatch";
  }
}

const sameBytes = (a: Uint8Array, b: Uint8Array): boolean => a.length === b.length && a.every((byte, i) => byte === b[i]);

/**
 * Checks step-up options against this session's handle and the action the page is about to confirm, with the contracts'
 * layout, purpose code, sorted-JSON text and hash, never a copy of them. Throws StepUpMismatch on any difference.
 */
export async function checkStepUpOptions(options: { challenge: string; allowCredentials?: unknown }, sessionHandle: string, action: StaffStepUpOptionsRequest): Promise<void> {
  const layout = STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE;
  let challenge: Uint8Array;
  try {
    challenge = fromBase64url(options.challenge);
  } catch {
    throw new StepUpMismatch();
  }
  if (challenge.length !== layout.bytes) throw new StepUpMismatch();
  if (challenge[layout.versionAt] !== layout.version || challenge[layout.purposeAt] !== layout.purpose) throw new StepUpMismatch();
  // The binding is recomputed here from what the page chose, so a challenge bound to another action, target, params or
  // session never reaches the key.
  const expected = await stepUpBinding(sessionHandle, await stepUpActionHash(action));
  if (!sameBytes(challenge.subarray(layout.bindingAt, layout.bindingAt + layout.bindingBytes), expected)) throw new StepUpMismatch();
  // Exactly one key, the session's own: an empty list would let the browser offer any key the person holds.
  if (!Array.isArray(options.allowCredentials) || options.allowCredentials.length !== 1) throw new StepUpMismatch();
}

/**
 * The action that revokes one of the person's staff sessions: its handle as the target, in lower case, the one spelling
 * the API accepts for a step-up target (it hashes the id exactly as sent), and no params.
 */
export function sessionRevokeAction(handle: string): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "staff_session_revoked", target: { type: "staff_session", id: handle.toLowerCase() }, params: {} });
}

/**
 * The action that reveals who sent an item: the item's id as the target and, as params, the reason's category and the
 * digest of the reason the person saved. The console builds it from what it shows, with the contracts' schema, so the
 * binding it checks before it asks the key is its own.
 */
export function revealAction(itemId: string, params: IdentityRevealedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "identity_revealed", target: { type: "intake_item", id: itemId }, params });
}

/**
 * The action that decides a case: the case's id as the target and, as params, the decision as the composer built it from
 * what the page shows: ids, enums, whole numbers and the digests the console computed, never a text. The contracts'
 * schema refuses anything else, so the binding the console checks before it asks the key is its own.
 */
export function decisionAction(caseId: string, params: CaseDecidedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "case_decided", target: { type: "case", id: caseId }, params });
}

/**
 * The action that reviews an appeal: the appealed decision's id as the target and, as params, the review as the review
 * composer built it from what the page shows: the appeal, ids, enums, whole numbers and digests, never a text.
 */
export function reviewAction(decisionId: string, params: AppealsReviewedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "appeals_reviewed", target: { type: "decision", id: decisionId }, params });
}

/**
 * One action confirmed by the key (3c design, section 8): the session's handle read from a marked /me right before,
 * since the API binds the challenge to the session the request's cookie names, which another tab's sign-in may have
 * replaced since the page read its session; then options for exactly this action, asked right before the key (the API
 * reads a step-up challenge only while more than a minute of its ten is left), checked against what the page chose,
 * signed, and handed to `send`, which sends the action's own request with the assertion. The only place the console asks
 * a key to confirm anything: the revocation of a session, a decision, a review and a reveal all go through it. Every
 * request is marked: the person clicked.
 */
export async function confirmWithKey<T>(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, action: StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, send: (stepUp: AuthenticationResponseJSON) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const { sessionHandle } = await deps.api.me({ activity: true });
  const { options } = await deps.api.stepUpOptions(action, { activity: true });
  await checkStepUpOptions(options, sessionHandle, action);
  let credential: unknown;
  try {
    credential = await deps.credentials.get({ publicKey: requestOptionsFromJSON(options) });
  } catch (err) {
    throw ceremonyFailure(err);
  }
  return send(authenticationResponseToJSON(credential));
}

/** "Sign out that session", confirmed by the key. "gone" when the session had already ended. */
export async function revokeSessionWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, targetHandle: string): Promise<"revoked" | "gone"> {
  const action = sessionRevokeAction(targetHandle);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, async (stepUp): Promise<"revoked" | "gone"> => {
    try {
      await deps.api.revokeSession(action.target.id, { stepUp }, { activity: true });
      return "revoked";
    } catch (err) {
      // The API answers a handle that names no live session of the person's as the app does: 404.
      if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 404 && err.code === "not_found") return "gone";
      throw err;
    }
  });
}

/**
 * "Reveal who sent this", confirmed by the key: the reveal of the item with the category and the digest of the saved
 * reason. Answers the reporter's handle or the notifier's given name; both are null when the name was forgotten.
 */
export function revealWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, itemId: string, params: IdentityRevealedParams) {
  const action = revealAction(itemId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.reveal(action.target.id, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/**
 * "Confirm with your staff key" in the decision composer: the decision on the case, with exactly the params the page
 * built. Answers the case as it stands after the decision, which the page then shows.
 */
export function decideWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, caseId: string, params: CaseDecidedParams) {
  const action = decisionAction(caseId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.decide(action.target.id, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/**
 * "Confirm with your staff key" in the review composer: the review of the decision's appeal, with exactly the params the
 * page built. Answers the decision's case as it stands after the review, which must be the case the page shows.
 */
export function reviewWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, caseId: string, decisionId: string, params: AppealsReviewedParams) {
  const action = reviewAction(decisionId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.review(caseId, action.target.id, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}
```
